AWS::AppSync::DomainName.rationale: Checked the resource page (4 property sections and 4 attributes), the tag page and 5 pinned schema descriptions; the domain name, certificate ARN and tag key/value patterns and lengths stated there are already enforced by the pinned schema.

AWS::AppSync::DomainNameApiAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections); it states no conditions, and the DomainName pattern and length shown there are already enforced by the pinned schema.

open_questions: CodeS3Location: the requirement that a runtime is given 'when code is used' is stated on Code only; whether it also applies to CodeS3Location is not stated, so CODE_REQUIRES_RUNTIME checks Code only.
SyncConfig/LambdaConflictHandlerConfig: described as the configuration used when ConflictHandler is LAMBDA; the text does not state that it is required then, so no rule was registered.
DataSourceName: must name a data source of the same API; this depends on another resource and was not registered.
RequestMappingTemplate: functions support only the 2018-05-29 version of the request mapping template; the template content is not checked.

LambdaAuthorizerConfig: an AppSync API may have only one Lambda authorizer configured at a time; counting AWS_LAMBDA across AuthenticationType and the AdditionalAuthenticationProviders items is not expressible with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.

AuthenticationType: the pages do not state that LambdaAuthorizerConfig, OpenIDConnectConfig or UserPoolConfig is required for AWS_LAMBDA, OPENID_CONNECT or AMAZON_COGNITO_USER_POOLS; no rule was registered.
MergedApiExecutionRoleArn: described as the service role for a merged API; the text does not state that it is required or only allowed when ApiType is MERGED, so no rule was registered.
EnvironmentVariables: the page gives a key pattern ^[A-Za-z]+\w*$ with 2 to 64 characters; map keys cannot be checked with the declarative operators.

QueryDepthLimit / ResolverCountLimit: 0 (or unspecified) is the documented default, while an explicitly set limit must be at least 1; whether an explicit 0 is accepted is unclear, so only the upper bounds were registered.
Name: the page lists the pattern [_A-Za-z][_0-9A-Za-z]* and maximum 65536 only as type metadata, not in the description, and the pinned schema has no pattern; not registered.
LambdaAuthorizerConfig/AuthorizerUri: the Lambda function must have a resource-based policy allowing AppSync to invoke it; external state.
ApiType / Visibility: explicitly setting GRAPHQL or GLOBAL in a stack update where the value was undefined replaces the API; update-time behaviour, not registered.

Definition / DefinitionS3Location: the page presents DefinitionS3Location as an alternative to embedding the schema ('rather than'), but does not state that exactly one of them is required or that both cannot be given; no rule was registered.
RequestMappingTemplate: optional for a Lambda data source and required for all other data sources; this depends on the Type of the referenced AWS::AppSync::DataSource and was not registered.
MetricsConfig: used only when the GraphQL API's ResolverLevelMetricsBehavior is PER_RESOLVER_METRICS and ignored for FULL_REQUEST_RESOLVER_METRICS; depends on another resource, not registered.
CodeS3Location: the requirement that a runtime is given 'when code is used' is stated on Code only; whether it also applies to CodeS3Location is not stated, so CODE_REQUIRES_RUNTIME checks Code only.
SyncConfig/LambdaConflictHandlerConfig: described as the configuration used when ConflictHandler is LAMBDA; not stated as required, so no rule was registered.

CachingConfig/CachingKeys: valid values are entries from the $context.arguments, $context.source and $context.identity maps; array string items cannot be scoped by the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.
Kind: the page does not state that PIPELINE requires PipelineConfig or that UNIT requires DataSourceName; no rule was registered.

SourceApiIdentifier / MergedApiIdentifier: APIs from other accounts strictly require the full resource ARN rather than the API ID; whether an API is cross-account is external information, so no rule was registered.
SourceApiAssociationConfig/MergeType: AUTO_MERGE uses the merged API's MergedApiExecutionRoleArn; this depends on the AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi resource and was not registered.
SourceApiIdentifier / MergedApiIdentifier are not marked required in the schema or on the page; whether both must be given to create an association is not stated.

ScalableDimension consists of the service namespace, resource type and scaling property, and ResourceId has a per-namespace format (e.g. service/<cluster>/<service> for ecs); consistency between ServiceNamespace, ScalableDimension and ResourceId was not registered as rules.

ServiceNamespace: the page lists allowed values (ecs | elasticmapreduce | ec2 | appstream | dynamodb | rds | sagemaker | custom-resource | comprehend | lambda | cassandra | kafka | elasticache | neptune | workspaces) but the pinned schema has no enum; not registered from page type metadata.
ScheduledActions: ScheduledActionName must be unique among the scheduled actions of the scalable target; uniqueness across array items cannot be expressed as a rule.
ResourceId for custom-resource must be the OutputValue of the CloudFormation stack that provides the resource; this depends on another stack and was not registered.
ReturnData: with math expressions only the final expression may return true and all other queries must set false; this spans several array items and was not registered.
MetricDataQuery Id must be unique among all MetricDataQuery objects of the policy; uniqueness across array items cannot be expressed as a rule.
CustomizedMetricSpecification/TargetTrackingMetric Dimensions must match the dimensions the metric was published with in CloudWatch (external state).

PredefinedMetricSpecification ResourceLabel is Required: Conditional; it is needed for ALBRequestCountPerTarget when a target group is attached to the Spot Fleet or ECS service, which depends on other resources and was not registered.
ResourceId and ScalableDimension have per-namespace formats and ScalableDimension starts with the service namespace; consistency with ServiceNamespace was not registered.
Which of TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration, StepScalingPolicyConfiguration and PredictiveScalingPolicyConfiguration must accompany each PolicyType is not stated explicitly on the pages.

PredictiveScalingMetricSpecification: whether a metric pair may be combined with individual load/scaling metrics is not stated explicitly; only the requirement for load and scaling metrics without a pair was registered.
StepScalingPolicyConfiguration MinAdjustmentMagnitude is described for AdjustmentType PercentChangeInCapacity; whether it is rejected or ignored for other adjustment types is not stated.
TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration TargetValue must be within -2^360 to 2^360 and valid for the chosen metric; not registered.

ComponentMonitoringSetting.DefaultOverwriteComponentConfiguration page says it is 'Required if CUSTOM mode is configured in ComponentConfigurationMode', which contradicts the ComponentConfigurationMode text (required for DEFAULT_WITH_OVERWRITE); confirm whether it is also required in CUSTOM mode (only the DEFAULT_WITH_OVERWRITE requirement is registered).

ConfigurationDetails.WindowsEvents / Processes and SubComponentConfigurationDetails.WindowsEvents / Processes may only be used for Windows EC2 instance components; the component platform cannot be decided from this resource's property values.

AWS::ApplicationSignals::Discovery.rationale: Checked the resource page and its 1 schema description; the type has only the read-only AccountId property, and the conditional wording on the page (recreating resources created before Application Map, instrumenting applications) describes behaviour, not property conditions.

AWS::ApplicationSignals::GroupingConfigu.rationale: Checked the resource page, the GroupingAttributeDefinition property page and 1 schema description; the only conditional wording describes when DefaultGroupingValue is used and read-only attribute formats, and required fields and lengths are already enforced by the schema.

open_questions: Sli (period-based) and RequestBasedSli (request-based): the page says you specify whether an SLO is period-based or request-based, but does not state explicitly that exactly one of Sli and RequestBasedSli must be specified.

RequestBasedSliMetric.MonitoredRequestCountMetric: it is not stated whether exactly one of GoodCountMetric and BadCountMetric must be specified.

MetricDataQueries arrays: 'exactly one' Expression must have ReturnData true, and at most 20 queries (10 MetricStat, 10 Expression) are allowed; these are array-level counts not expressed as per-item rules, and Id must be unique within each array.

SliMetric.KeyAttributes and DependencyConfig.DependencyKeyAttributes must include at least Type, Name and Environment 'if this SLO is related to a metric collected by Application Signals', and ResourceType/Identifier/Name are used only for particular Type values; the triggering condition is not tied to a specific property value.

CompositeSliConfig.SelectionConfig: Pattern is interpreted as a prefix for PREFIX and a regular expression for REGEX, but it is not stated whether Pattern is required for PREFIX/REGEX or CompositeSliComponents for EXPLICIT.
MetricStat.Period must be a multiple of 60 for regular-resolution metrics (1, 5, 10, 30 or multiples of 60 for high-resolution metrics); the metric resolution is external state.

Metric Dimensions Name/Value must contain only printable ASCII with at least one non-whitespace character, and Name cannot start with a colon; these character restrictions are not in the pinned schema and are not registered.
ExclusionWindow.StartTime can only be scheduled in the future, and Tags need the cloudwatch:TagResource permission; both depend on external state (current time, IAM permissions).

Tags: tag keys must be unique per resource and may use only letters and numbers representable in UTF-8 plus + - = . _ : / @; uniqueness across array items and the Unicode character set cannot be checked with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.
CapacityAssignmentConfiguration/CapacityAssignments/*/WorkgroupNames: the names must identify existing Athena workgroups; this depends on other resources and was not registered.

Parameters (Type FEDERATED): the page says to use either connection-arn or connection-type with connection-properties, but not both; how this relates to the top-level ConnectionType property is not stated, so no rule was registered.
ConnectionType: described as the connection type for a FEDERATED data catalog; whether it may be set for other Type values is not stated.
Name: the catalog name must be unique for the AWS account; this needs account state and was not registered.
Parameters: the Lambda ARNs, catalog-id account and Glue connection must exist; this needs external state and was not registered.

Tags: tag keys must be unique per resource and may use only letters and numbers representable in UTF-8 plus + - = . _ : / @; uniqueness and the Unicode character set cannot be checked with the declarative operators.

AWS::Athena::NamedQuery.rationale: Checked the resource page (5 property sections and the NamedQueryId attribute) and 6 pinned schema descriptions; they state no conditions beyond the schema's required properties, create-only properties and length limits.

AWS::Athena::PreparedStatement.rationale: Checked the resource page (4 property sections) and 4 pinned schema descriptions; they state no conditions beyond the schema's required properties, create-only properties and length limits.

open_questions: ManagedQueryResultsConfiguration: the pinned schema description says ResultConfiguration and ManagedQueryResultsConfiguration cannot be set at the same time, while the Enabled page says that with Enabled false results go to ResultConfiguration$OutputLocation; only the explicit Enabled=true versus OutputLocation conflict was registered.
ResultConfiguration/EncryptionConfiguration/KmsKey: described as the KMS key ARN or ID for SSE_KMS and CSE_KMS; the text does not say it is required for those options, so no rule was registered.

WorkGroupConfiguration/ExecutionRole applies only to Spark-enabled (and Identity Center enabled) workgroups and CustomerContentEncryptionConfiguration does not apply to Athena SQL workgroups; whether a workgroup is Spark-enabled is not decidable from one documented property value, so no rule was registered.

WorkGroupConfiguration/EngineConfiguration: to specify DPU values for provisioned-capacity queries the Classifications name should be athena-query-engine-properties with only max-dpu-count and min-dpu-count; this is should-wording on nested array items and was not registered.
WorkGroupConfiguration/EngineVersion/SelectedEngineVersion: valid values are determined by ListEngineVersions (external state).
WorkGroupConfigurationUpdates (including the ResultConfigurationUpdates Remove* flags) describes update-time changes; update-only behaviour was not registered.

Tags: tag keys must be unique per resource and may use only letters and numbers representable in UTF-8 plus + - = . _ : / @; uniqueness and the Unicode character set cannot be checked with the declarative operators.

Delegations/*/RoleType: the page says roleType can only be PROCESS_OWNER in CreateAssessment and only RESOURCE_OWNER in BatchCreateDelegationByAssessment; which API the CloudFormation handler uses for Delegations is not stated, so no rule was registered.
Tags Key/Value: the pinned schema descriptions give lengths 1-127 (key) and 1-255 (value) while the schema and tag page allow 1-128 and 0-256; the two disagree, so no length rule was registered.
Tags Key/Value: the schema descriptions allow Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -; this boilerplate character set is not enforced by the schema and was not registered.

VPCZoneIdentifier is Required: Conditional ('Required to launch instances into a nondefault VPC'), and its subnets must reside in the AvailabilityZones when both are given; both depend on VPC/subnet state outside this resource.
PlacementGroup: 'You cannot specify multiple Availability Zones and a cluster placement group' depends on the referenced placement group's strategy, which is another resource's value.
InstanceMaintenancePolicy: 'the difference between them cannot be greater than 100' (MaxHealthyPercentage - MinHealthyPercentage <= 100) needs arithmetic the rule operators cannot express.
DesiredCapacityType is supported 'for attribute-based instance type selection only'; it is not stated whether this means every or any MixedInstancesPolicy override must use InstanceRequirements.

InstancesDistribution: OnDemandAllocationStrategy 'prioritized' and SpotAllocationStrategy 'capacity-optimized-prioritized' are not valid for groups that specify InstanceRequirements; detecting InstanceRequirements in any override item is not expressible with the current operators.

LaunchTemplateOverrides.WeightedCapacity: 'If you specify a value for WeightedCapacity for one instance type, you must specify a value for WeightedCapacity for all of them' is a cross-item condition that is not registered.
Per-group limits (up to 40 instance types, up to four sets of InstanceRequirements, up to 20 launch templates across LaunchTemplate and overrides) count across array items and are not registered.

LifecycleHookSpecification.RoleARN is 'Valid only if the notification target is an Amazon SNS topic or an Amazon SQS queue'; it is not stated explicitly whether RoleARN requires NotificationTargetARN.
TrafficSourceIdentifier.Type must correspond to the kind of Identifier (Classic Load Balancer name, ELBv2 or VPC Lattice target group ARN); matching the identifier kind is not registered.

CapacityReservationSpecification: the intro mentions an 'open' CapacityReservationPreference, but the listed options are capacity-reservations-only, capacity-reservations-first, none and default; the valid value set is therefore not registered.
Valid values for array string items (MetricsCollection.Metrics, TerminationPolicies, NotificationConfigurations.NotificationTypes) are not registered because rule scopes address objects only.
Whether LaunchTemplate and MixedInstancesPolicy may both be specified is not stated explicitly ('You can alternatively associate a launch template ... by specifying a MixedInstancesPolicy').

ImageId and InstanceType are Required: Conditional on the page ('If you specify InstanceId, an ImageId is not required' / 'an InstanceType is not required'), while the pinned schema lists both as required; confirm which applies when InstanceId is used.

AssociatePublicIpAddress and PlacementTenancy: 'you must specify at least one subnet for VPCZoneIdentifier when you create your group' is a condition on the AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup that uses this launch configuration (another resource).
ClassicLinkVPCSecurityGroups is Required: Conditional ('Available for backward compatibility') without an explained condition.
Ebs: 'you cannot create an unencrypted volume from an encrypted snapshot' and 'the volume size must be equal or greater than the size of the snapshot' depend on the snapshot (external state).
Ebs.Throughput is described as 'The throughput (MiBps) to provision for a gp3 volume'; it is not stated explicitly that other volume types reject it.
BlockDeviceMappings Ebs Iops for gp3: the page states a 16,000 IOPS maximum, which may predate current gp3 limits; not registered as a rule.

RoleARN is 'Valid only if the notification target is an Amazon SNS topic or an Amazon SQS queue'; it is not stated explicitly whether RoleARN requires NotificationTargetARN, and the target kind is another resource.

StepAdjustments cross-item rules (ranges can't overlap or have a gap; at most one null lower bound and at most one null upper bound; a negative lower bound or positive upper bound requires a step with a null bound) are not registered.
StepAdjustment.ScalingAdjustment must be non-negative for exact capacity, but AdjustmentType is a top-level property outside the step adjustment scope; not registered.
The pinned schema description of ScalingAdjustment says 'For exact capacity, you must specify a positive value' while the page says 'non-negative'; the registered rule follows the page (>= 0).

ResourceLabel (target tracking and predictive metrics): 'You can't specify a resource label unless the target group is attached to the Auto Scaling group' depends on another resource; the ALBRequestCount metric pair also needs a resource label per the page example.
MetricDataQuery/TargetTrackingMetricDataQuery: Id must be unique across queries and ReturnData must be true only for the final expression; these cross-item conditions are not registered.

Predictive MetricSpecifications: it is not stated explicitly whether a metric pair excludes individual load/scaling metrics, or whether predefined and customized load (or scaling) metrics are mutually exclusive.

TargetTrackingConfiguration and PredictiveScalingConfiguration are required for their policy types, but the page does not state that they are rejected for other policy types (unlike ScalingAdjustment and StepAdjustments).
TimeZone must be a canonical IANA time zone name; validating against the IANA Time Zone Database is an external table and is not registered.

AWS::AutoScaling::WarmPool.rationale: Checked the resource page and the InstanceReusePolicy property page (the pinned schema has no property descriptions); the conditional wording only describes how warm pool size follows from MaxGroupPreparedCapacity, MinSize and the group's capacities, defaults, and the -1 value used to clear a setting on update, so no single-resource creation condition remains.

open_questions: ApplicationSource: 'You must specify either a CloudFormationStackARN or TagFilters' does not state explicitly whether both may be given; only 'at least one' is registered.

CustomizedLoadMetricSpecification / PredefinedLoadMetricSpecification: 'This property or a ... is required when configuring predictive scaling, and cannot be used otherwise'; no property value explicitly marks a scaling instruction as configuring predictive scaling, and mutual exclusivity of the two load metric properties is not stated explicitly.
PredictiveScalingMaxCapacityBehavior, PredictiveScalingMaxCapacityBuffer and ScheduledActionBufferTime are 'Valid only when configuring predictive scaling'; not registered for the same reason.
ScalingPolicyUpdateBehavior is 'Valid only when configuring dynamic scaling'; its relation to DisableDynamicScaling is not stated explicitly.
ResourceLabel (predefined load and scaling metrics) is Required: Conditional and requires an Application Load Balancer target group attached to the scalable resource (another resource).

PredefinedScalingMetricType ALBRequestCountPerTarget 'applies only to Auto Scaling groups, Spot Fleet requests, and ECS services'; this depends on the parent scaling instruction's ServiceNamespace and is not registered.

TargetTrackingConfiguration: EstimatedInstanceWarmup is used only for Auto Scaling groups and ScaleInCooldown/ScaleOutCooldown are not used for Auto Scaling groups; these depend on the parent scaling instruction and are not registered.
Each target tracking configuration must specify a unique scaling metric (cross-item uniqueness) - not registered.

The page lists allowed values (for example ServiceNamespace, ScalableDimension, PredictiveScalingMaxCapacityBehavior, PredictiveScalingMode, ScalingPolicyUpdateBehavior, PredefinedScalingMetricType) that the pinned schema does not enforce; they are not registered as rules.
CustomizedLoadMetricSpecification/CustomizedScalingMetricSpecification Dimensions must match the dimensions the metric was published with (external CloudWatch state).

Lifecycle (in BackupPlanRule and in CopyActions): DeleteAfterDays must be at least 90 days after MoveToColdStorageAfterDays; the compare operator cannot add a 90-day offset, so no rule was registered.
TargetLogicallyAirGappedBackupVaultArn: the ARN must be in the same account and Region as the backup plan; this depends on the deployment account and Region and was not registered.

ScanSettings and ScanActions (MalwareScanner, ResourceTypes, ScannerRoleArn, ScanMode) have no property descriptions on the pages or in the pinned schema, so any dependency between them is undocumented.

BackupSelection NotResources: the limit drops to 30 ARNs when wildcards are used; detecting wildcards inside the string array is not expressible with the declarative operators, so only the 500 limit was registered.

BackupSelection Conditions ConditionKey: the ConditionParameter page says to include the prefix aws:ResourceTag in the key, but the ConditionKey description uses the unprefixed example Department; whether the prefix is mandatory is ambiguous and was not registered.

FrameworkControls ControlScope: the page says a scope can be a combination of one resource type and one resource ID and describes ComplianceResourceIds as the ID of the only resource, while also listing Minimum 1 / Maximum 100 items; whether ComplianceResourceIds is limited to one ID and then requires exactly one ComplianceResourceTypes entry is not stated precisely.
FrameworkControls ControlName and ControlInputParameters: valid control names and parameter names/values come from the AWS Backup Audit Manager control catalog (external), not from the page.
FrameworkTags Key/Value: the schema descriptions allow Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -; this boilerplate character set is not enforced by the schema and was not registered.

MpaApprovalTeamArn: the page says it cannot be changed after it is set from the CloudFormation template, but the pinned schema does not mark it create-only; this is an update-time restriction and was not registered.

ReportSetting FrameworkArns, Accounts, OrganizationUnits and Regions: the page says RESOURCE_COMPLIANCE_REPORT and CONTROL_COMPLIANCE_REPORT also describe coverage by Regions and frameworks, but whether FrameworkArns is required for, or only allowed with, those templates is not stated.
ReportSetting ReportTemplate: the pinned schema description lists only BACKUP_JOB_REPORT | COPY_JOB_REPORT | RESTORE_JOB_REPORT while the page lists six templates; the rule uses the page list.
ReportPlanTags Key/Value: the schema descriptions allow Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -; this boilerplate character set is not enforced by the schema and was not registered.

Tags Key/Value: the page allows UTF-8 letters, numbers, spaces and + - = . _ : / while the pinned schema description allows Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and - (no colon); the two disagree, so no character-set rule was registered.

ProtectedResourceArns: the list may hold specific ARNs or the wildcard "*" but not both; checking whether a string array mixes "*" with ARNs is not expressible with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.

ProtectedResourceType: the page says each protected resource type can have one single value; whether this limits a restore testing plan to one selection per resource type (a cross-resource condition) is not stated precisely.
ProtectedResourceConditions KeyValue: allowed characters are letters, white space, numbers and + - = . _ : /; this character set is not enforced by the schema and was not registered.
RestoreMetadataOverrides: the allowed keys come from the restore testing inferred metadata list (external) and were not registered.

ResourceSelection Resources: up to 100 specific resources may be specified per tiering configuration (apparently summed across all ResourceSelection items), and each list holds either ARNs or the wildcard *; neither the cross-item total nor the ARN/wildcard exclusivity is expressible with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.

Tags: the tag page intro says allowed characters are UTF-8 letters, numbers and + - = . _ : / and that spaces are not allowed in tag values, but the pinned Key pattern allows separators (\p{Z}) and @ and the Value pattern allows any character except NUL; the boilerplate disagrees with the schema, so no character-set or no-space rule was registered.

ComputeResources MinvCpus, DesiredvCpus and MaxvCpus: the page only states that DesiredvCpus must lie between MinvCpus and MaxvCpus when it is updated; no creation-time ordering is stated, so no ordering rule was registered.

ComputeResources SpotIamFleetRole: the Type description says a SPOT environment must always specify spotIamFleetRole, while the SpotIamFleetRole description says it is required only when AllocationStrategy is BEST_FIT or unspecified; the rule follows the narrower SpotIamFleetRole statement.

ComputeResources InstanceTypes, ImageId and Ec2Configuration ImageIdOverride: instance types must share one architecture and the AMI must match it; this needs EC2 instance-type and AMI metadata (external) and was not registered.

LaunchTemplate Overrides TargetInstanceTypes: must not contain optimal, default_x86_64 or default_arm64, must be a subset of ComputeResources InstanceTypes and must not overlap between overrides; these string-array conditions are not expressible with the declarative operators.

LaunchTemplate / Overrides UserdataType: EKS_NODEADM is required when the image type is a custom AMI based on EKS_AL2023 or EKS_AL2023_NVIDIA; this depends on the AMI (external) and was not registered.

ComputeResources AllocationStrategy and LaunchTemplate: for Fargate they 'shouldn't be specified' (recommendation wording, not registered); the cached AllocationStrategy section is truncated and the pinned schema has no enum, so valid AllocationStrategy values were not registered.

Enhanced AMI update rules on the resource page (ServiceRole unset or AWSServiceRoleForBatch, AllocationStrategy values, ReplaceComputeEnvironment true for BEST_FIT, UpdateToLatestImageVersion true) apply to updates only and were not registered; the statement that UpdateToLatestImageVersion is ignored when an AMI comes from a launch template conflicts with the LaunchTemplate description.
Ec2Configuration ImageType: supported values differ between ECS and EKS environments and the cached section is truncated, so no value rule was registered.

AWS::Batch::ConsumableResource.rationale: Checked the resource page and 7 schema descriptions; the only constrained value is ResourceType (REPLENISHABLE | NON_REPLENISHABLE), which the pinned schema enum already enforces, and the remaining text describes read-only quantities and timestamps.

open_questions: Platform-dependent conditions inside EcsProperties TaskProperties and NodeProperties node ranges (ExecutionRoleArn required on Fargate; NetworkConfiguration not allowed on EC2 or ECS Managed Instances; NetworkMode only for MANAGED_INSTANCES; IpcMode not supported on Fargate; StopTimeout/StartTimeout at most 120 seconds on Fargate; Memory, Vcpus and swap settings not supported on Fargate) depend on the top-level PlatformCapabilities, which a scoped rule cannot read; they were registered only for ContainerProperties.

Per-container constraints registered for ContainerProperties (Memory at least 4 MiB, Swappiness 0-100, MaxSwap non-negative, EphemeralStorage 21-200 GiB, ResourceRequirements Type, LogDriver list, RuntimePlatform values, Windows restrictions, Ulimit names, EFS volume transit encryption and access point root directory) also apply to NodeRangeProperties Container and EcsProperties task containers/volumes; those duplicates were not registered.

Conditions across array items or between structure levels are not expressible: at least one essential container per task; DependsOn COMPLETE/SUCCESS cannot target an essential container; EKS container names must be unique; EKS memory limits must equal requests when both are set; TargetNodes ranges must cover all nodes (0:n); Vcpus and Memory must be specified at least once per node; all node groups must use the same InstanceType; EFS IAM authorization also requires ContainerProperties JobRoleArn; EKS Metadata Namespace must be identical across node ranges.

Image: the page limits images to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, colons, periods, forward slashes and number signs but also documents registry/repository@digest names; the character set conflicts with the digest form, so no Image rule was registered.

JobQueue: the job queue must be in the VALID state before it can be associated with a quota share; this is external state and was not registered.

FairsharePolicy / QuotaSharePolicy: once set, the policy type cannot be removed or changed to the other type; this is an update-time restriction and was not registered.

NotificationsWithSubscribers/*/Subscribers: a notification can have one SNS subscriber and up to 10 email subscribers; the per-SubscriptionType counts cannot be expressed with the declarative operators, only the total of 1-11 was registered.
Notification/Threshold: the maximum limit is described as 1,000,000% above the budgeted amount; how this applies to ABSOLUTE_VALUE thresholds is not stated, so it was not registered.
Budget/FilterExpression: ExpressionDimensionValues MatchOptions may contain only one value, but expressions nest recursively through And, Or and Not, which a fixed scope cannot cover; not registered.

ThresholdExpression: the match option GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL is required and values must be numbers between 0 and 10,000,000,000; these constraints apply inside the JSON string and were not registered.
