PermissionModel is top-level while DeploymentTargets is inside StackInstancesGroup items, which one scoped rule cannot combine; not registered.

AutoDeployment RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval is 'Required: Conditional'; the page only states 'Specify only if Enabled is set to True', so only the prohibition when Enabled is false was registered and whether it is required when Enabled is true is unclear.

TemplateURL: an Amazon S3 location must start with https://, but Systems Manager documents are also accepted and cannot be told apart reliably; the page gives a 1 MB limit while the schema description says 460,800 bytes. Not registered.
AccountsUrl files must be .csv or .txt and at most 10 MB; this concerns the referenced object and was not registered.

StackSetName must be unique in the Region; CallAs DELEGATED_ADMIN requires the account to be registered as a delegated administrator; Capabilities depend on the template contents. All are external state.
ManagedExecution cannot be modified while operations are running or queued; this is an update-time restriction and was not registered.
TypeNameAlias must be unique within the account and Region; this depends on existing activations (external state).
VersionBump manually updates a previously activated type; whether specifying it on creation is rejected or ignored is not stated.
If a CreationPolicy is used with the wait condition, none of the wait condition's properties may be specified; CreationPolicy is a resource attribute, not a property value, so no rule was registered.

When a WaitCondition is added during a stack update it must use a new WaitConditionHandle, and updates of Count, Handle and Timeout are not supported; these are update-time restrictions and were not registered.

The type has no settable properties; the requirement to associate a wait condition added during a stack update with a new WaitConditionHandle is an update-time, cross-resource restriction and was not registered.

AWS::CloudFront::AnycastIpList.rationale: Checked the resource page, 5 property pages (AnycastIpList, IpamCidrConfig, IpamCidrConfigResult, Tags, Tag) and 32 schema descriptions; the only constraints stated are the Name pattern/length, IpAddressType values and tag key/value lengths and characters, all already enforced by the pinned schema, and the IPAM pool ARN is inside an array so no reference entry was added.

AWS::CloudFront::ConnectionGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page and 16 schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes the default connection group that CloudFront creates for distribution tenants (behaviour), so no single-resource condition beyond the schema applies; AnycastIpListId is registered as a reference.

open_questions: TrafficConfig.Type (SingleWeight or SingleHeader) is required, but the pages do not state that TrafficConfig.SingleWeightConfig must be given when Type is SingleWeight and SingleHeaderConfig when Type is SingleHeader (or that the other must be omitted); confirm before registering a Type-dependent rule.

StagingDistributionDnsNames must name the staging distribution's CloudFront domain name; checking that it belongs to a distribution with DistributionConfig.Staging true needs another resource's values.

CacheBehaviors items: DefaultTTL, MaxTTL, MinTTL, SmoothStreaming, TrustedSigners and ForwardedValues are documented as unsupported for multi-tenant distributions (ConnectionMode tenant-only), but a per-item scoped rule cannot read DistributionConfig.ConnectionMode, so this is not registered for CacheBehaviors.
CacheBehavior/DefaultCacheBehavior 'must include either a CachePolicyId or ForwardedValues' is registered as at-least-one; the pages do not say whether specifying both is rejected.

gRPC: a CacheBehaviors item with GrpcConfig.Enabled true needs DistributionConfig.HttpVersion to include HTTP/2 (not readable from a per-item scope), and any gRPC behaviour must allow HTTP methods including POST (AllowedMethods is an unordered array, not checkable with value_in); confirm how to enforce these.

TargetOriginId in DefaultCacheBehavior/CacheBehaviors must equal an Origins[].Id or OriginGroups Items[].Id, and Origins[].Id 'must be unique within the distribution'; these cross-array checks cannot be expressed with the available operators.
Origins[]: S3OriginConfig vs CustomOriginConfig ('Required: Conditional') depends on whether the S3 bucket uses static website hosting, which is external state.
Restrictions.GeoRestriction.Locations is 'Required: Conditional' without an explicit condition (presumably required for whitelist/blacklist and omitted for none); confirm before registering.

OriginReadTimeout (documented 1-120 s) and OriginKeepaliveTimeout (documented 1-300 s) in CustomOriginConfig/S3OriginConfig/VpcOriginConfig are not bounded in the pinned schema; confirm whether these ranges are fixed limits or quota-dependent before registering range rules.
ForwardedValues.Cookies.Forward must be none when the behaviour forwards to an Amazon S3 origin; this needs the target origin's type (and whether it is S3), which a single-field rule cannot resolve.

IPV6Enabled and AnycastIpListId: 'To use this field for a multi-tenant distribution, use a connection group instead' does not state whether specifying them with ConnectionMode tenant-only is rejected.

External conditions not checked: ViewerCertificate.AcmCertificateArn must be an ACM certificate in us-east-1; associated CloudFront functions must be published to the LIVE stage; WebACLId/function/Lambda ARNs must exist; TenantConfig ParameterDefinitions marked required need values in each tenant.

Parameters: a valid parameter value must exist for every parameter marked as required in the multi-tenant distribution (DistributionId); checking this needs the parameter definitions of the AWS::CloudFront::Distribution resource, not this resource's values.

AWS::CloudFront::KeyValueStore.rationale: Checked the resource page, the ImportSource and Tag property pages and 13 schema descriptions. The only conditional wording (omitting Comment during updates clears it) describes update behaviour, and tag lengths, characters and SourceType values are already enforced by the pinned schema.

AWS::CloudFront::MonitoringSubscription.rationale: Checked the resource page, 2 property pages and 6 schema descriptions. No conditional requirement is stated; RealtimeMetricsSubscriptionStatus values and required properties are already enforced by the pinned schema.

open_questions: OriginAccessControlConfig.SigningProtocol: the page and schema description say the only valid value is sigv4, but the pinned schema pattern also allows sigv4a; confirm whether sigv4a is accepted before restricting the value.

OriginAccessControlConfig.SigningBehavior no-override: passing the viewer Authorization header requires adding it to the cache policy of every cache behavior that uses this origin access control; this depends on AWS::CloudFront::CachePolicy and Distribution resources, not on this resource.

CookiesConfig.Cookies, HeadersConfig.Headers and QueryStringsConfig.QueryStrings: the behavior values whitelist, allExcept and allViewerAndWhitelistCloudFront refer to these lists, but the pages do not state that the lists are required for those behaviors (or forbidden for none/all); confirm before registering a rule.
OriginRequestPolicyConfig.Name is described as a unique name; uniqueness against existing origin request policies in the account cannot be decided from this resource.

PublicKeyConfig.EncodedKey: CloudFront supports RSA 2048 or ECDSA 256 keys for signed URLs and cookies, and only RSA 2048 for field-level encryption; the key type is inside the encoded PEM value and the intended use is configured in other resources, so it is not checked by a rule.
ResponseHeadersPolicyConfig.Name must be unique for response headers policies in the account; this needs the existing policies of the account.

CorsConfig.AccessControlAllowMethods.Items: the page lists the valid values GET, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT and ALL, but the pinned schema has no enum and the rule operators cannot check each string item of the array.

The resource page states that this resource is deprecated (CloudFront RTMP distributions were deprecated on December 31, 2020); whether new streaming distributions can still be created is service state, not a property condition.

StreamingDistributionConfig.TrustedSigners is required by the schema, yet the page says to remove the element for public URLs, and TrustedSigners.Enabled is described as true when accounts in the list are configured as trusted signers; the expected relation between Enabled and AwsAccountNumbers is not stated as a requirement.

AWS::CloudFront::TrustStore.rationale: Checked the resource page, 3 property pages and 20 schema descriptions. The only conditional wording describes the behaviour of UseClientCertificateOCSPEndpoint when true, and tag and S3 location constraints are already enforced by the pinned schema.

AWS::CloudFront::VpcOrigin.rationale: Checked the resource page, 2 property pages and 19 schema descriptions. The conditional wording only gives default ports and a non-exhaustive list of OriginSSLProtocols values ("Valid values include"), which is not an explicit single-resource condition beyond the pinned schema.

open_questions: Source: a maximum of one channel is allowed per source, and the value must be Custom or the name of a partner event source; uniqueness across channels and valid partner source names cannot be decided from this resource's values.

Highlights dashboard: to create it, Name must be AWSCloudTrail-Highlights, a refresh schedule must be set and enabled, Frequency Unit must be HOURS and Value must be 6; the dashboard Type is read-only and the page does not say that the name alone selects the Highlights dashboard, so these conditions are not registered as rules.
The page states that CloudTrail Lake is no longer open to new customers from May 31, 2026; whether the account can create dashboards depends on account state.

Query and refresh permissions: CloudTrail must be granted StartQuery on each event data store and StartDashboardRefresh on the dashboard through resource-based policies (AWS::CloudTrail::ResourcePolicy); this depends on other resources.

Widgets QueryParameters: the page lists $StartTime$, $EndTime$ and $Period$ as the valid query parameters, but the pinned schema has no enum and the rule operators cannot check each string item of the array.
The page states that CloudTrail Lake is no longer open to new customers from May 31, 2026; whether the account can create event data stores depends on account state.

FederationRoleArn: the page says it provides the federation role when Lake query federation is enabled and that the role must exist in the account with the required permissions; it does not state that FederationRoleArn is required when FederationEnabled is true, and role existence is external state.

AdvancedEventSelectors FieldSelectors: each selector requires an eventCategory field set with Equals to a category-specific value (Management, Data, NetworkActivity, Insight, ConfigurationItem, Evidence or ActivityAuditLog), data events require resources.type, network activity events require eventSource with Equals only, and only one resources.type field is allowed per selector; these conditions span several field selectors and value arrays and are not expressible with the available operators.
InsightsDestination: the destination must be an event data store that logs Insights events (eventCategory Insight); this depends on the other event data store's configuration.

AWS::CloudTrail::ResourcePolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 properties) and 2 schema descriptions. The only conditional wording explains that CloudFormation accepts the policy in JSON or YAML, and ResourceArn and ResourcePolicy are already required by the pinned schema.

open_questions: EventSelectors DataResources is marked Required: Conditional without an explained condition; the page only limits data resources to 250 per selector and 250 across all selectors of the trail (not when logging all data events), which the available operators cannot count.
AdvancedEventSelectors: a trail allows at most 500 values across all conditions and selectors; this total is not expressible with the available operators.

AdvancedEventSelectors FieldSelectors: each selector requires an eventCategory field set with Equals (Management, Data or NetworkActivity for trails), data events require resources.type, network activity events require eventSource with Equals only, and only one resources.type field is allowed per selector; these conditions span several field selectors and value arrays.
IsOrganizationTrail cannot be true unless the trail is created by the management account of an AWS Organizations organization; this is account state.
S3BucketName, CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn and CloudWatchLogsRoleArn must refer to existing resources in the account with the required policies; existence and permissions are external state.

Period: valid values are 10, 20, 30, 60 and any multiple of 60; the declarative operators cannot test 'multiple of 60', so no rule was registered (MetricStat.Period likewise depends on the metric's storage resolution).
Metrics: exactly one expression must have ReturnData true and all other items false, and each Id must be unique among the items; these cross-item conditions cannot be expressed as rules.
DatapointsToAlarm is the M and EvaluationPeriods the N of an 'M out of N' alarm; the text implies DatapointsToAlarm <= EvaluationPeriods but does not state it as a constraint.
WallClockWindow period values are checked only against the top-level Period; for alarms built from Metrics the period sits in each MetricStat and is not covered.
ExtendedStatistic says 'Specify a value between p0.0 and p100', but CloudWatch also accepts other extended statistics (for example trimmed means); no pattern rule was registered.
The pinned schema requires none of MetricName, Metrics or EvaluationCriteria (PromQL); the text does not state which alarm source must be present, so no rule requires one.
Dimension names must have been included when the metric was published, and tagging on create needs the cloudwatch:TagResource permission; both are external state.
TreatMissingData valid values (breaching, notBreaching, ignore, missing) are given only in prose; the pinned schema has no enum.
Name must be unique within the AWS account and Region; uniqueness depends on existing mute rules (external state).

The page introduction says each mute rule can target up to 100 alarms by name, while MuteTargets.AlarmNames allows up to 500 items in the page and the pinned schema; the effective limit needs confirmation.

Creating the rule needs cloudwatch:PutAlarmMuteRule on the rule and on each targeted alarm (IAM permissions, external state); StartDate/ExpireDate are interpreted in the schedule time zone and no ordering constraint is stated.
MetricMathAnomalyDetector.MetricDataQueries: exactly one item must have ReturnData true (all others false) and Ids must be unique; these cross-item conditions cannot be expressed as rules.

MetricStat.Period must be a multiple of 60 for regular-resolution metrics (1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 60 or multiples of 60 for high-resolution metrics); this depends on the metric's storage resolution (external state).
Dimension value format is registered for Dimensions and SingleMetricAnomalyDetector.Dimensions only; dimensions nested in MetricDataQueries[].MetricStat.Metric are not covered.

The page does not say how the top-level MetricName/Namespace/Stat/Dimensions relate to SingleMetricAnomalyDetector and MetricMathAnomalyDetector (whether they may be combined or one is required); no exclusivity rule was registered.
Configuration.MetricTimeZone must be a tz database name; validity depends on the external tz database and was not registered.
AlarmName must be unique within the AWS account; uniqueness depends on existing alarms (external state).
ActionsSuppressor must name or reference an existing alarm, and AlarmRule functions reference other alarms by name or ARN; alarm existence is external state.
Tagging on create needs the cloudwatch:TagResource permission (IAM, external state).
DashboardName: the page says the name must be between 1 and 255 characters, but the pinned schema has no length limit; this page-only limit is not registered as a rule.
DashboardBody must be JSON following the Dashboard Body Structure and Syntax, which the declarative operators cannot validate.

Tagging a rule needs the cloudwatch:TagResource permission in addition to cloudwatch:PutInsightRule (IAM, external state); the page also limits a rule to 50 tags, which the pinned schema does not enforce.
RuleBody must follow the Contributor Insights rule syntax (JSON), which the declarative operators cannot validate.
AlarmName must be unique within the AWS account and Region; uniqueness depends on existing alarms (external state).

ComparisonOperator: the page and schema description say the valid values are GreaterThanThreshold, GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold, LessThanThreshold and LessThanOrEqualToThreshold, while the page's Allowed values also list the anomaly-band operators and the pinned schema has no enum; no value rule was registered.

Page-only limits not in the pinned schema: QueryResultsToEvaluate 1-100, ScheduledQueryConfiguration.LogGroupIdentifiers 1-50 entries, AggregationExpression minimum 1 character, TreatMissingData values (breaching, notBreaching, ignore, missing).

Creating the alarm needs cloudwatch:PutLogAlarm, and the roles in ScheduledQueryRoleARN and ActionLogLineRoleArn must grant the query and log-retrieval permissions; these are IAM prerequisites (external state).
Name must differ from the names of other metric streams in the account and Region (external state).

FirehoseArn and RoleArn must refer to an existing delivery stream and IAM role in the same account as the metric stream, and the role must allow firehose:PutRecord and firehose:PutRecordBatch; creating the stream also needs iam:PassRole (external state).

OutputFormat valid values (json, opentelemetry1.0, opentelemetry0.7) are given only in prose, and StatisticsConfigurations[].AdditionalStatistics are limited to percentiles for OpenTelemetry formats; the string array items cannot be tested by the declarative operators.
MetricStreamFilter.MetricNames items must be printable ASCII with at least one non-whitespace character; string array items cannot be tested by the declarative operators.
IncludeLinkedAccountsMetrics applies only when the stream is created in a monitoring account (external state).
OTelEnrichment is a singleton: only one resource can exist per AWS account, and resource tags on telemetry must be enabled for the account before creation; both are external state.

EncryptionKey is documented as an optional input ('The key used to encrypt the domain', Required: No) and is createOnly, but the pinned schema also lists /properties/EncryptionKey in readOnlyProperties; whether a design may set it needs confirmation.

EnvironmentType: each environment type (ARM_CONTAINER, ARM_EC2, LINUX_CONTAINER, LINUX_EC2, LINUX_GPU_CONTAINER, MAC_ARM, WINDOWS_EC2, WINDOWS_SERVER_2019_CONTAINER, WINDOWS_SERVER_2022_CONTAINER) is available only in listed Regions; regional availability is external state.
OverflowBehavior ON_DEMAND on a VPC-connected fleet requires the project service role to have the VPC permissions; this IAM prerequisite is external state.
Name must be unique across all projects in the AWS account; uniqueness depends on existing projects (external state).

Source.Location (and SecondarySources[].Location): the page says 'For all of the other types, you must specify Location', which literally includes NO_SOURCE; because NO_SOURCE has no input repository, the registered rule covers only BITBUCKET, CODECOMMIT, GITHUB, GITHUB_ENTERPRISE, GITLAB, GITLAB_SELF_MANAGED and S3.

Source.BuildStatusConfig: the page limits it to GITHUB, GITHUB_ENTERPRISE and BITBUCKET, while ReportBuildStatus also supports GitLab and GitLab Self Managed; whether BuildStatusConfig is used for GITLAB/GITLAB_SELF_MANAGED is unclear, so the WARNING rule covers only CODECOMMIT, CODEPIPELINE, S3 and NO_SOURCE.

Environment.ComputeType ATTRIBUTE_BASED_COMPUTE (and CUSTOM_INSTANCE_TYPE) requires attributes via computeConfiguration, but the pinned Environment schema has no ComputeConfiguration property; how a project supplies these attributes in CloudFormation is unclear.

Environment.ImagePullCredentialsType: cross-account or private registry images require SERVICE_ROLE and CodeBuild curated images require CODEBUILD, and RegistryCredential cannot be used with curated or Amazon ECR images; these depend on the image's provenance (external state) and were not registered.
Triggers.FilterGroups: at least one WebhookFilter in each filter group must have type EVENT; FilterGroups is an array of arrays of untyped JSON that the declarative operators cannot address.

Triggers: the ProjectTriggers page says the webhook feature isn't available in CloudFormation for GitHub Enterprise projects, while ScopeConfiguration.Domain is described for GITHUB_ENTERPRISE; whether Webhook true is rejected for GITHUB_ENTERPRISE sources needs confirmation.

Environment.DockerServer.SecurityGroupIds must allow ingress from the project VPC on port 9876, RegistryCredential.Credential may use a secret name only if it exists in the current Region, and a cross-account EncryptionKey needs service-role permission; all are external state.

The pinned Project schema has no enums or length limits; page-listed allowed values (Source.Type, Artifacts.Type, Environment.Type/ComputeType, Cache.Type, etc.) and limits (Name pattern and length, Description 0-255, TimeoutInMinutes 5-2160, QueuedTimeoutInMinutes 5-480, VpcConfig 5 security groups/16 subnets) are not registered as rules.

ExportConfig.S3Destination is Required: No, and the page does not state that it must be given when ExportConfigType is S3 (or omitted for NO_EXPORT); confirm whether S3 export without S3Destination is rejected.
The pinned schema has no enums for Type or ExportConfigType; the page-listed values (Type, ExportConfigType S3/NO_EXPORT, Packaging ZIP/NONE) are not registered as rules.
Username is described as the Bitbucket username for BASIC_AUTH, but the page does not state that it is required in that case; confirm whether BASIC_AUTH without Username is rejected.

Token must be a connection ARN for AuthType CODECONNECTIONS and a secret ARN for SECRETS_MANAGER, and Secrets Manager secrets must already exist; the referenced connection or secret is external state and no format rule was registered.
RepositoryName must be unique across the calling AWS account; uniqueness depends on existing repositories (external state).

RepositoryName: the page limits names to alphanumeric, dash and underscore characters and says they 'cannot include certain characters' (see CodeCommit quotas), but gives no exact pattern and the pinned schema has none; no character-set rule was registered.

RepositoryTrigger.Branches: the page note says 'you must include the array itself' although the property is marked Required: No and the schema does not require it; whether an omitted Branches array is rejected needs confirmation.
Triggers[].Events: the 'all' exclusivity rule inspects only the first five array positions; lists with duplicated event values beyond that are not checked.
ConnectionName must be unique in the AWS account; uniqueness depends on existing connections (external state) and is not registered as a rule.

ProviderType: the page says 'The valid provider type is GitHub Enterprise Server', while the pinned schema enum also allows Bitbucket, GitHub, GitHubEnterpriseServer, GitLab, GitLabSelfManaged and AzureDevOps; which provider types a host actually accepts is not settled by the text, so no value rule was registered.

AWS::CodeDeploy::Application.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 3 pinned schema descriptions. The only conditional wording describes the generated default ApplicationName and that ApplicationName updates are not supported (update behaviour), so there is no single-resource condition to register.

open_questions: ECSServices: the page says it applies only to deployment groups that use the Amazon ECS compute platform; the compute platform is set on the AWS::CodeDeploy::Application resource, so no rule was registered.

DeploymentStyle/LoadBalancerInfo/ElbInfo/TargetGroupInfo: the pages say CloudFormation supports blue/green deployments on the Lambda compute platform only and that ECS blue/green deployments use the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook instead of this resource; this depends on the application's ComputePlatform (another resource) and was not registered.

BlueGreenDeploymentConfiguration/TerminateBlueInstancesOnDeploymentSuccess: BlueInstanceTerminationOption does not apply to Lambda deployments; this depends on the application's ComputePlatform and was not registered.

DeploymentStyle/DeploymentOption: the page notes that an Application Load Balancer or Network Load Balancer is required for an Amazon ECS deployment; this depends on the application's ComputePlatform and the load balancer type, so no rule was registered.

LoadBalancerInfo/TargetGroupInfoList is Required: Conditional; the page says to use it for Application and Network Load Balancers and ElbInfoList for Classic Load Balancers, which depends on the type of the referenced load balancer (external state).

Deployment/Revision/RevisionType: GitHub is documented for EC2/On-premises deployments only and String for AWS Lambda deployments only (compute platform of another resource); the pages also do not state which of S3Location/GitHubLocation each RevisionType requires, so no rule was registered.
LoadBalancerInfo TargetGroupInfo Name: the page says not to use the target group ARN or TargetGroupFullName; only the 32-character limit was registered.
LoadBalancerInfo/TargetGroupPairInfoList/*/TargetGroups: the page describes it as 'One pair of target groups' without stating an exact item count; no cardinality rule was registered.
AgentPermissions/Principals: the page says wildcards are not supported in the principal ARNs; the declarative operators cannot test each string item of the array, so no rule was registered.

ConfigurationProperties: an action can have up to one queryable property; counting items with Queryable true across the array cannot be expressed with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.
Settings URL templates may refer to a configuration property as {Config:name} only when that property is both required and not secret; this cross-property string reference was not registered.

The pages list Category allowed values (Source | Build | Deploy | Test | Invoke | Approval | Compute), Provider/Version patterns and lengths, ArtifactDetails MinimumCount/MaximumCount 0-5 and at most 10 ConfigurationProperties, none of which the pinned schema enforces; these page-listed limits were not registered.

ArtifactStores: a cross-region action requires ArtifactStores with an artifact store for the pipeline Region and for each cross-region action Region; the pipeline Region is the stack Region, not a property value, so no rule was registered.
ArtifactStore Location: the S3 bucket must be in the same AWS Region as the pipeline; this needs the bucket's Region (external state) and was not registered.

Stages: output artifact names must be unique within the pipeline and each input artifact must exactly match an output artifact of a preceding action; these cross-stage conditions cannot be expressed with the declarative operators.

Triggers: the trigger configuration is only supported for the CodeStarSourceConnection action type, i.e. GitConfiguration SourceActionName should name a CodeStarSourceConnection source action of the pipeline; this cross-item reference was not registered.

Variables: the resource page says variable names can have alphanumeric and underscore characters and values must match [A-Za-z0-9@\-_]+, while the VariableDeclaration page lists Name pattern [A-Za-z0-9@\-_]+ and DefaultValue pattern .*; the statements conflict, so no rule was registered.
Stages Actions InputArtifacts: for a CodeBuild action with multiple input artifacts one input source must be designated PrimarySource in the free-form Configuration; not registered.
ArtifactStore EncryptionKey Id: for cross-account actions only the key ID or key ARN (not an alias) can be used; this depends on the accounts of the action roles and was not registered.
TargetAction: the action must be from the source (first) stage of the target pipeline; this needs the AWS::CodePipeline::Pipeline values and was not registered.
TargetPipelineVersion: the page marks it Required: Yes but the pinned schema does not list it as required; the discrepancy was not registered as a rule.

Code: the resource intro says 'You must provide a location for the source code ZIP file in the CloudFormation template', but the Code property is documented as Required: No; whether Code is mandatory at creation is unclear, so no rule was registered.

RepositoryAccessToken/ConnectionArn: the intro says a GitHub personal access token must be provided, but ConnectionArn (no description) appears to be an alternative; whether exactly one of RepositoryAccessToken or ConnectionArn is required is not stated, so no rule was registered.
ConnectionName: connection names must be unique in an AWS account; this needs account state and was not registered.
ProviderType/HostArn: the schema says 'You must specify either a ProviderType or a HostArn' but does not say whether specifying both is rejected; only the at-least-one condition was registered.
ProviderType: the page lists Bitbucket | GitHub | GitHubEnterpriseServer | GitLab | GitLabSelfManaged as allowed values but the pinned schema has no enum; the list was not registered as a rule.

AWS::CodeStarConnections::SyncConfigurat.rationale: Checked the resource page (no property pages) and 11 pinned schema descriptions. The only conditional wording is the TriggerResourceUpdateOn description ('When to trigger Git sync'), whose values are already enforced by the schema enum.

open_questions: Tags: the page says tag key names cannot start with "aws"; Tags is a string map and the declarative operators cannot test map keys, so no rule was registered.
Name: notification rule names must be unique in the AWS account; this needs account state and was not registered.

Targets/*/TargetType: the page lists SNS, AWSChatbotSlack and AWSChatbotMicrosoftTeams as the target types while the pinned schema only enforces the pattern ^[A-Za-z]+$; the value list was not registered as a rule.

DeveloperProviderName: the page says only letters, periods, underscores and dashes can be used, with length 1-100, but the pinned schema has no pattern or length; whether digits are allowed is unclear, so no rule was registered.

CognitoStreams: the stream must be in the developer's account and in the same Region as the identity pool, and RoleArn must grant cognito-sync PutRecord on the stream; these need external state and were not registered.

AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag.rationale: Checked the resource page (4 properties) and the pinned schema, which has no property descriptions. The only conditional wording explains how principal tag values are taken from user claims and that UseDefaults applies default mappings instead of a custom map, which is behaviour rather than a checkable requirement.

open_questions: RoleMappings: AmbiguousRoleResolution is required when Type is Token or Rules, RulesConfiguration is required when Type is Rules, MappingRule MatchType must be Equals, Contains, StartsWith or NotEqual, and at most 25 rules are allowed per identity provider; RoleMappings is a map keyed by identity provider and the declarative scope cannot iterate map values, so no rules were registered.
Roles: map keys must be authenticated or unauthenticated; map keys cannot be checked with the declarative operators.
CloudWatchLogsConfiguration LogGroupArn: the log group must not be encrypted with AWS KMS and must be in the same AWS account as the user pool; this needs external state and was not registered.
EventSource userAuthEvents is for user pools with the Plus feature plan; the tier is set on the AWS::Cognito::UserPool resource, so no rule was registered.

Settings/Assets: the operation has a 2-megabyte request-size limit covering the CSS settings and image assets; the serialized size cannot be checked with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.

TermsName: Amazon Cognito displays terms documents only after both types (terms-of-use and privacy-policy) are provided in at least one language, each in a separate request; this needs a second AWS::Cognito::Terms resource and was not registered.

EnabledMfas/MfaConfiguration: the page says MFAs can only be all disabled if MfaConfiguration is OFF and describes removing EnabledMfas after MFA was enabled (update behaviour); whether MfaConfiguration ON or OPTIONAL requires a non-empty EnabledMfas at creation is not stated, so no rule was registered.
LambdaConfig PreTokenGeneration and PreTokenGenerationConfig LambdaArn must be identical when both are set; equality between two property values cannot be expressed with the declarative operators.

VerificationMessageTemplate: the page also says to specify EmailMessageByLink for CONFIRM_WITH_LINK and EmailMessage for CONFIRM_WITH_CODE; Amazon Cognito applies default messages when they are omitted, so only the 'leave blank' and 'not both' conditions were registered.
AdminCreateUserConfig InviteMessageTemplate must include the {####} temporary password placeholder if users are created with passwords; this depends on how users are created and was not registered.

WebAuthnRelyingPartyID must be the fully-qualified custom domain when the user pool uses passkeys, has a custom domain and uses managed login or the classic hosted UI; this depends on AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain and was not registered.
Schema: any attribute mapped from an IdP attribute must be mutable; the mappings are on AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider, so no rule was registered.

SmsConfiguration SnsRegion (user pools in Asia Pacific (Seoul) must use the Tokyo Region) and EmailConfiguration SourceArn Region support depend on the deployment Region and SES setup (external state); not registered.

UserPoolAddOns/Policies SignInPolicy/WebAuthnFactorConfiguration tier rules: UserPoolTier defaults to ESSENTIALS; the Plus-tier rule reports an unspecified UserPoolTier as NEEDS_REVIEW rather than FAIL.
DefaultRedirectURI must be in the CallbackURLs list; membership of one property value in another property's list cannot be expressed with the declarative operators.

CallbackURLs: each redirect URI must be absolute, must not include a fragment, and must use HTTPS except http://localhost, http://127.0.0.1 and http://[::1]; per-item string checks cannot be expressed, so no rule was registered.
ExplicitAuthFlows ALLOW_USER_AUTH requires the user pool to be in the Essentials tier or higher; the tier is on AWS::Cognito::UserPool, so no rule was registered.

Token validity: AccessTokenValidity and IdTokenValidity can range from five minutes to one day and RefreshTokenValidity from 60 minutes to 10 years depending on TokenValidityUnits; the unit-dependent ranges were not registered.
WriteAttributes must include all attributes mapped to IdP attributes when the client allows IdP sign-in; the mappings are on AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider, so no rule was registered.
AnalyticsConfiguration: Amazon Pinpoint is not available in all Regions (external state); not registered.

Domain: for custom domains it is the fully-qualified domain name and for prefix domains the prefix alone; the page lists the prefix pattern ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ which the pinned schema lacks, and the pages do not state that a custom domain requires CustomDomainConfig, so no rule was registered.
GroupName must be unique in the user pool; this depends on other AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup resources and was not registered.

ProviderDetails: the required keys depend on ProviderType and social IdP authorize_scopes values must match the documented list, but the page says the values and their schema are subject to change and the reviewed text only shows the OIDC example; no per-type key rules were registered.
ProviderType: the page lists SAML | Facebook | Google | LoginWithAmazon | SignInWithApple | OIDC, but the pinned schema has no enum; the list was not registered.
AttributeMapping: mapped user pool attributes must be mutable on the user pool and writable by app clients; these are values of other resources and were not registered.

The resource must be created in the secondary (replica) Region, the user pool must have a replica in that Region, and the replica must be ACTIVE or INACTIVE before creation; this depends on AWS::Cognito::UserPoolReplica and the deployment Region and was not registered.

EmailConfiguration, LambdaConfig and SmsConfiguration sub-properties have no descriptions on the property pages; conditions that apply to the same settings on AWS::Cognito::UserPool were not assumed here.

AWS::Cognito::UserPoolReplica.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 properties) and the pinned schema, which has no property descriptions. The conditional wording covers IAM permissions needed to create the replica and that UserPoolTagsAtCreate cannot be modified after creation (update behaviour), neither of which is a single-resource property condition.

AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer.rationale: Checked the resource page, the ResourceServerScopeType property page and the pinned schema (no descriptions). The text only describes identifier and scope formats in tokens and the default-value note; the page-listed patterns and lengths are not textual conditions, so there is nothing further to register.

open_questions: RiskExceptionConfiguration BlockedIPRangeList/SkippedIPRangeList are set in CIDR notation; per-item string checks cannot be expressed, so no rule was registered.
NotifyConfiguration From must be an address individually verified in Amazon SES or from an SES-verified domain; this needs external state and was not registered.

AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUICustomizationAtt.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 properties) and the pinned schema (no descriptions). The only conditional wording describes that a customization without a client applies to all app clients (behaviour), so there is no single-resource condition to register.

open_questions: UserAttributes: email is required if email_verified is True or EMAIL is in DesiredDeliveryMediums, and phone_number is required if phone_number_verified is True or SMS is in DesiredDeliveryMediums (the default is SMS); checking for an array item with a given Name cannot be expressed with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.
ForceAliasCreation is used only if the phone_number_verified or email_verified attribute is True and is otherwise ignored; this needs a check of UserAttributes items and was not registered.

Username must not duplicate another username in the user pool and can be provided only if usernames are a valid sign-in attribute of the user pool; these depend on other resources and were not registered.
UserAttributes: custom attribute names must have the custom: prefix and attributes required by the user pool must be supplied; this depends on the user pool schema and was not registered.

AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUserToGroupAttachm.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 properties) and the pinned schema (no descriptions). The only conditional wording is the note that the API must be authorized with IAM credentials, which is not a property condition; the page-listed patterns are not textual conditions.

open_questions: InputDataConfig.Documents.TestS3Uri: the page says it is not required if you do not specify a test CSV file; confirm whether it is required when InputDataConfig.TestS3Uri is given for a native (SEMI_STRUCTURED_DOCUMENT) model.
VersionName must be unique among all models with the same classifier name in the account and Region; this needs external state and cannot be checked from one resource.

InputDataConfig.S3Uri, InputDataConfig.TestS3Uri and OutputDataConfig.S3Uri must point to buckets in the same Region as the Comprehend API endpoint; this depends on the bucket's Region (external state).

The page says a flywheel either uses an existing trained model (ActiveModelArn) or trains a new model from a provided dataset, but does not state which properties (ModelType, TaskConfig) are required when ActiveModelArn is omitted; confirm the requirement.

TaskConfig.DocumentClassificationConfig and TaskConfig.EntityRecognitionConfig are described as 'Configuration required for' a document classification or entity recognition model; confirm whether they are required when ModelType is DOCUMENT_CLASSIFIER or ENTITY_RECOGNIZER respectively and whether they are mutually exclusive.

Schedule.ScheduleExpression: the page says rules run at most once per day and the cron expression must use specific values (not wildcards) for the minutes and hours fields, but the accepted expression syntax is unclear (the page describes six cron fields and shows a five-field example, while the schema description mentions cron or rate expressions); confirm the syntax before registering a pattern rule.

Criteria: the page allows up to 20 conditions per filter criteria and 20 values per condition, which the pinned schema does not enforce; confirm whether 'filter criteria' means each Criteria array (e.g. Region, ResourceTag) so the limits can be checked.
OrganizationConfiguration is described as configuration for organization rules; confirm whether it is only valid (or required) when RuleType is OrganizationRule.

Organization-level rules can only be created by the management account or delegated administrator (schema description); this depends on the deploying account and cannot be checked from resource properties.

Source.SourceDetails: when Source.Owner is CUSTOM_POLICY, the only acceptable MessageType values are ConfigurationItemChangeNotification and OversizedConfigurationItemChangeNotification; the per-item check depends on the parent Owner and cannot be expressed with the current scoped operators.

MaximumExecutionFrequency (top level) may be specified only for an AWS managed rule triggered at a periodic frequency or a custom rule triggered by configuration snapshot delivery; whether a managed rule is periodic depends on the managed rule definition (external).
EvaluationModes: the page says the valid values are distinct objects, but the pinned schema does not set uniqueItems; confirm whether duplicate Mode entries are rejected.

The pinned schema has no enum for Source.Owner, SourceDetails.EventSource, SourceDetails.MessageType, MaximumExecutionFrequency and EvaluationModes.Mode although the pages list allowed values; confirm whether these should be enforced.
The configuration recorder must be created and started before AWS Config managed rules can be created; this depends on another resource and account state.
The pages do not say whether AccountAggregationSources and OrganizationAggregationSource are mutually exclusive or whether one of them is required; confirm before registering a rule.
The pages do not say whether AllAwsRegions and AwsRegions may both be specified in AccountAggregationSources or OrganizationAggregationSource; confirm.
AccountAggregationSources is listed with Maximum: 1 on the page, but the pinned schema has no maxItems; confirm whether more than one account aggregation source is rejected.

RecordingMode: DAILY recording cannot be specified for AWS::Config::ResourceCompliance, AWS::Config::ConformancePackCompliance and AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder (in RecordingModeOverrides.ResourceTypes, and for included resource types when RecordingFrequency is DAILY); an array-contains check tied to a sibling value is not expressible with the current operators.

RecordingGroup.IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: global IAM resource types can only be recorded in Regions where AWS Config was available before February 2022; this depends on the deployment Region (external).

The pages do not state whether one of TemplateBody, TemplateS3Uri or TemplateSSMDocumentDetails is required, or whether TemplateSSMDocumentDetails may be combined with TemplateBody or TemplateS3Uri; confirm.

TemplateS3Uri must point to a template of at most 300 KB and TemplateBody may only contain AWS::Config::ConfigRule and AWS::Config::RemediationConfiguration resources; these concern template content and S3 object state (external).
S3KmsKeyArn must belong to the same Region as the destination S3 bucket; this depends on the bucket's Region (external).
A configuration recorder must exist before the delivery channel is created, and only one delivery channel is allowed per Region per account; these depend on other resources and account state.

S3BucketName must not be a bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled, and a bucket or SNS topic in another account needs policies granting AWS Config access; these depend on external bucket and topic configuration.

The pages do not state that exactly one of OrganizationManagedRuleMetadata, OrganizationCustomRuleMetadata and OrganizationCustomPolicyRuleMetadata must be specified; confirm before registering an exclusivity rule.

OrganizationCustomPolicyRuleMetadata.OrganizationConfigRuleTriggerTypes: Custom Policy rules support only the change-initiated types ConfigurationItemChangeNotification and OversizedConfigurationItemChangeNotification; confirm whether ScheduledNotification is rejected (per-item check on a string array is not expressible with the current operators).

Only a management account or a delegated administrator can create an organization Config rule, and a Custom Lambda rule needs a Lambda function in that account; these depend on account state (external).

The pages do not state whether TemplateBody or TemplateS3Uri is required or whether they are mutually exclusive (the ConformancePack schema says only one may be specified); confirm for the organization conformance pack.
TemplateS3Uri must point to a conformance pack template of at most 300 KB; this depends on the S3 object (external).

AWS::Config::RemediationConfiguration.rationale: Checked the resource page and the ExecutionControls and SsmControls property pages; the conditional wording only describes defaults (MaximumAutomaticAttempts 5, RetryAttemptSeconds 60, ErrorPercentage 50%) and remediation behaviour, and the page-listed ranges are value limits rather than single-resource conditions.

AWS::Connect::ApprovedOrigin.rationale: Checked the resource page and the 2 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties.

AWS::Connect::ContactFlowModuleAlias.rationale: Checked the resource page and the 6 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties and types.

AWS::Connect::ContactFlowModuleVersion.rationale: Checked the resource page and the 5 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties.

AWS::Connect::DataLakeAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page and 5 schema descriptions; 'only one dataset in a single resource' is inherent in the single DataSetId string and TargetAccountId only documents a default, so no rule applies.

open_questions: Name must be unique within the Amazon Connect instance; uniqueness depends on other resources and is not checked.

Validation.Minimum says it 'Cannot be provided when ExclusiveMinimum is also provided', while Validation.ExclusiveMinimum says it 'Can be provided alongside Minimum where both operate independently'; the texts conflict, so no mutual-exclusion rule is registered.

Validation length/number/list settings are documented as applying to specific ValueType values (TEXT, NUMBER, list types); whether specifying them for another ValueType is rejected or ignored is not stated.
Name must be unique within the data table; uniqueness depends on other resources and is not checked.
Primary attributes must have unique value combinations and cannot contain expressions; this concerns record values (DataTableRecord), not this resource's properties.

AWS::Connect::DataTableRecord.rationale: Checked the resource page, the value/record property pages and 10 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties.

open_questions: Items: the total number of sections and questions must not exceed 100 each; counting across nested items is not expressible with the current operators.

Section and question RefId values must be unique within the evaluation form, and answer option RefId values unique within the question; uniqueness across array items is not expressible with the current operators.

EvaluationFormQuestionTypeProperties says the properties 'must be either for a numeric question or a single select question', but the schema also defines Text and MultiSelect; confirm whether exactly one of the question type properties must be set and whether it must match QuestionType.

RecurrencePattern.ByMonth is described as 'Used with YEARLY frequency' and ByMonthDay as 'Used with MONTHLY or YEARLY frequency'; whether other Frequency values are rejected is not stated, so no rule is registered.
DirectoryId is not documented as required when IdentityManagementType is EXISTING_DIRECTORY; confirm before registering a rule.
Amazon Connect limits the number of instances that can be created or deleted in 30 days (account quota; not checked).
EncryptionConfig.KeyId: only KMS keys with the default key spec SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT are supported; the key spec is external state and is not checked.

The pages do not state which configuration property (S3Config, KinesisVideoStreamConfig, KinesisStreamConfig, KinesisFirehoseConfig) must accompany each StorageType, or which StorageType each ResourceType accepts; confirm before registering rules.

AWS::Connect::IntegrationAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page and 8 schema descriptions; the intro only lists supported integration kinds already covered by the IntegrationType enum and the tag key pattern already excludes aws:.

AWS::Connect::PredefinedAttribute.rationale: Checked the resource page, its property pages and 12 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording describes behaviour of AttributeConfiguration, not a constraint.

open_questions: QueueConfig.ContactFlowArn must reference a flow of type Transfer to Queue and UserConfig.ContactFlowArn a flow of type Transfer to Agent; the flow type belongs to another resource and is not checked.

TaskAction.References says 'URL is the only accepted type', while Reference.Type allows URL, ATTACHMENT, NUMBER, STRING, DATE and EMAIL; confirm whether task action references are limited to URL before registering a rule.
Reference.Type DATE values must be Epoch timestamps (value format of the Value field; not checked).
Only two security keys are allowed per Amazon Connect instance; this counts other resources and is not checked.
Fields: 'A template requires at least one field that has type Name'; requiring at least one array item with a given Type is not expressible with the current operators.
ContactFlowArn 'is not required when there is a field with fieldType = QUICK_CONNECT'; the page does not state that ContactFlowArn is required otherwise, and the condition depends on array contents.
InitializationData must be a valid JSON string; JSON validity is not checked by the rule operators.
Password is required when the instance uses Amazon Connect for identity management and must not be included otherwise; the identity management type belongs to the AWS::Connect::Instance resource.

IdentityInfo.FirstName and LastName are required when the instance uses Amazon Connect or SAML identity management, and IdentityInfo.Email returns an error with SAML; these depend on the instance's IdentityManagementType.
UserProficiencies AttributeName and AttributeValue must be predefined attributes present in the instance (external state).

AWS::Connect::UserHierarchyStructure.rationale: Checked the resource page, the level property pages and 11 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties.

AWS::Connect::ViewVersion.rationale: Checked the resource page and 5 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties.

AWS::Connect::Vocabulary.rationale: Checked the resource page and 11 schema descriptions; LanguageCode is enforced by its enum, Content format and name uniqueness are descriptive, and the tag descriptions carry no aws: restriction.

open_questions: ChannelSubtypeConfig.Telephony.DefaultOutboundConfig.ConnectSourcePhoneNumber: the schema says 'If you do not specify a source phone number, you must specify a queue', but it does not name the queue property (presumably Telephony.ConnectQueueId) or say whether this applies to every OutboundMode (for example AgentlessConfig); confirm before registering a rule.
The page notes that users can view or edit the campaign in the Amazon Connect console only if the instance ID is added as a tag (owner = instance ARN); decide whether designs must carry that tag.
Source cannot be added or removed after the campaign is created (update-time restriction; not checked).

ControlIdentifier: only Strongly recommended and Elective controls are permitted, except the Region deny control; this depends on the AWS Control Tower control catalog and cannot be decided from property values.
Conditions.Range.TimestampFormat 'should be one of EPOCHMILLI or ISO_8601', but the pinned schema has no enum; confirm whether other values are rejected before registering a rule.
ConflictResolution.SourceName is described as the ObjectType name used 'when choosing SOURCE as the ConflictResolvingModel'; the page does not say it is required for SOURCE or ignored for RECENCY.

AttributeTypesSelector: only the Address, EmailAddress and PhoneNumber types can be used in MatchingRules; the relation between the selector lists and the rule attributes is not expressible with the current operators.
DeadLetterQueueUrl requires an SQS queue policy allowing SendMessage for Customer Profiles (external state).
The pages do not state which of Uri and FlowDefinition must be specified, or whether ObjectTypeName or ObjectTypeNames is required; confirm before registering rules.
FlowDefinition.SourceFlowConfig: the page does not state that the SourceConnectorProperties member must match ConnectorType (for example S3 with ConnectorType S3).

SourceFlowConfig.ConnectorProfileName must be unique for each connector profile in the account and ScheduledTriggerProperties.ScheduleStartTime must be an EPOCH date/time (external state / value format).

Keys[].ObjectTypeKeyList[].StandardIdentifiers: each ProfileObject can have only one UNIQUE key but multiple PROFILE keys; counting UNIQUE across array items is not expressible with the current operators.

AWS::CustomerProfiles::Recommender.rationale: Checked the resource page, its property pages and 22 schema descriptions; the conditional wording (EventValueThreshold, FailureReason, timestamps) describes service behaviour or read-only values, not constraints.

open_questions: SegmentSqlQuery and SegmentSort have no description ('Property description not available'); whether SegmentGroups and SegmentSqlQuery are alternatives or can be combined is not documented.

AvailabilityZones: 'If provided, the length of this list must equal the ReplicationFactor parameter'; comparing an array length with another property is not expressible with the declarative operators, so this must be checked manually.

ReplicationFactor: the page describes 1 (single node) and 'a number between 3 ... and 10' for multi-node clusters, but does not state whether 2 or values above 10 are rejected; the pinned schema has no minimum or maximum.
NotificationTopicARN: the Amazon SNS topic owner must be the same as the DAX cluster owner (depends on the topic's account).
SubnetGroupName: DAX clusters run only in a VPC and all subnets of the subnet group must exist in the same VPC (depends on the subnet group resource).

ParameterNameValues: 'record-ttl-millis and query-ttl-millis are the only supported parameter names'; the property is a JSON object and restricting its key names is not expressible with the declarative operators, so the parameter names must be checked manually.

AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page (Description, SubnetGroupName, SubnetIds) and the pinned schema; the page states no conditions beyond SubnetIds being required, which the schema already enforces.

open_questions: Description, ExecutionRoleArn, State and PolicyDetails are 'Required: Conditional' and the page intro says 'The properties are required when you add a lifecycle policy and optional when you update a lifecycle policy' without naming which properties; the creation-time requirement is not registered.

Many properties are labelled [Default policies only], [Custom snapshot and AMI policies only], [Custom snapshot policies only], [Custom AMI policies only] or [Event-based policies only]; how a design identifies the policy kind (DefaultPolicy, PolicyLanguage SIMPLIFIED/STANDARD, PolicyType, ResourceTypes) is not stated precisely, so these scoping restrictions are not registered.

For a default policy the parameters may be given 'either in the request body, or in the PolicyDetails request structure, but not both'; the exact parameter set is not enumerated, so this is not registered.

Page-listed ranges and allowed values missing from the pinned schema are not registered: CreateInterval 1-7 days, RetainInterval 2-14 days, State/PolicyType/PolicyLanguage/Location/IntervalUnit/EventSource.Type/EventType enums, CrossRegionCopyTargets and CrossRegionCopyRules up to 3, Schedules up to 4, Actions/ResourceTypes/ResourceLocations exactly 1, retention/deprecation counts up to 1000, and the Description pattern.

ArchiveRule requires a schedule creation frequency of at least 28 days, and archived snapshots must stay in the archive tier for at least 90 days (RetentionArchiveTier Count/Interval); both need the frequency derived from CronExpression or Interval/IntervalUnit and are not registered.

DeprecateRule Interval must be less than or equal to the schedule's retention period, and CrossRegionCopyDeprecateRule Interval less than or equal to the cross-Region copy retention period; these need unit conversion between IntervalUnit values and are not registered. Whether count-based/age-based archive and deprecation rules must match the schedule's RetainRule kind is also not registered.

CreateRule intro requires 'Interval, IntervalUnit, and Times' for interval schedules, but the Times description says DLM selects a time when Times is omitted; only CronExpression-or-Interval and Interval-needs-IntervalUnit are registered.

VariableTags is labelled '[AMI policies and snapshot policies that target instances only]' but the text says variable tags are only valid for EBS Snapshot Management - Instance policies; the conflicting scope is not registered.
CreateRule Location for Local Zone or Outpost targets may be the same Local Zone/Outpost or the parent Region (permissive wording); only the Region-to-CLOUD requirement is registered.
Script ExecutionHandler must name an SSM document the account owns or that is shared with it (external state).

Description: the page says descriptions can have up to 31 characters and contain only ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, but it also lists a maximum of 255 and the pinned schema allows 255 characters; the text looks copied from an identifier constraint, so it is not registered until confirmed.

OracleSettings.SecretsManagerOracleAsmAccessRoleArn and SecretsManagerOracleAsmSecretId are required only if the Oracle database uses Automatic Storage Management (ASM); ASM usage is external to the resource.
The page does not state that the Settings member must correspond to Engine; not registered.
KinesisSettings.ServiceAccessRoleArn is 'Required: Conditional' but the condition is not stated.
S3Settings.ServiceAccessRoleArn is described as 'A required parameter' but is listed as Required: No; confirm whether it is required for every S3 endpoint.
S3Settings.CdcPath is required for an S3 source when a task captures change data; this depends on the replication task, not on the endpoint.
RedshiftSettings.ExplicitIds is only valid for a full-load migration task (depends on the replication task).
PostgreSqlSettings.MapBooleanAsBoolean and RedshiftSettings.MapBooleanAsBoolean must be set on both the source and target endpoints to take effect (depends on another endpoint).

DatabaseName: 'For a MySQL source or target endpoint, don't specify DatabaseName' conflicts with using it together with MySqlSettings.TargetDbType SPECIFIC_DATABASE, and the set of MySQL engine names is not listed; not registered.
RedshiftSettings.AcceptAnyDate: 'Always use ACCEPTANYDATE with the DATEFORMAT parameter' does not say whether DateFormat must be specified explicitly; not registered.

EndpointType, EngineName, SslMode and several settings values (for example Kafka SecurityProtocol, Redis AuthType, S3 EncryptionMode) have page value lists that the pinned schema lacks; values are not validated by the schema.
The roles given in the ServiceAccessRoleArn and SecretsManagerAccessRoleArn settings must allow iam:PassRole (IAM policy, external state).
SourceIds: if multiple values are specified they must be of the same type (for example all replication instance IDs); the identifier type depends on the referenced resources.
SourceType: the page lists replication-instance | replication-task, but the pinned schema has no enum.

Description: the page says descriptions can have up to 31 characters and contain only ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, but also lists a maximum of 255 and the pinned schema allows 255 characters; not registered until confirmed.
VpcSecurityGroups: the security groups must work with the VPC containing the instance profile (depends on other resources).
TransformationRules: homogeneous data migrations do not support transformation rules; whether the migration is homogeneous depends on the source and target data providers (other resources).
ComputeConfig.MaxCapacityUnits and MinCapacityUnits: the page lists valid DCU values 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 192, 256 and 384, but the pinned schema has no enum or range.
ComputeConfig.PreferredMaintenanceWindow: minimum 30-minute window is not expressible with the operators.
ComputeConfig.VpcSecurityGroupIds: the security group must work with the VPC containing the replication (depends on other resources).
AllowMajorVersionUpgrade must be true when EngineVersion is a different major version than the instance's current version (update-time, depends on the current state).
PreferredMaintenanceWindow: minimum 30-minute window is not expressible with the operators.
VpcSecurityGroupIds: the security group must work with the VPC containing the replication instance (depends on other resources).
NetworkType: IPv6-only is not supported, but the page gives no value list and the pinned schema has no enum.
The subnets must be in two different Availability Zones in the same Region (depends on the subnet resources).
Resource creation fails if the dms-vpc-role IAM role does not already exist (account state).

MultiRegionProperties.WitnessRegion: the page states the witness Region cannot be the same as the cluster's Region; the cluster Region is the deployment Region, not a property value, so this must be checked against the target Region of the design.
DatetimeOptions.TimezoneOffset 'Shouldn't be used if Format for this parameter includes timezone fields'; detecting timezone fields in a datetime format string is not reliably expressible.
Input.Metadata.SourceArn: DataBrew currently supports only ARNs from Amazon AppFlow (service support; not registered as a rule).

The pages do not state which of DatasetName, ProjectName and Recipe, or which output property (Outputs, DataCatalogOutputs, DatabaseOutputs, OutputLocation), is required for each job Type; confirm before registering rules.
ProfileConfiguration and ValidationConfigurations are described for profile jobs; whether they are rejected or ignored for RECIPE jobs is not stated.
ValidationConfigurations[].RulesetArn: the ruleset's TargetArn should be the ARN of the dataset associated with the job (depends on another resource).

AWS::DataBrew::Recipe.rationale: Checked the resource page, the recipe step, action, condition and parameter pages and 15 schema descriptions; the conditional wording describes step behaviour, and input choices are enforced by the schema oneOf.

open_questions: Rules[].CheckExpression: if it starts with a column reference, ColumnSelectors should be null, and with ColumnSelectors there should be no column reference on the left side of a condition; column references are only distinguishable through SubstitutionMap values in backticks, so no rule is registered.

AWS::DataBrew::Schedule.rationale: Checked the resource page and 4 schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the schema's required properties.

The resource page lists PutPipelineDefinition validation errors (an object missing a name or identifier field, an empty string or reference field, too many objects, a pipeline in FINISHED state); the empty-field condition conflicts with the StringValue page minimum of 0 and the object-count limit is a service quota, so they are left for review.
AWS Data Pipeline is no longer available to new customers; whether a new pipeline can be created depends on the account.

AzureBlobSasConfiguration and FederatedIdentity: the pages do not state whether they are required when AzureBlobAuthenticationType is SAS or OIDC (FederatedIdentity has no description), so the credential property needed for each authentication type must be confirmed.
AzureAccessTier only applies when the location is used as a transfer destination, which depends on the AWS::DataSync::Task that uses the location.
Ec2Config SubnetArn must be in the same VPC as the Amazon EFS file system and in the same Availability Zone as at least one of its mount targets (depends on the subnet and file system resources).

AWS::DataSync::LocationFSxLustre.rationale: Checked the resource page and tag page (FsxFilesystemArn, SecurityGroupArns, Subdirectory, Tags) and the pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording describes default and source/destination behaviour of Subdirectory, and required/pattern/length limits are already in the schema.

open_questions: Protocol NFS MountOptions Version: the page notes 'DataSync currently only supports NFS version 3 with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP locations' while the schema allows AUTOMATIC, NFS4_0 and NFS4_1 (AUTOMATIC chooses 4.1); whether values other than NFS3 are rejected is unclear.

SecurityGroupArns must allow outbound NFS (TCP 111, 635, 2049) or SMB (TCP 445) traffic and the file system security groups must allow the same inbound ports (depends on the security group resources).
Protocol SMB User must be a member of the AWS Delegated FSx Administrators group or the Domain Admins/custom administration group (depends on the directory).

KerberosKeytab: the page says it is required if KERBEROS is specified, but CmkSecretConfig/CustomSecretConfig can also carry a Kerberos keytab; whether KerberosKeytab may be omitted when CustomSecretConfig holds the keytab must be confirmed.
BlockSize must be a multiple of 512 bytes; divisibility is not expressible with the declarative operators, so it must be checked manually.
NameNodes: Basic mode tasks accept only one NameNode while Enhanced mode accepts several; the mode is set on the AWS::DataSync::Task that uses the location.

AWS::DataSync::LocationNFS.rationale: Checked the resource page, MountOptions and OnPremConfig pages and the pinned schema descriptions; the conditional wording covers the AUTOMATIC default, server behaviour when a version is refused, and an NFS 3 note that concerns FSx for ONTAP locations, and enums/required items are already in the schema.

open_questions: Subdirectory: 'DataSync can't transfer objects with a prefix that begins with a slash (/) or includes //, /./, or /../ patterns'; it is unclear whether this rejects such a Subdirectory value at creation or only affects transfers, so a prefix starting with / or containing //, /./ or /../ must be reviewed.
S3StorageClass only takes effect when the location is used as a task destination, which depends on the AWS::DataSync::Task.

AuthenticationType, KerberosPrincipal, KerberosKeytab and KerberosKrb5Conf have no description on the page; whether the Kerberos properties are required when AuthenticationType is KERBEROS, and which AuthenticationType applies when it is omitted, must be confirmed (the NTLM-only and KERBEROS-only rules do not fire when AuthenticationType is omitted).
KerberosPrincipal must match exactly the SPN in the keytab and krb5.conf files; the file contents cannot be checked from the design values.
Options PosixPermissions should be set only for NFS, Amazon EFS and Amazon S3 locations; this depends on the location resources referenced by SourceLocationArn and DestinationLocationArn.
Options PreserveDevices PRESERVE is not supported for Amazon EFS locations (depends on the referenced location types).
Options SecurityDescriptorCopyFlags is only used for transfers between SMB and FSx for Windows File Server locations (depends on the referenced location types).

Options VerifyMode POINT_IN_TIME_CONSISTENT is not supported when transferring to S3 Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage classes (depends on the destination AWS::DataSync::LocationS3 S3StorageClass).
TaskReportConfig ObjectVersionIds only applies if versioning is enabled on the destination bucket (external bucket setting).
TaskReportConfig Overrides Verified only applies if the task verifies data; whether VerifyMode NONE (which still checksums during transfer) disables it is unclear.
Schedule runs at a minimum interval of 1 hour; checking the cron or rate ScheduleExpression interval is not expressible with the declarative operators.

ProjectIdentifier: the pinned schema description is truncated after 'If', and neither the page nor the schema states whether ProjectIdentifier or EnvironmentIdentifier is needed to create a connection; the intended condition must be confirmed.

Props SparkGlueProperties GlueConnectionName: the page says to specify either glueConnectionName or glueConnectionNames, but not both; glueConnectionNames does not exist in the pinned schema, so no rule was registered and the schema version should be rechecked when it is added.
