AWS::DataZone::Domain.rationale: Checked the resource page, 2 property pages and the pinned schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes when the domain execution role and timestamps are created, and patterns/enums are already in the schema.

AWS::DataZone::DomainUnit.rationale: Checked the resource page and the pinned schema descriptions; no conditional wording was found and required/pattern/length limits are already in the schema.

open_questions: EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier is only valid for V1 domains and a V2 domain returns a ValidationException; this depends on DomainVersion of the AWS::DataZone::Domain identified by DomainIdentifier.

AWS::DataZone::EnvironmentActions.rationale: Checked the resource page, 1 property page and the pinned schema descriptions; no conditional wording was found beyond patterns and lengths already in the schema.

open_questions: EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier: the page says 'In the current release, only the following values are supported: DefaultDataLake and DefaultDataWarehouse', but the schema pattern accepts any blueprint ID and V2 domains use other blueprints; whether other values are rejected must be confirmed before registering a rule.

AWS::DataZone::EnvironmentProfile.rationale: Checked the resource page, 1 property page and the pinned schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes creation timestamps, and required/pattern limits are already in the schema.

AWS::DataZone::FormType.rationale: Checked the resource page, 1 property page and the pinned schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes creation timestamps, and required/pattern limits are already in the schema.

AWS::DataZone::GroupProfile.rationale: Checked the resource page and the pinned schema descriptions; no conditional wording was found beyond patterns and enums already in the schema.

AWS::DataZone::Owner.rationale: Checked the resource page, 3 property pages and the pinned schema descriptions; the choice between a Group and a User owner is already enforced by the schema oneOf, and no other conditional wording was found.

AWS::DataZone::PolicyGrant.rationale: Checked the resource page, 19 property pages and the pinned schema descriptions; the only restriction ('the only supported filter is the allDomainUnitsGrantFilter') and the principal/detail unions are already enforced by the schema oneOf combinators.

AWS::DataZone::ProjectMembership.rationale: Checked the resource page, 1 property page and the pinned schema; the Member union ('only one of the following members can be specified') is already enforced by the schema oneOf.

AWS::DataZone::ProjectProfile.rationale: Checked the resource page, 6 property pages and the pinned schema; the conditional wording only describes the creation timestamp, and required/pattern limits are already in the schema.

AWS::DataZone::SubscriptionTarget.rationale: Checked the resource page, 1 property page and the pinned schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes what a subscription target is and its timestamps, and required items are already in the schema.

AWS::DataZone::UserProfile.rationale: Checked the resource page, 3 property pages and the pinned schema descriptions; the Iam/Sso details union is already enforced by the schema oneOf and no other conditional wording was found.

AWS::Deadline::Budget.rationale: Checked the resource page, its property pages (actions, schedule, usage tracking resource) and the pinned schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes when a budget starts or ends and what actions do, with no stated constraint beyond the schema's required items and limits.

open_questions: AcceleratorCapabilities Selections: all accelerators must use the same Runtime, and specifying latest for some selections while leaving others blank raises an exception; comparing values across array items is not expressible with the declarative operators, so this must be checked manually.

Before a limit is used it must be associated with one or more queues (AWS::Deadline::QueueLimitAssociation) and its AmountRequirementName must be added to a step in a job template; this depends on other resources and job templates.

AWS::Deadline::MeteredProduct.rationale: Checked the resource page (LicenseEndpointId, ProductId and attributes) and the pinned schema; no conditional wording was found and the patterns are already in the schema.

open_questions: IdentityCenterRegion is required when IAM Identity Center is in a different Region than the monitor; the Identity Center Region is external to the resource values.

AWS::Deadline::QueueEnvironment.rationale: Checked the resource page and the pinned schema; no conditional wording was found and required items, enums and patterns are already in the schema.

AWS::Deadline::QueueFleetAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page (FarmId, FleetId, QueueId) and the pinned schema; no conditional wording was found and the ID patterns are already in the schema.

open_questions: Two limits with the same AmountRequirementName cannot be associated with the same queue; this depends on the AWS::Deadline::Limit resources and other associations of the queue.

AWS::Deadline::StorageProfile.rationale: Checked the resource page, the file system location property page and the pinned schema; no conditional wording was found and required items, enums and lengths are already in the schema.

open_questions: Deadline Cloud limits the number of workers to the fleet's MaxWorkerCount (with eventual consistency); this depends on the AWS::Deadline::Fleet and its current worker count.
AutoEnableMembers: changing the value requires the stack account to be the Detective administrator for the organization (account/organization state, not decidable from the resource values).
MemberEmailAddress must be the root user email address of the account given in MemberId, otherwise invitation creation fails (external account data).

AWS::Detective::OrganizationAdmin.rationale: Checked the resource page (AccountId, GraphArn attribute) and the pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording describes behaviour (enabling Detective and creating a graph if not yet enabled), and the AccountId pattern is already in the schema.

AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace.rationale: Checked the resource page, the IamAuthConfiguration/IdcAuthConfiguration/Tag property pages and the pinned schema descriptions; the 'Required: Conditional' OperatorAppRoleArn and IdcInstanceArn are already required by the schema whenever Iam or Idc is given, and the only other conditional wording is the ElevatedActionsEnabled default.

open_questions: Metadata: the required and optional keys depend on AssetType and are defined only in the DevOps Agent Asset API per-type metadata schema (validated server-side); they are not checked here.

ServiceId: for configurations other than SourceAws and Aws it must be the UUID generated when the service was registered (RegisterService / AWS::DevOpsAgent::Service); this depends on another resource and is not registered as a rule.

Certificate is required when a private certificate authority issues the TLS certificate of the target service; which CA issued the target certificate is external state, so this is not decidable from the resource values.

ServiceDetails: the page says its structure depends on the value of ServiceType but does not state the mapping (for example gitlab -> ServiceDetails.GitLab) or whether ServiceDetails is mandatory for a given ServiceType; not registered as a rule.

AWS::DevOpsAgent::Trigger.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Condition/Schedule property pages and the pinned schema descriptions; 'Currently only TIME_BASED is supported' is already enforced by the Type enum and the remaining wording describes behaviour (Active/Inactive status, when the trigger fires).

AWS::DevOpsGuru::LogAnomalyDetectionInte.rationale: Checked the resource page and the single pinned schema description; the type has no settable properties (AccountId is read-only), so there is no condition to register.

open_questions: Config.Sns.TopicArn: DevOps Guru only supports standard SNS topics; whether the referenced topic is a standard (not FIFO) topic is a property of the SNS topic, not of this resource.

Config.Sns.TopicArn: a topic in another account must have a policy granting DevOps Guru permission to publish, and a topic encrypted with a customer managed KMS key needs key permissions for DevOps Guru; both are external state.

AllowedPrefixesToDirectConnectGateway is required when the association is to a transit gateway (schema description); whether AssociatedGatewayId is a transit gateway (tgw- ID/ARN or a Ref to AWS::EC2::TransitGateway) cannot be tested by the available condition operators, so this is not registered as a rule.
AllowedPrefixesToDirectConnectGateway items: an IPv6 CIDR must use /64 or shorter (schema description); per-item checks on a string array are not expressible as a declarative rule.

AcceptDirectConnectGatewayAssociationProposalRoleArn is 'Required: Conditional': it is used only when the Direct Connect gateway is owned by a separate AWS account, which is account state not decidable from the resource values.
The virtual private gateway must be attached to a VPC and must not be associated with another Direct Connect gateway (external state).
ConnectionsBandwidth: the page lists the possible values 1Gbps, 10Gbps, 100Gbps and 400Gbps, while the pinned schema only has the pattern ^[1-9][0-9]*(M|G)bps$; not registered as a rule.

All connections in the LAG must use the same bandwidth and terminate at the same Direct Connect endpoint; checking member AWS::DirectConnect::Connection resources (LagId, Bandwidth, Location) needs other resources' values.
RequestMACSec: all connections in the LAG must be capable of supporting MACsec (port/location capability, external state).

Mtu: the Template Reference page says the supported values are 1500 and 8500, but the pinned schema description says 1500 and 9001; the allowed jumbo value needs confirmation before registering a rule.
RateLimit must be one of the supported bandwidth values and cannot exceed the bandwidth of the parent connection or LAG (supported-value list and another resource's bandwidth).
AllocatePrivateVirtualInterfaceRoleArn should only be used for hosted virtual interfaces, i.e. when the connection or LAG is owned by another account (account ownership is external state).
RouteFilterPrefixes items: an IPv6 CIDR must use /64 or shorter (schema description); per-item checks on a string array are not expressible as a declarative rule.
RateLimit must be one of the supported bandwidth values and cannot exceed the bandwidth of the parent connection or LAG (supported-value list and another resource's bandwidth).
AllocatePublicVirtualInterfaceRoleArn should only be used for hosted virtual interfaces, i.e. when the connection or LAG is owned by another account (account ownership is external state).
Mtu: the page (intro and property) states 1500 or 8500 and this is registered, but the pinned schema description says 1500 and 9001; confirm the rule if the documentation changes.

The ASN of a transit gateway associated with the Direct Connect gateway must differ from the Direct Connect gateway ASN; this compares other resources (AWS::EC2::TransitGateway, AWS::DirectConnect::DirectConnectGateway).
RateLimit must be one of the supported bandwidth values and cannot exceed the bandwidth of the parent connection or LAG (supported-value list and another resource's bandwidth).
AllocateTransitVirtualInterfaceRoleArn should only be used for hosted virtual interfaces, i.e. when the connection or LAG is owned by another account (account ownership is external state).

VpcSettings.SubnetIds: the two subnets must be in different Availability Zones; the Availability Zone is a value of the AWS::EC2::Subnet resources, and the text implies but does not state an exact count of two subnets.

Edition: the page lists Allowed values Enterprise | Standard | Hybrid, and Name and Password have page-listed patterns (Password: 8-64 characters with three of lowercase, uppercase, digit, special character), none of which are in the pinned schema; not registered as rules.

VpcSettings.SubnetIds: the two subnets must be in different Availability Zones; the Availability Zone is a value of the AWS::EC2::Subnet resources, and the text implies but does not state an exact count of two subnets.
Size: the page lists Allowed values Small | Large (see CreateDirectory), and Name, Password and Description have page-listed patterns, none of which are in the pinned schema; not registered as rules.

MasterUsername and MasterUserPassword are 'Required: Conditional' but the page does not state the condition (for example restores from SnapshotIdentifier or SourceDBClusterIdentifier, or ManageMasterUserPassword); confirm.
MasterUsername cannot be a reserved word for the chosen database engine; the reserved-word list is not on the page.

RestoreToTime 'must be specified if the UseLatestRestorableTime parameter is not provided' and must be before the latest restorable time; the page does not say whether this applies only to point-in-time restores (SourceDBClusterIdentifier), and the restorable time is external state, so it is not registered.
RestoreType copy-on-write cannot be used when the source cluster engine version is earlier than 1.11 (depends on the source cluster).

StorageEncrypted is 'Required: Conditional': when restoring, KmsKeyId must be specified if the source is unencrypted and StorageEncrypted is true, and StorageEncrypted must not be false if the source is encrypted (depends on the source snapshot or cluster).

PreferredBackupWindow must be at least 30 minutes and must not conflict with PreferredMaintenanceWindow; PreferredMaintenanceWindow must be at least 30 minutes; window arithmetic is not expressible with the operators.
DBSubnetGroupName, SnapshotIdentifier and SourceDBClusterIdentifier must match existing resources (external state).

NetworkType (IPV4 | DUAL) and StorageType (standard | iopt1) value lists on the page are absent from the pinned schema; NetworkType must also be supported by the DB subnet group (depends on another resource).
Name must not match the name of an existing DBClusterParameterGroup (external state).
Tags: the page says up to 10 tags can be assigned to an instance, but the pinned schema has no maxItems; confirm whether this is a current service limit before registering it.
PreferredMaintenanceWindow: minimum 30-minute window is not expressible with the declarative operators.
CertificateRotationRestart should be set only when clients do not use SSL/TLS (depends on client usage).
The subnets must be in at least two different Availability Zones; this depends on the subnet resources.

DBSubnetGroupName: the page allows letters, numbers, periods, underscores, spaces or hyphens, while the pinned schema pattern [a-zA-Z][0-9a-zA-Z-:._ ]* (unanchored) also allows ':'; the character set is left for manual review.
SourceIds must identify resources of the given SourceType (instance, security group, parameter group, snapshot); this depends on the referenced resources.

SourceIds items 'can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens'; the pinned schema item pattern does not reject consecutive hyphens and per-item string checks are not expressible, so check manually.
AdminUserPassword is 'Required: Conditional' but the page does not state the condition (presumably AuthType PLAIN_TEXT versus SECRET_ARN); confirm when it must be specified.

AdminUserPassword constraints (8 to 100 characters; no '/', '"' or '@') are not registered because the page does not say whether they also apply when AuthType is SECRET_ARN; confirm before registering a format rule.
AdminUserName cannot be a reserved word; the reserved-word list is not given on the page.
ShardCapacity: the page says allowed values are 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and ShardCount: maximum is 32; the pinned schema has no enum or maximum for either property.
AuthType: the page lists PLAIN_TEXT or SECRET_ARN, but the pinned schema has no enum.
PreferredMaintenanceWindow: minimum 30-minute window is not expressible with the declarative operators.
Replicas must contain an entry for the Region where the stack is deployed; this depends on the deployment Region, not on property values, and is not registered as a rule.

MultiRegionConsistency STRONG (MRSC): the witness page says an MRSC table has either three replicas or two replicas plus one witness, and the witness Region must differ from every replica Region and lie in the same Region set (US, EU or AP). The Region-set membership is external data, cross-array Region comparison is not expressible, and the Replicas page allows adding replicas incrementally, so the replica/witness count was not registered. GlobalTableWitnesses is described only for MRSC; the page does not state explicitly that it is rejected when MultiRegionConsistency is EVENTUAL.

SSESpecification / Replicas[*].SSESpecification: when customer-managed KMS keys are used, every replica must specify SSESpecification, and AWS managed and customer managed keys cannot be mixed; the page does not state how this relates to SSEEnabled/SSEType values, so no per-replica rule was registered. The KMS key must also be in the replica's Region (external state).
SSESpecification.SSEType: the description says the only supported value is KMS, but the page's Allowed values list AES256 | KMS and the pinned schema has no enum; confirm whether AES256 is rejected.

Top-level ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings and ReadOnDemandThroughputSettings, and GlobalSecondaryIndexes[*].ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings / ReadOnDemandThroughputSettings, 'can only be applied for multi-account global tables'; the page does not say which property values identify a multi-account global table (for example GlobalTableSourceArn), so no rule was registered.

Replicas[*].ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings and Replicas[*].GlobalSecondaryIndexes[*].ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings are described as read capacity settings 'when the BillingMode is set to PROVISIONED'; the page does not state explicitly that they are rejected under PAY_PER_REQUEST.

KeySchema and the KeySchema of GlobalSecondaryIndexes[*] / LocalSecondaryIndexes[*] must use attributes defined in AttributeDefinitions, and index names must be unique across GlobalSecondaryIndexes and LocalSecondaryIndexes combined; these cross-array conditions are not expressible with the current operators (uniqueness within each list is registered).
Projection.NonKeyAttributes: the total count across all secondary indexes must not exceed 100 when ProjectionType is INCLUDE; this aggregate is not registered.

KeySchema and AttributeDefinitions are optional in the pinned schema and on the page (Required: No); the page does not state when they are required (for example for a table that is not a multi-account replica with GlobalTableSourceArn).
GlobalSecondaryIndexes: up to 20 indexes (a service quota), and only one index may be created or deleted per stack operation (update-time); not registered.

VectorIndexes is documented on the page (it requires BillingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST and SearchSchema attributes must be in AttributeDefinitions) but is absent from the pinned schema; no rule was registered.

Page-listed constraints missing from the pinned schema: BillingMode allowed values (PROVISIONED | PAY_PER_REQUEST), TableName pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+ and length 3-255, AttributeType (S | N | B), KeyType (HASH | RANGE), ProjectionType (ALL | KEYS_ONLY | INCLUDE), StreamViewType, Replicas[*].TableClass (STANDARD | STANDARD_INFREQUENT_ACCESS), Tag Key length 1-128 and Value length 0-256.
The StreamArn attribute can be used only when StreamSpecification is specified; this depends on Fn::GetAtt usage in other resources and is not registered.
Table billing and provisioned throughput are implemented; GSI and other DynamoDB conditions need review.
InitializationGracePeriodSeconds: the page text says 'Valid values: 1 to 600' but the page and pinned schema list Minimum -1; confirm whether -1 or 0 is accepted before registering a lower bound.

The account limit of 50 application status checks and the requirement to associate the check with instances or tags (AssociateApplicationStatusCheck) before health checks start are outside the resource's property values.
S3BucketName: the bucket must exist and be accessible by the EC2 Capacity Manager service (bucket policy); this external state cannot be checked from the resource's properties.

Future-dated Capacity Reservation constraints (InstanceMatchCriteria must be targeted, OutPostArn and PlacementGroupArn not supported, at least 32 vCPUs, only C/M/R/I/T/G families, EndDate outside the commitment duration) cannot be evaluated because the schema exposes no writable start-date or future-dated indicator.
UnusedReservationBillingOwnerId: billing can be assigned only for Capacity Reservations shared through AWS RAM and the target account must accept; this depends on other resources and external state.
The pages do not state whether AvailabilityZone and AvailabilityZoneId are mutually exclusive or whether one of them is required; confirm before registering a rule.

InstanceTypeSpecifications: all instance type specifications must use the same Availability Zone (AvailabilityZone or AvailabilityZoneId); equality across array items cannot be expressed with the available operators.
RemoveEndDate and NoRemoveEndDate describe adding or removing an end date on an existing fleet (update behaviour); whether they may be set at creation together with EndDate is not stated.

AWS::EC2::CarrierGateway.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 5 schema descriptions; the only constraints stated are the tag key/value aws: prefix patterns and lengths, which the pinned schema already enforces.

open_questions: ClientCidrBlock must not overlap the local CIDR of the VPC of the associated subnet or manually added routes; this needs other resources' values.

AuthenticationOptions: FederatedAuthentication is described only as 'if applicable' for Type federated-authentication (unlike the explicit requirements for certificate-authentication and directory-service-authentication); confirm whether it is required.
ServerCertificateArn and ClientRootCertificateChainArn must be certificates provisioned in ACM and signed by a CA; this is external state.

TargetVpcSubnetId is required for VPC-based Client VPN endpoints and not required for Transit Gateway-based endpoints, and the subnet must be an existing target network of the endpoint (or local); this depends on the referenced ClientVpnEndpoint.
A target network association must exist before the route is created (DependsOn on AWS::EC2::ClientVpnTargetNetworkAssociation when created together); this is a template-level dependency.
SubnetId is required for VPC-based endpoints, while Transit Gateway-based endpoints use AvailabilityZone or AvailabilityZoneId instead; which applies depends on the referenced ClientVpnEndpoint.
Only one subnet per Availability Zone can be associated with an endpoint and associated subnets must be in the same VPC; this needs other associations' values.
BgpAsn documents a default of 65000 while both BgpAsn and BgpAsnExtended say one of them must be specified; whether specifying both is rejected is not stated.
IpAddress may be an RFC6598/RFC1918 private IPv4 address or an IPv6 address only when OutsideIpAddressType of the VPN connection is PrivateIpv4 or Ipv6; this depends on the AWS::EC2::VPNConnection.

Placement properties (Affinity, AvailabilityZone, HostId, HostResourceGroupArn, PartitionNumber, Tenancy) are documented as 'not supported for CreateFleet' although the schema accepts them in overrides; confirm whether they may be set, and whether the HostResourceGroupArn/Tenancy host condition applies.

Overrides AvailabilityZone/AvailabilityZoneId: the text says either 'must be specified in the request, but not both'; only 'not both' is registered because overrides commonly specify a subnet instead of an Availability Zone.
Overrides: for fleets of type request and maintain a maximum of 300 override items is allowed across all launch templates; this aggregate count across LaunchTemplateConfigs items cannot be expressed.
TargetCapacityUnitType can be specified only when attribute-based instance type selection (InstanceRequirements in the overrides) is used; this depends on array items and is not registered.

EbsBlockDevice: per-volume-type Iops ranges (gp3 3,000-80,000; io1 100-64,000; io2 100-256,000) and VolumeSize ranges, and the statement that KmsKeyId is supported only for RunInstances, RequestSpotFleet and RequestSpotInstances, are not registered.

TargetCapacitySpecification: 'If the request type is maintain, you can specify a target capacity of 0'; whether a target capacity of 0 is rejected for request and instant fleets is not stated explicitly.
Domain: when the Elastic IP is associated with a VPC defined in the same template, a DependsOn on the VPC-gateway attachment is required; this is a template-level dependency on another resource.
InstanceId requires the instance to have exactly one attached network interface, and NetworkInterfaceId must be used when the instance has more than one; this depends on the referenced instance.
RoleArn: up to 16 IAM roles can be associated with one ACM certificate; this limit spans other association resources.
The associated role needs s3:GetObject on the returned bucket and kms:Decrypt on the returned KMS key; these permissions are external state.

DeliverLogsPermissionArn for kinesis-data-firehose: the page requires it when the delivery stream and the monitored resources are in different accounts, while the schema description says not to specify it for kinesis-data-firehose; the account relationship is external, so no rule is registered for firehose.
LogDestination must be the ARN of a log group, S3 bucket or Firehose delivery stream matching LogDestinationType; the ARN formats are given only as examples and are not registered as patterns.
The gateway (virtual private gateway or internet gateway) and the route table must be in the same VPC; this needs the referenced resources' values.
InstanceType and InstanceFamily: the pages describe each option but do not state whether exactly one of them is required or whether both may be specified; confirm before registering a rule.
NetmaskLength or Cidr must be specified when the pool has no DefaultNetmaskLength allocation rule; this depends on the referenced IPAM pool.
NetmaskLength range (0-32 for IPv4, 0-128 for IPv6) depends on the address family of the referenced pool.
PubliclyAdvertisable: the schema says it 'Must be set if and only if the pool is IPv6'; only the IPv4 prohibition is registered because the requirement for IPv6 pools in a private scope is unclear.

Locale: it must be an operating Region of the IPAM, must match the source pool's locale when one is set, and the Local Zone network border group option is only available for IPv4 pools in the public scope; these depend on other resources.
PublicIpSource is used only for pools in the public scope and SourceIpamPoolId space must be free in the parent pool; the scope type and parent pool state come from other resources.
AddressFamily: the page lists ipv4 | ipv6 but the pinned schema has no enum; the value is not validated by a rule.

NetmaskLength can be used for Amazon-provided IPv6 CIDRs to top-level pools and for pools with source pools, but not to provision BYOIP CIDRs to top-level pools; this depends on the referenced IPAM pool.

Rule conditions: IpamPoolId conditions belong to ipam-pool-cidr rules and ResourceId/ResourceOwner/ResourceRegion/Cidr/ResourceTag conditions to ipam-resource-cidr rules; a per-condition check against the parent rule's RuleType cannot be expressed.
The pages do not state whether static-cidr rules require StaticCidr, or whether ipam-resource-cidr rules require ResourceType and IpamScopeId.
ImageId: when the AMI comes from LaunchTemplate, the referenced launch template version must contain ImageId; this depends on another resource and is not checked.
SecurityGroups (names) can be used only in a default VPC; for a nondefault VPC security group IDs are required. Whether the target VPC is the default VPC is external state.

CreditSpecification.CPUCredits: T3 instances with host tenancy support only standard (the T3 default is unlimited); this is an instance-type capability statement and it is unclear whether it also covers t3a, so no rule is registered.

BlockDeviceMappings Ebs: 'You must specify either a snapshot ID or a volume size' is not registered because a mapping that overrides an AMI device takes its snapshot from the AMI; VolumeSize must also be at least the snapshot size, which is external.

NetworkInterfaces: AssociatePublicIpAddress, DeleteOnTermination, Description, GroupSet and PrivateIpAddress apply only when a network interface is created at launch; confirm whether specifying them together with NetworkInterfaceId is rejected or ignored.
NetworkInterfaces PrivateIpAddresses: only one entry may have Primary set to true; the current operators cannot count array items by value, so this is not checked.

NetworkInterfaces AssociateCarrierIpAddress: the pinned schema says it is not currently supported by CloudFormation, while the page allows it only for subnets in a Wavelength Zone (external); confirm whether designs must omit it.
Volumes: each VolumeId must be in the same Availability Zone as the instance; this depends on the AWS::EC2::Volume resource.
PrivateDnsNameOptions.HostnameType and MetadataOptions.HttpProtocolIpv6 depend on the subnet type (IPv4-only, IPv6-only or dual-stack) and on Nitro support, which are external.
HibernationOptions is valid only when the instance meets the hibernation prerequisites (instance type, AMI, root volume), which are external.

ElasticGpuSpecifications and ElasticInferenceAccelerators: the page states that Amazon Elastic Graphics reached end of life and Amazon Elastic Inference is no longer available; confirm whether designs must omit them.
PreserveClientIp: the page says the value for IpAddressType must be ipv4 to use it, but IpAddressType is absent from the pinned schema; confirm the endpoint IP address type before registering a rule.
Only one EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint can be created per VPC; this depends on other resources in the same VPC and is not checked.

AWS::EC2::InternetGateway.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 5 schema descriptions; the only settable property is Tags and no conditional wording exists.

AWS::EC2::IpPoolRouteTableAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page and 3 schema descriptions; both settable properties are schema-required IDs and no conditional wording exists (the page introduction describes a route server association, a documentation slip rather than a condition).

open_questions: KeyType ed25519 is not supported for Windows instances; this depends on the AMI of the instances that use the key pair and is not checked.

LaunchTemplateData.InstanceRequirements is supported only when the template is used by Auto Scaling groups, EC2 Fleet or Spot Fleet, not by AWS::EC2::Instance or RunInstances; this depends on the consuming resource.
LaunchTemplateData.ImageId: if the template omits ImageId, the AWS::EC2::Instance that uses it must specify ImageId (cross-resource).
LaunchTemplateData.IamInstanceProfile: when the template is used by an Auto Scaling group, specify either Arn or Name but not both; the consumer is not known from this resource.
LaunchTemplateData.InstanceMarketOptions.MarketType is Required: Conditional, but the page does not state the condition.

LaunchTemplateData.CreditSpecification is valid only for T instances and CpuOptions.AmdSevSnp only for M6a, R6a and C6a instance types; these are instance-type capability lists and are not registered.

LaunchTemplateData.Placement: PartitionNumber is valid only when the placement group strategy is partition, and GroupId is needed for a shared placement group (both depend on the placement group); the page also says AvailabilityZone and AvailabilityZoneId cannot both be specified, but AvailabilityZoneId is absent from the pinned schema.
BlockDeviceMappings Ebs.VolumeSize: 'You must specify either a snapshot ID or a volume size' is not registered because a mapping that overrides an AMI device takes its snapshot from the AMI.

NetworkInterfaces NetworkCardIndex: the primary network interface must use network card index 0; confirm whether DeviceIndex 0 identifies the primary interface on instance types with several network cards before registering a rule.
NetworkInterfaces PrivateIpAddresses: only one entry may have Primary set to true; the current operators cannot count array items by value, so this is not checked.
NetworkInterfaces DeviceIndex: a template with secondary but no primary network interface requires the AWS::EC2::Instance that uses it to supply the primary interface (cross-resource).
LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroups (names) are for the default VPC only; for a nondefault VPC SecurityGroupIds are required (external state).
LaunchTemplateData.UserData must be in MIME multi-part archive format when the template is used with AWS Batch; this depends on the consumer.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRoute.rationale: Checked the resource page and 6 schema descriptions; the only condition (exactly one target, LocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroupId or NetworkInterfaceId, with DestinationCidrBlock and LocalGatewayRouteTableId) is already enforced by the schema oneOf.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRouteTable.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 8 schema descriptions; no conditional wording exists, and the tag aws: prefix and length limits are already enforced by the schema pattern and lengths.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRouteTableVPCAssoc.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 6 schema descriptions; both settable IDs are schema-required, no conditional wording exists, and the tag aws: prefix is enforced by the schema pattern.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualI.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 8 schema descriptions; both settable IDs are schema-required, no conditional wording exists, and the tag aws: prefix is enforced by the schema pattern.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayVirtualInterface.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 17 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording (tag keys and values cannot be prefixed with aws:, length limits) is already enforced by the schema pattern and lengths.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGr.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 13 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording (tag keys and values cannot be prefixed with aws:, length limits) is already enforced by the schema pattern and lengths.

open_questions: Regional NAT gateways (AvailabilityMode regional): the page does not state whether AllocationId, SubnetId or VpcId are required; the public AllocationId rule therefore excludes regional mode, and the default AvailabilityMode is not stated.
The network border group of each Elastic IP address must match that of the Availability Zone of the public NAT gateway; this is external.
AvailabilityZoneAddresses: AvailabilityZoneId is to be used instead of AvailabilityZone, but the page does not state that exactly one of them must be given.

AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 6 schema descriptions; VpcId is schema-required and no conditional wording exists.

open_questions: RuleNumber: entries of the same network ACL can't use the same rule number unless one is an egress rule and the other an ingress rule; this depends on the other AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry resources and is not checked.

AWS::EC2::NetworkInsightsAccessScope.rationale: Checked the resource page and its AccessScopePathRequest, PathStatementRequest, PacketHeaderStatementRequest, ResourceStatementRequest, ThroughResourcesStatementRequest and Tag property pages (the pinned schema has no descriptions); no conditional wording exists.

ServiceConnectDefaults.Namespace: a namespace name can't include >, <, double quotation marks or /, but the property also accepts a namespace ARN (which contains /), so the restriction is not registered as a rule.

Configuration.ManagedStorageConfiguration.KmsKeyId and FargateEphemeralStorageKmsKeyId must be single-Region keys, and ExecuteCommandLogConfiguration log group and S3 bucket must already exist; these depend on external state.

DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy: only one capacity provider in a strategy can have Base defined; it is unclear whether an explicit Base of 0 counts as defined, and counting items that specify a field is not expressible, so no rule is registered.

ContainerDefinitions DependsOn: the COMPLETE and SUCCESS conditions can't be set on an essential container, and HEALTHY requires the dependent container to have a health check; checking this needs matching ContainerName against another container definition, which is not expressible.
ContainerDefinitions MountPoints SourceVolume must be a volume name defined in Volumes Name; this cross-array reference is not expressible as a rule.

ContainerDefinitions LogConfiguration Options: the awslogs option list marks awslogs-region and awslogs-group as Required: Yes; confirm whether these must be present whenever LogDriver is awslogs before registering a rule.

ContainerDefinitions LogConfiguration LogDriver: the supported drivers depend on whether tasks run on Fargate or EC2 instances, and the pinned schema has no enum; the hosting depends on the capacity provider (another resource).
ContainerDefinitions Secrets ValueFrom and RepositoryCredentials CredentialsParameter must be full ARNs when the secret or parameter is in a different Region; this depends on external state.

ContainerDefinitions SystemControls Value lists valid IPC and network namespace values (kernel.*, fs.mqueue.*, net.*) that appear to describe Namespace; it is unclear which property they constrain, so no rule is registered.
ContainerDefinitions LinuxParameters Tmpfs MountOptions lists valid values, but it is unclear whether options that take arguments (such as mode or uid) are accepted with values; not registered.
PrimaryTaskSet is used when the service uses the EXTERNAL deployment controller type; checking this needs the DeploymentController of the AWS::ECS::Service named in Service (another resource).

NetworkConfiguration is Required: Conditional: it is required for task definitions that use the awsvpc network mode and not supported for other network modes; the network mode is a property of the AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition, so this is not registered.

Role is only permitted when a load balancer is used and the task definition does not use the awsvpc network mode (the service-linked role is used for awsvpc, service discovery, external controller, multiple target groups); the network mode belongs to the task definition, so only 'Role requires LoadBalancers' is registered.

TaskDefinition is required for the ECS and CODE_DEPLOY deployment controllers, but the default DeploymentController.Type is not stated in the reviewed text; the rule applies only when DeploymentController.Type is set explicitly. Confirm the default (ECS) to extend it to an unspecified controller.

AwsvpcConfiguration.AssignPublicIp says 'When the service deploymentController is ECS, the value must be DISABLED', which contradicts common Fargate usage with ENABLED under the ECS controller; not registered until AWS confirms the statement.
CapacityProviderStrategy cross-item conditions are not expressible with the rule operators: only one item may define Base, and with multiple items at least one must have Weight greater than 0.

DeploymentCircuitBreaker 'can only be used for services using the rolling update (ECS) deployment type': the rule covers the CODE_DEPLOY and EXTERNAL controllers only; confirm whether it is also invalid for the ECS controller with Strategy BLUE_GREEN, LINEAR or CANARY.

Canary and linear deployments are rejected when BakeTimeInMinutes + CanaryBakeTimeInMinutes (or BakeTimeInMinutes + StepBakeTimeInMinutes x number of steps) exceeds 33 hours, including defaults; this arithmetic cannot be expressed with the compare operator.

ManagedEBSVolume per-volume-type Iops ranges (gp3 3,000-16,000, io1 100-64,000, io2 100-256,000), SizeInGiB ranges and the 1,000 MiB/s Throughput maximum are stated on the page but may lag current EBS limits; not registered. FilesystemType must match the snapshot's filesystem and SizeInGiB must be at least the snapshot size, which needs snapshot state.
ServiceRegistries ContainerName/ContainerPort/Port requirements depend on the task definition network mode (bridge/host vs awsvpc) and on the Cloud Map service DNS record type (SRV); not registered.

LoadBalancers: LoadBalancerName 'should be omitted' for Application/Network Load Balancers (recommendation wording); CODE_DEPLOY requires two target groups defined in the CodeDeploy deployment group; ContainerPort must match a containerPort in the task definition; awsvpc tasks support only ALB/NLB with ip target type. These need other resources or are not explicit, so they are not registered.

ServiceConnectService.Timeout.PerRequestTimeoutSeconds can only be set if the Service Connect appProtocol isn't TCP; appProtocol is defined in the task definition port mapping, so this is not registered.

ServiceConnectConfiguration.LogConfiguration.Options: the text says both 'You cannot configure both the awslogs-datetime-format and awslogs-multiline-pattern options' and 'This option is ignored if awslogs-datetime-format is also configured'; confirm the severity before registering. The splunk-token/splunk-url requirement is not registered because the token may be supplied through SecretOptions.

PlatformVersion, PlacementConstraints, DAEMON and magnetic EBS restrictions are registered for an explicit LaunchType only; Fargate selected through a FARGATE/FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategy is not detected.
EBSTagSpecification.PropagateTags: 'Tags can only propagate to a SERVICE specified in ServiceVolumeConfiguration' is unclear about which values are allowed; not registered.
PlacementConstraints: the limit of 10 constraints includes constraints in the task definition; the registered rule checks the service's own constraints only.

Cpu and Memory (task level): the Fargate table of valid Cpu/Memory combinations and the EC2/external Cpu range (128 to 196608 CPU units) are not encoded; both are strings that may carry units (for example '1 vCPU', '2 GB'), and some Fargate sizes also require Linux platform version 1.4.0 or later.

ContainerDefinitions: the total CPU reserved by all containers must be lower than the task-level Cpu and the total container Memory must be lower than the task-level Memory; these are sums across array items and are not encoded.
ContainerDefinitions/Essential: 'All tasks must have at least one essential container' (Essential defaults to true) is a condition across array items and is not encoded.

Intra-resource name references are not encoded: MountPoints/SourceVolume must name a Volumes item; VolumesFrom/SourceContainer, DependsOn/ContainerName, Links and ProxyConfiguration/ContainerName must name a container; a ResourceRequirements item of type InferenceAccelerator must match an InferenceAccelerators DeviceName.

ContainerDefinitions/DependsOn: the COMPLETE and SUCCESS conditions can't be set on an essential container, and HEALTHY requires the dependent container to have a health check; this depends on the referenced container's settings and is not encoded.

Array-wide limits not encoded: only one volume configured at launch per task definition, only one container per task may specify NeuronDevice resources, a port may appear in only one port mapping per container, ContainerPortRange ranges must not overlap, and at most 100 port ranges per container.
PortMappings/ContainerPortRange: the format (ports 1-65535, first port less than last port) is not encoded.

ContainerDefinitions/SystemControls: IPC namespace systemControls are not supported with IpcMode host and network namespace systemControls are not supported with NetworkMode host, but the SystemControl Namespace and Value descriptions do not clearly say which field carries the sysctl name, so these conditions are not encoded.

ProxyConfiguration/ProxyConfigurationProperties: the documented keys (IgnoredUID or IgnoredGID, AppPorts, ProxyIngressPort, ProxyEgressPort, EgressIgnoredPorts, EgressIgnoredIPs) are marked (Required) inside a key-value list; confirm whether these should be checked as key names.

Platform and agent requirements outside the task definition are not encoded: Fargate platform versions for PidMode, SystemControls, Capabilities Add, EphemeralStorage, EnvironmentFiles, DependsOn, StartTimeout, StopTimeout and health checks; container agent, ecs-init and Docker Remote API versions; Swappiness is not supported on Amazon Linux 2023.
ContainerDefinitions/DependsOn is not supported when the task definition is used in a CodeDeploy blue/green deployment (AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup); this depends on another resource.
NetworkMode awsvpc requires a NetworkConfiguration on the service or RunTask call; this depends on the AWS::ECS::Service or task launch, not on the task definition.
Windows-only restrictions are checked only when RuntimePlatform/OperatingSystemFamily is a WINDOWS_* value; confirm whether Windows task definitions in designs always declare RuntimePlatform.

RuntimePlatform/CpuArchitecture: ARM64 is described as available for Linux EC2, Managed Instances and Linux containers on Fargate; the page does not state an explicit prohibition for Windows, so no rule is registered.
Secrets/ValueFrom and RepositoryCredentials/CredentialsParameter: a full ARN is required when the secret or parameter is in a different Region; this needs the stack Region and is not encoded.

LogConfiguration/Options: to route logs with the splunk log driver a splunk-token and a splunk-url are needed; the token may be supplied through SecretOptions instead of Options, so no rule is registered.

ResourceRequirements: the NeuronDevice resource type is only supported on Managed Instances; RequiresCompatibilities is optional and may list several launch types, so the scope of this restriction is not encoded.

Volumes/DockerVolumeConfiguration: Docker volumes are described as only supported with the EC2 launch type; whether this also excludes EXTERNAL and MANAGED_INSTANCES compatibilities is not stated, so only the Fargate exclusion is encoded.
FirelensConfiguration/Options: valid option keys are enable-ecs-log-metadata, config-file-type and config-file-value; checking map keys against this list is not encoded.

CapacityProviderStrategy: only one capacity provider in the strategy can have Base defined; counting array items that specify Base cannot be expressed with the available operators, so check it manually.

CapacityProviderStrategy: when multiple capacity providers are specified, at least one must have a Weight greater than zero; this cross-item condition cannot be expressed with the available operators, so check it manually.

ServiceRegistries: whether ContainerName and ContainerPort, or Port (but not both), must be specified depends on the task definition network mode (bridge/host/awsvpc) and on whether the AWS Cloud Map service uses SRV records, which are values of other resources.
NetworkConfiguration.AwsVpcConfiguration.AssignPublicIp must be DISABLED when the service deploymentController is ECS; this depends on the AWS::ECS::Service named in Service.

PlatformVersion is specified only for tasks using the Fargate launch type; when CapacityProviderStrategy is used instead of LaunchType, whether PlatformVersion is allowed depends on the capacity provider types, which cannot be decided from this resource.

NetworkConfiguration.AwsVpcConfiguration Subnets and SecurityGroups must all be from the same VPC, LoadBalancers ContainerPort must correspond to a containerPort in the task definition, and target groups must use target type ip for awsvpc task definitions; these need other resources' values.
RootDirectory.CreationInfo is required if RootDirectory.Path does not already exist on the file system; whether the path exists is external state and must be confirmed.

FileSystemId: the page says only the ID format (fs-...) is accepted, but the pinned schema pattern also accepts a file system ARN; confirm whether an ARN value is rejected before registering a format rule.
ProvisionedThroughputInMibps: the upper limit (3414 MiBps) depends on the Region and can be raised through Support, so the maximum must be confirmed against the target Region and account quota.

PerformanceMode (generalPurpose | maxIO) and ThroughputMode (bursting | provisioned | elastic) list allowed values on the page, but the pinned schema has no enum for them; misspelled values are not caught by schema validation.

ReplicationConfiguration.Destinations: the text says that for One Zone file systems the replication configuration must specify AvailabilityZoneName and Region, but it does not state whether this refers to a One Zone source or a One Zone destination file system; confirm before registering a rule.
AvailabilityZoneName: One Zone file systems are not available in all Availability Zones; availability is regional external state.

IpAddress is described for IpAddressType IPV4_ONLY or DUAL_STACK and Ipv6Address for IPV6_ONLY or DUAL_STACK (default IPV4_ONLY), but the text does not explicitly forbid IpAddress with IPV6_ONLY or Ipv6Address with IPV4_ONLY; confirm before registering a rule.
IpAddressType must match the IP type of the subnet in SubnetId, and IpAddress/Ipv6Address must come from that subnet; this needs the AWS::EC2::Subnet values.
SecurityGroups must belong to the same VPC as SubnetId, and for One Zone file systems SubnetId must be in the file system's Availability Zone; these need other resources' values.
SecurityGroups: the maximum number depends on the account's VPC security group quota.
PrincipalArn: the same principal ARN can't be used in more than one access entry; uniqueness across AWS::EKS::AccessEntry resources for the cluster needs other resources' values.

Type lists valid values (STANDARD, FARGATE_LINUX, EC2_LINUX, EC2_WINDOWS, EC2, HYBRID_LINUX, HYPERPOD_LINUX) on the page, but the pinned schema has no enum for it; misspelled values are not caught by schema validation.
ServiceAccountRoleArn: to specify an existing IAM role, an IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider must already exist for the cluster; this is external state.
AddonName and AddonVersion must be an add-on and version available for the cluster's Kubernetes version; this depends on the cluster and on EKS add-on availability (external).

Configuration: the structure varies depending on the capability Type, but the text does not state explicitly that ArgoCd may be used only with Type ARGOCD or Ack only with Type ACK; confirm before registering a rule.
RoleArn must have a trust policy that allows the EKS service principal to assume it and the permissions required by the capability type; this is external IAM state.
CapabilityName must be unique within the cluster; this needs other AWS::EKS::Capability resources and existing capabilities.

Each cluster can have at most two certificate authorities at a time (the signing CA and one successor); whether the cluster already has a successor CA, or whether several AWS::EKS::CertificateAuthority resources target the same ClusterName, cannot be decided from this resource alone.
KubernetesNetworkConfig.ServiceIpv4Cidr must not overlap any CIDR block assigned to the VPC of the cluster subnets; this needs the AWS::EC2::VPC and subnet values.

KubernetesNetworkConfig.IpFamily ipv6 requires the VPC and subnets to have both IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks, is not available in China Regions, and needs version 1.10.1 or later of the Amazon VPC CNI add-on; these are other resources and regional/external state.

RemoteNetworkConfig RemoteNodeNetworks/RemotePodNetworks Cidrs must each be within an RFC-1918 range with a size between /8 and /32 and must not overlap the VPC CIDR blocks or the Kubernetes service IP range; per-string array item checks are not expressible with the available operators and the overlap check needs other resources.
ResourcesVpcConfig.PublicAccessCidrs: IPv6 CIDR blocks can't be added to IPv4 clusters; checking each array string against the cluster IpFamily is not expressible with the available operators.
ActiveCertificateAuthorityId must be the Id of an AWS::EKS::CertificateAuthority whose distribution status is COMPLETE; this is external state of another resource.
EncryptionConfig Provider.KeyArn must be a symmetric KMS key created in the same Region as the cluster (with access granted for a cross-account key); this is external KMS state.
Name must be unique within the AWS Region and account; this is external state.
Subnets: only private subnets (with no direct route to an Internet Gateway) are accepted; this depends on the route tables of the AWS::EC2::Subnet resources.
A Fargate profile can't be created while another Fargate profile in the same cluster is in the DELETING status; this is external state.
Oidc is documented as Required: No although Type allows only oidc; the text does not state whether Oidc must be specified when Type is oidc, so confirm before registering a rule.

InstanceTypes with LaunchTemplate: the LaunchTemplate description says not to specify instanceTypes, while the InstanceTypes description allows 0-20 instance types when the launch template itself has no instance type; the outcome depends on the AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate content, so it is not registered.

AmiType and Version must not be specified when the launch template uses a custom AMI, and the launch template can't include SubnetId, IamInstanceProfile, RequestSpotInstances, HibernationOptions, or TerminateInstances; these depend on the AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate values.
Version: the Kubernetes version of the cluster is the only accepted specified value; this needs the AWS::EKS::Cluster Version.

Taints Effect is documented as one of No_Schedule, Prefer_No_Schedule, or No_Execute, but the pinned schema has no enum and the EKS API uses NO_SCHEDULE, PREFER_NO_SCHEDULE and NO_EXECUTE; confirm the accepted spelling before registering a rule.

AmiType, CapacityType, UpdateConfig.UpdateStrategy and WarmPoolConfig.PoolState list allowed values on the page, but the pinned schema has no enum for them; misspelled values are not caught by schema validation.

WarmPoolConfig.PoolState HIBERNATED is only supported on specific instance types, a GPU instance type needs an applicable GPU AmiType, and Windows AMI types are only supported in some commercial Regions; these depend on external instance-type and regional information.

Namespace and ServiceAccount must name a Kubernetes namespace and service account inside the cluster, and the service account and its Pods must be in that namespace; this is Kubernetes state outside the template.

Nested instance fleet/group limits are stated in prose but not registered for the Cluster's MasterInstanceFleet, CoreInstanceFleet, TaskInstanceFleets, MasterInstanceGroup, CoreInstanceGroup and TaskInstanceGroups (they are registered on the standalone AWS::EMR::InstanceFleetConfig / InstanceGroupConfig types): Spot provisioning TimeoutDurationMinutes 5-1440, Spot/On-Demand resize TimeoutDurationMinutes 5-10,080, VolumeSpecification Throughput valid only for gp3, AutoScalingPolicy ScalingAction.Market not available for instance groups, and unique scaling rule names within a policy.
Instance fleets: "At least one of TargetSpotCapacity and TargetOnDemandCapacity should be greater than 0" is worded as "should"; no rule was registered.

VolumeSpecification SizeInGB "can be a number from 1 - 1024" (minimum 10 if "the volume type is EBS-optimized") and Throughput 125 - 1000 may be outdated relative to current EBS limits and the EBS-optimized condition is unclear; not registered.

Release-dependent availability not registered: instance fleets (4.8.0 and later, excluding 5.0.x), Configurations (4.x and later), On-Demand allocation strategy (5.12.1 and later), ScaleDownBehavior options (4.1.0 / 5.1.0), HadoopVersion (earlier than 4.0), and PlacementGroupConfigs (from 5.23.0 only InstanceRole MASTER with PlacementStrategy SPREAD).

Steps[].ActionOnFailure: the page says "Possible values are CANCEL_AND_WAIT and CONTINUE" but the pinned schema has no enum and the EMR API also accepts other values for cluster launch steps; confirm before registering an allowed-values rule.

ManagedScalingPolicy.UtilizationPerformanceIndex: ScalingStrategy "Determines whether a custom scaling utilization performance index can be set"; it is implied but not stated that the index requires ScalingStrategy ADVANCED.

Instances.Ec2SubnetId "Applies to clusters that use the uniform instance group configuration", Ec2SubnetIds "Applies to clusters that use the instance fleet configuration", and Placement.AvailabilityZone is used for uniform instance groups; whether specifying them with the other configuration is invalid is not stated.

KerberosAttributes: ADDomainJoinUser and CrossRealmTrustPrincipalPassword are "Required only when establishing a cross-realm trust", which is configured in the referenced security configuration (another resource); not checked.
Scaling CloudWatchAlarmDefinition.Period: "if you specify a CloudWatch metric, specify 300" is guidance tied to how EMR emits metrics; not registered.
JobFlowRole/ServiceRole defaults (EMR_EC2_DefaultRole etc.) "must have already" been created; this depends on account state and is not checked.
TargetOnDemandCapacity/TargetSpotCapacity: "At least one of TargetSpotCapacity and TargetOnDemandCapacity should be greater than 0" is worded as "should"; no rule was registered.

LaunchSpecifications.SpotSpecification.BlockDurationMinutes: valid values are 60-360 in steps of 60, but Spot blocks are no longer available to new customers (supported until December 31, 2022); whether the property is still accepted depends on the account.

InstanceTypeConfigs[].EbsConfiguration VolumeSpecification SizeInGB "1 - 1024" (minimum 10 for "EBS-optimized" volume types) and Throughput "125 - 1000" may be outdated relative to current EBS limits; not registered.

ClusterId: the target cluster must use instance fleets ("A cluster can not use both instance fleets and instance groups") and a release that supports instance fleets (4.8.0 and later, excluding 5.0.x; On-Demand allocation strategy 5.12.1 and later); these depend on the AWS::EMR::Cluster resource and are not checked.

AutoScalingPolicy.Rules[].Action.SimpleScalingPolicyConfiguration.ScalingAdjustment: "If AdjustmentType is set to EXACT_CAPACITY, the number should only be a positive integer" is worded as "should"; no rule was registered.
AutoScalingPolicy.Rules[].Trigger.CloudWatchAlarmDefinition.Period: "if you specify a CloudWatch metric, specify 300" is guidance tied to how EMR emits metrics; not registered.
EbsConfiguration VolumeSpecification SizeInGB "1 - 1024" (minimum 10 for "EBS-optimized" volume types) and Throughput "125 - 1000" may be outdated relative to current EBS limits; not registered.
JobFlowId: the target cluster must use instance groups ("A cluster can not use both instance groups and instance fleets"); this depends on the AWS::EMR::Cluster resource and is not checked.

AWS::EMR::SecurityConfiguration.rationale: Checked the resource page (no property pages) and 2 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is that Kerberos authentication and EMRFS authorization are available in EMR 5.10.0 and later, which concerns the clusters using the configuration, and the JSON document content is defined outside the page.

open_questions: UserRole: "You only need to specify UserRole when you set AuthMode to SSO" does not clearly state whether UserRole is required for SSO or forbidden for IAM; no rule was registered.
AuthMode: the schema description says "Amazon EMR Studio currently only supports SSO authentication" while the page and the pinned enum allow SSO and IAM; the contradiction is unresolved.
SubnetIds, EngineSecurityGroupId and WorkspaceSecurityGroupId must belong to the VPC specified by VpcId; this depends on other resources and is not checked.

AWS::EMR::StudioSessionMapping.rationale: Checked the resource page (no property pages) and 4 schema descriptions; "Either IdentityName or IdentityId must be specified" is already satisfied because IdentityName is required by the pinned schema (IdentityId is not a property), and IdentityType is enforced by the enum.

open_questions: Tags Key/Value: the schema descriptions list allowed characters (Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -) but the pinned schema has no pattern and the list omits characters such as ':' commonly allowed in tags; no character-set rule was registered.

ConfigurationOverrides.MonitoringConfiguration.ContainerLogRotationConfiguration.RotationSize: the page says "Minimum of 2KB, Maximum of 2GB", but the pinned pattern ^\d+(\.\d+)?[KMG][Bb]?$ accepts sizes outside that range; a size-range check on the unit-suffixed string was not registered because no declarative operator compares such values.
SessionIdleTimeoutInMinutes: the page gives no description ("Property description not available"); whether it requires a session-enabled virtual cluster (another resource) is not documented.

SecurityConfigurationData.EncryptionConfiguration.InTransitEncryptionConfiguration.TLSCertificateConfiguration.CertificateProviderType: the page text says "Acceptable values: PEM or Custom" but both the page's Allowed values line and the pinned enum list only PEM; confirm whether Custom is accepted.

Tags Key/Value: the pinned schema descriptions state lengths of 1 to 127 (key) and 1 to 255 (value) Unicode characters and a character set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -, but the pinned schema has no length or pattern constraints and the 127/255 limits differ from the usual 128/256; no length or character-set rule was registered.

WorkerTypeSpecifications: the schema says it "must contain all valid worker types for a Spark or Hive application" (Driver and Executor for Spark, HiveDriver and TezTask for Hive), but the list is introduced with "include" and the Type value spelling (Spark/SPARK, Hive/HIVE) is not fixed, so no required-keys rule was registered.

WorkerTypeSpecifications vs ImageConfiguration: "You can either set image details in this parameter for each worker type, or in imageConfiguration for all worker types" does not clearly say that both cannot be set together; no exclusivity rule was registered.

WorkerTypeSpecifications.<worker type>.ImageConfiguration.ImageUri: the ImageUri requirement at creation also applies to per-worker image configurations, but map entries cannot be scoped by the rule engine; only the top-level ImageConfiguration is checked.
InitialCapacity[].Value.WorkerConfiguration Memory/Disk and MaximumCapacity: valid memory and disk sizes per vCPU are on the external "Supported worker configurations" page and are not checked.

InitialVlans CIDR blocks must not overlap each other or other subnets in the VPC; overlap between the VLAN members is not expressible with the current operators and overlap with VPC subnets needs external state.

For a public HCX VLAN (InitialVlans.IsHcxPublic true), the CIDR must be allocated from the IPAM public pool, added to the VPC as a secondary CIDR block, and at least two Elastic IP addresses must be allocated from the public IPAM pool (external state).

LicenseInfo, VcfHostnames, SiteId and ConnectivityInfo are Required: No, and the page does not state whether they are required when VcfVersion is not SELF_DEPLOYED (LicenseInfo is described as 'required to create an environment').

VcfHostnames entries must each be unique and resolve in the VPC DHCP option set's DNS; uniqueness across the object members is not expressible with the current operators and DNS resolution is external.
Hosts[].HostName must also be unique across Amazon EVS environments, and LicenseInfo keys must meet instance-type-specific core and capacity minimums (external state).
PreferredAvailabilityZones: the number of Availability Zones listed must equal NumCacheNodes; comparing an array length with an integer property is not expressible with the available operators.
CacheParameterGroupName: a parameter group with cluster-enabled='yes' cannot be used when creating a cluster; this depends on the referenced parameter group's settings.

NetworkType / IpDiscovery: IPv6 is supported only for specific engine versions (Valkey 7.2+, Redis OSS 6.2-7.1, Memcached 1.6.6+) on Nitro-based node types; this needs engine-version and node-type tables.
NotificationTopicArn: the SNS topic owner must be the same as the cluster owner; this depends on external account ownership.

AutomaticFailoverEnabled must be enabled for Valkey or Redis OSS (cluster mode enabled) replication groups; whether the Global datastore is cluster mode enabled depends on the member replication groups (another resource).
CacheParameterGroupName must be compatible with the major engine version used by the Global datastore; this needs engine-version and parameter-group-family data.

Engine is documented as 'For Valkey or Redis OSS only' but the accepted value strings are not enumerated on the page or in the pinned schema; confirm whether a value check (valkey | redis) should be added.

AWS::ElastiCache::ParameterGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and the 5 pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the page-listed CacheParameterGroupFamily values and tag null-value notes, which are value lists or behaviour descriptions rather than single-resource conditions.

open_questions: PreferredCacheClusterAZs: the number of Availability Zones listed must equal NumCacheClusters; comparing an array length with an integer property is not expressible with the available operators.

NodeGroupConfiguration.ReplicaAvailabilityZones: the number of Availability Zones must match ReplicaCount (or ReplicasPerNodeGroup when ReplicaCount is not specified); array length comparison is not expressible with the available operators.

Cluster mode can also be enabled without ClusterMode (for example through a cluster-enabled parameter group or more than one node group); the AutomaticFailoverEnabled and SnapshottingClusterId restrictions are registered only for an explicit ClusterMode value and need review otherwise.

PrimaryClusterId is 'not required if NumCacheClusters, NumNodeGroups, or ReplicasPerNodeGroup is specified', but NumCacheClusters defaults to 1, so it is unclear whether PrimaryClusterId is ever required; the cluster must also already exist and be available (external state).
AtRestEncryptionEnabled and TransitEncryptionEnabled are only available in an Amazon VPC with specific engine versions (Valkey 7.2+, Redis OSS 3.2.6 or 4.x onward); this needs engine-version data.
NetworkType / IpDiscovery: IPv6 is supported only for specific engine versions on Nitro-based node types; this needs engine-version and node-type tables.
Engine: the page states 'The value must be set to valkey or redis.' but the pinned schema has no enum and case handling is not documented; confirm whether a value check should be added.
CacheParameterGroupName must match the cluster mode (for example default.redis3.2 vs default.redis3.2.cluster.on); this depends on the referenced parameter group.
NotificationTopicArn: the SNS topic owner must be the same as the cluster owner; this depends on external account ownership.

AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page and the Tag property page (the pinned schema has no property descriptions); the only wording is that a tag with a null Value is permitted, which is not a restriction.

AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroupIngress.rationale: Checked the resource page and its 3 properties (the pinned schema has no property descriptions); the only notes are that updates are not supported and that EC2SecurityGroupOwnerId takes an account ID rather than an access key ID, which describe behaviour and value meaning rather than a decidable condition.

open_questions: NetworkType: ipv6 is only supported with IPv6-only subnets; this depends on the referenced subnets (another resource).

AuthenticationMode.Passwords 'Specifies the passwords to use for authentication if Type is set to password'; it is not stated whether Passwords is required for Type password or must be omitted for iam / no-password-required.
The relationship between the top-level Passwords / NoPasswordRequired properties and AuthenticationMode is not documented (for example whether both may be specified together).
UserIds: for Redis OSS a user named default must be included; the list holds user IDs, so checking the user name requires the referenced AWS::ElastiCache::User resources.
UserIds: the page says the list can be empty for Valkey, while the pinned schema and page list Minimum: 1; confirm which applies.
SourceBundle: the Amazon S3 bucket must be in the same region as the environment; this depends on the bucket and the environment (other resources).

ImageConfiguration.Build.Architecture must match the architecture of the instances in the environment that the version is deployed to; this depends on the environment's configuration (another resource).

Process must be turned on for application versions created using AWS CodeBuild or AWS CodeCommit; it is registered for BuildConfiguration only, and it is unclear whether an ImageConfiguration.Build (which also runs CodeBuild) requires Process.

SourceConfiguration: if both SolutionStackName and SourceConfiguration are specified, the solution stack of the source configuration template must match SolutionStackName; this depends on the referenced configuration template.
OptionSettings namespaces, option names and values depend on the selected platform (external option tables) and are not checked.

Tier: the page lists Name values (WebServer, Worker, Cluster) and Type values (Standard, SQS/HTTP, EKS) per tier, implying the pairs WebServer/Standard, Worker/SQS/HTTP and Cluster/EKS; the pairing is not stated as an explicit constraint and the pinned schema has no enums.
OptionSettings namespaces, option names and values depend on the selected platform (external option tables) and are not checked.

Listeners.InstanceProtocol: listeners sharing the same InstancePort must all use a secure (HTTPS or SSL) or all use an insecure (HTTP or TCP) InstanceProtocol; this cross-item comparison is not expressible with the available operators.
Subnets: at most one subnet per Availability Zone may be specified; the Availability Zone of each subnet is external (another resource).

AvailabilityZones is for a load balancer in a default VPC and Subnets for a nondefault VPC; whether the VPC is the default VPC is external, and it is not stated whether both may be specified together.
Scheme and SecurityGroups are valid only for load balancers in a VPC; VPC membership cannot be decided from the property values alone.
Policies.InstancePorts and Policies.LoadBalancerPorts are 'Required only for some policy types'; the policy types that require them are not listed.

Policy names must be unique within the set of policies for the load balancer; uniqueness across AppCookieStickinessPolicy, LBCookieStickinessPolicy and Policies is not expressible (uniqueness within each list is registered).
Listeners.LoadBalancerPort on EC2-Classic is limited to 25, 80, 443, 465, 587 and 1024-65535; EC2-Classic is not decidable from the property values.
Secure-listener certificate requirement is implemented; other protocol and action conditions need review.

Actions: the rule must include exactly one forward, fixed-response or redirect action and it must be the last action performed; an authentication action is allowed only for HTTPS listeners. Counting actions by Type and ordering them is not expressible, and the listener protocol belongs to another resource.
Conditions: at most one condition each for http-request-method, host-header, path-pattern and source-ip; per-Field counting of Conditions items is not expressible with the current operators.
Priority: a listener can't have multiple rules with the same priority; this needs the other ListenerRule resources of the same listener.

Actions ForwardConfig: when both ForwardConfig and TargetGroupArn are given, the single ForwardConfig target group must be the same as TargetGroupArn; string equality between two paths is not expressible (only the one-group limit is registered).
RedirectConfig Protocol: you can't redirect HTTPS to HTTP; this depends on the protocol of the listener (another resource).

HostHeaderConfig Values must include at least one '.' and only alphabetical characters after the final '.', and JWT AdditionalClaims Values can't include spaces when Format is space-separated-values; per-string checks on string arrays are not expressible.

AuthenticateOidcConfig UseExistingClientSecret: 'If you are creating a rule, you can omit this parameter or set it to false' - confirm whether UseExistingClientSecret true should be rejected for a rule that is being created.
The listener must be associated with an Application Load Balancer, and SourceIpConfig uses Values for ALB and IpAddressType for NLB; both depend on the listener/load balancer resources.

IpAddressType: 'Internal load balancers must use ipv4' is not registered because the LoadBalancerAttributes text (ipv6.deny_all_igw_traffic is true for internal load balancers) implies internal IPv6-capable load balancers; confirm the current restriction for Scheme internal.

Subnets/SubnetMappings: only one subnet per Availability Zone, Application Load Balancers need subnets from at least two Availability Zones, and ALBs on Outposts need one Outpost subnet; these need the subnets' Availability Zones (external state).

LoadBalancerAttributes: access_logs.s3.bucket, connection_logs.s3.bucket and health_check_logs.s3.bucket are required when the corresponding *.enabled attribute is true, and attribute keys are supported only by specific load balancer types; these cross-item key/value conditions are not expressible with the current operators.

SubnetMappings AllocationId (internet-facing NLB), PrivateIPv4Address (internal NLB), IPv6Address and SourceNatIpv6Prefix, SecurityGroups ([Application Load Balancers and Network Load Balancers]) and EnablePrefixForIpv6SourceNat ([Network Load Balancers with UDP listeners]) carry load balancer type/scheme labels without an explicit prohibition; confirm whether other types or schemes reject them.

Port and Protocol are 'Required: Conditional' and the page only says they do not apply when the target is a Lambda function; confirm that they are required for instance, ip and alb target types and whether specifying Port, Protocol or VpcId for lambda target groups is rejected.

Matcher: HttpCode ranges depend on the protocol and load balancer type (Gateway Load Balancers must use 200-399), GrpcCode applies to the GRPC protocol version, and ProtocolVersion/HealthCheckPath are labelled [HTTP/HTTPS]; range strings and label scopes are not registered.

TargetType ip: publicly routable addresses are not allowed except VPC subnet ranges, and Targets AvailabilityZone is required for IP addresses outside the VPC; both need the VPC CIDR blocks (external state).

TargetGroupAttributes cross-attribute conditions: load_balancing.algorithm.anomaly_mitigation only when load_balancing.algorithm.type is weighted_random, target_health_state.unhealthy.draining_interval_seconds only when target_health_state.unhealthy.connection_termination.enabled is false, and target_failover.on_deregistration must equal target_failover.on_unhealthy; per-load-balancer-type attribute support also needs the load balancer type. Not expressible as single-item checks.

Cross-resource conditions: a TCP_UDP or TCP_QUIC listener must use a target group of the same protocol, QuicServerId must be unique at the listener level, and an alb target must have a listener whose port matches the target group port.

EncryptionAtRestOptions.KmsKeyId says 'Required if you enable encryption at rest', but OpenSearch Service uses an AWS managed key when no key is given; confirm before registering KmsKeyId as required when EncryptionAtRestOptions.Enabled is true.
EBSOptions.Iops 'applies only to provisioned IOPS EBS volume types', but the page does not list which VolumeType values (io1, gp3, ...) accept Iops, so no rule is registered.
EBSOptions.VolumeSize limits, ElasticsearchClusterConfig.InstanceType/DedicatedMasterType/WarmType and ElasticsearchVersion supported values depend on external OpenSearch Service tables.

VPCOptions.SubnetIds needs one subnet per Availability Zone the domain uses (for example three subnets for a three-AZ domain); matching the subnet count to ZoneAwarenessConfig.AvailabilityZoneCount and checking the subnets' AZs is not registered.

ElasticsearchClusterConfig.ZoneAwarenessEnabled: 'Don't enable zone awareness if your cluster has no replica index shards or is a single-node cluster'; replica shards are index settings and the statement is guidance, so InstanceCount 1 with ZoneAwarenessEnabled true is not registered.
MasterUserOptions.MasterUserARN is 'Required: Conditional'; the page only says to specify it when InternalUserDatabaseEnabled is false and does not say it is required in that case.
LogPublishingOptions slow logs also need slow-log collection enabled through the Configuration API (outside CloudFormation).
