open_questions: Type: the page says "Valid types include OpenApi3 and JSONSchemaDraft4" but the pinned schema has no enum; the wording "include" does not state that the list is exhaustive, so no allowed-values rule was registered.

ConnectionArn: "The destination endpoint must support the authorization type specified for the connection" depends on the referenced AWS::Events::Connection and the external HTTP endpoint and is not checked.

AWS::Events::Archive.rationale: Checked the resource page (no property pages, no schema descriptions); the conditional wording covers archive behaviour, the RetentionDays default (0 = indefinite), the default AWS owned key and a recommendation to use a customer managed key, none of which is a single-resource rule.

open_questions: AuthParameters.ConnectivityParameters: described as "For private OAuth authentication endpoints" and "If you specify a private OAuth endpoint"; the page does not state that it is invalid with BASIC or API_KEY authorization, so no rule was registered.
AuthorizationType/AuthParameters: the page does not state whether AuthParameters is required when AuthorizationType is given (the schema requires neither); only the mismatch case is checked.

Name/EventSourceName: "for partner event buses, the name must exactly match the name of the partner event source"; comparing two string properties for equality is not supported by the declarative operators, so this is not checked.
KmsKeyIdentifier: schema discovery (AWS::EventSchemas::Discoverer) is not supported for event buses encrypted with a customer managed key; this depends on another resource and is not checked.

Statement vs Action/Principal/Condition: "You can include a Policy parameter in the request instead of using the StatementId, Action, Principal, or Condition parameters", but StatementId is required by the schema; it is not stated whether Action/Principal/Condition are forbidden with Statement or whether Action and Principal are required without it.

Condition Key/Value: the schema descriptions of Key and Value appear swapped ("Specifies the key for the condition. Currently the only supported key is aws:PrincipalOrgID" is on Value, "Currently, this must be the ID of the organization" is on Key); no rule was registered for them.
Statement/policy size: "The permission policy on the event bus cannot exceed 10 KB in size" covers the whole bus policy (all statements) and is not checked.

State: ENABLED_WITH_ALL_CLOUDTRAIL_MANAGEMENT_EVENTS "is only valid for rules on the default event bus or custom event buses"; whether EventBusName refers to a partner event bus cannot be decided reliably from the name, so this is not checked.

Targets[].RoleArn is "Required: Conditional": it is needed for some target types (EC2, Kinesis Data Streams, Step Functions, API Gateway) and for cross-account event bus targets granted through an organization; the target type and the grant are not decidable from property values, so no rule was registered.
Targets[] Input/InputPath/InputTransformer "are not available with PutTarget if the target is an event bus of a different AWS account"; this depends on the target's account and is not checked.

Targets[].InputPath: the Targets text says "you must use JSON dot notation, not bracket notation" while the InputPath page says "You may use JSON dot notation or bracket notation"; the contradiction is unresolved, so no rule was registered.
Targets[].SqsParameters: "If you specify a fair or FIFO queue as a target, the queue must have content-based deduplication enabled" depends on the AWS::SQS::Queue resource and is not checked.

Targets[].EcsParameters.CapacityProviderStrategy[].Base: "Only one capacity provider in a capacity provider strategy can have a base defined"; the rule engine has no operator for counting array items that define a field, so this is not checked.

Targets[].RedshiftDataParameters: DbUser is "Required when authenticating using temporary credentials" and SecretManagerArn is "Required when authenticating using AWS Secrets Manager"; the authentication method is not a property value, so it is unclear whether exactly one of them must be given.

Targets[].EcsParameters AwsVpcConfiguration Subnets/SecurityGroups "must all be in the same VPC", and LaunchType "must match one of the launch type (compatibilities) of the target task"; these depend on other resources and are not checked.

The pinned Rule schema lacks the page's Allowed values and ranges for many nested properties (for example EcsParameters.LaunchType, AwsVpcConfiguration.AssignPublicIp, PlacementConstraint.Type, PlacementStrategy.Type, PropagateTags, RetryPolicy ranges); these were not registered as rules.

AWS::EventsV2::EventBus.rationale: Checked the resource page, the EncryptionConfiguration, StorageConfiguration and Tag property pages and 16 schema descriptions; the conditional wording is limited to naming patterns, lengths and ranges already enforced by the schema and to KMS-key and drift recommendations.

open_questions: Configuration.AwsServiceEventsConfiguration.Pattern must not include source, account, or region as top-level fields; the pattern is a JSON string, so this needs a JSON-content check rather than a declarative rule.
OnFailureConfiguration: an empty object removes a configured destination on update; this is update-time behaviour only and was not registered.
Creating the resource fails if the event bus referenced by EventBusArn already has a default resource policy, and the bus must already exist; both depend on external state.
PolicyDocument principals must exist and be visible to the service when the policy is written (external state).
PolicyDocument text says 'Declare Version.' alongside drift-avoidance guidance; it is unclear whether a PolicyDocument without Version is rejected or only reported as drift.
PointInTimeConfiguration is described as 'Used when StartingPosition is POINT_IN_TIME'; the page does not state whether it is required for POINT_IN_TIME or rejected/ignored for LATEST.

BatchConfiguration.MaxBatchSize has a per-target maximum (100 for Lambda, Step Functions and EventsV2 bus targets; 10 for SQS, SNS and Events bus targets; 1 for API Gateway, API destinations and universal targets) that depends on classifying InvokeConfiguration.TargetArn; the rule engine cannot condition on an ARN pattern, so it is not registered.
EventBusV2Parameters.DeduplicationConfiguration: the text says to omit it and set SystemMetadata.DeduplicationId for token-based deduplication; it does not state that specifying both is rejected.
InvokeConfiguration.RoleArn must belong to the same account as the subscriber (needs the stack account).
ResumePosition is ignored on create and applied only on an update that moves State from STOPPED to RUNNING (update-time behaviour).
Template Reference page was unavailable on 2026-09-29; review is based on pinned schema descriptions only
RunningStatus.Status is described only as 'Provide START or STOP action to apply on an experiment'; the pinned schema has no enum for it, so the accepted values are unconfirmed.

ExecutionStatus.Status ('Provide START or STOP') and ExecutionStatus.DesiredState ('Provide CANCELLED or COMPLETED') have no enum or pattern in the pinned schema, so the accepted values are unconfirmed.

Each entry of the Targets map must specify at least one ResourceArns entry or at least one ResourceTags entry, but not both (ExperimentTemplateTarget page); Targets is a map keyed by target name, so the per-target check cannot be expressed with an array scope and needs manual review.

Targets.<name>.ResourceType must be supported for the actions that use it, and Actions.<name>.ActionId, Parameters and Targets must match the FIS action catalog; this depends on the external FIS action definitions.

Actions.<name>.StartAfter must name other actions in the same template and Actions.<name>.Targets must name keys of the top-level Targets map; these are cross-map references inside map-valued properties that need manual review.

StopConditions[].Value is the ARN of the CloudWatch alarm 'if applicable'; when it is required depends on StopConditions[].Source (for example aws:cloudwatch:alarm versus none), which the page does not spell out.
When ExperimentOptions.AccountTargeting is multi-account, AWS::FIS::TargetAccountConfiguration resources are required for the target accounts; this involves other resources.

A target account configuration is required when ExperimentOptions.AccountTargeting of the referenced experiment template (ExperimentTemplateId) is multi-account; checking this needs the values of the AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate resource.
The SNS topic in SnsTopicArn must allow the role AWSServiceRoleForFMS to publish SNS logs; this is a topic-policy precondition outside this resource.

ResourceType lists valid resource types per policy type (for example Network ACL - AWS::EC2::Subnet, DNS Firewall/Network Firewall/third-party firewall - AWS::EC2::VPC), but the list omits SECURITY_GROUPS_COMMON and IMPORT_NETWORK_FIREWALL and may be outdated, so it is not registered as a SecurityServicePolicyData.Type to ResourceType rule.

SecurityServicePolicyData.ManagedServiceData is a JSON string whose documented constraints (FirewallDeploymentModel must match the chosen deployment model, preProcessRuleGroups priorities 1-99 and postProcessRuleGroups 9901-10000, automaticResponseAction only when automaticResponseStatus is ENABLED, one logDestinationConfigs and up to 20 redactedFields) need a JSON-content check.

PolicyOption.NetworkAclCommonPolicy is described as used when SecurityServicePolicyData.Type is NETWORK_ACL_COMMON; the page does not state whether PolicyOption is required for NETWORK_ACL_COMMON, NETWORK_FIREWALL or THIRD_PARTY_FIREWALL, or rejected for other types.
ResourceTypeList says 'Use this only to specify multiple resource types'; it is unclear whether a single-item ResourceTypeList is rejected.
IncludeMap/ExcludeMap: the page says 'not both' but also that ExcludeMap is not evaluated when IncludeMap is set; registered as WARNING pending confirmation of whether the service rejects both.

NetworkAclEntry: the page labels PortRange for TCP/UDP and IcmpTypeCode for ICMP and offers CidrBlock and Ipv6CidrBlock, but does not state whether these are required for the corresponding Protocol or mutually exclusive.
Name cannot be changed after the resource set is created (update-time restriction; the pinned schema does not mark Name as create-only).
Resources has no property description on the Template Reference page (schema: 'A resource ARN or URI'); constraints on its items are unknown.

A file system can have at most 8 data repository associations, and FileSystemPath values must not overlap across associations ('/' is allowed only for the first association); these conditions span several resources and were not registered.
Each data repository association must use a unique FileSystemPath directory and a unique S3 bucket or prefix (DataRepositoryPath); uniqueness across resources was not registered.

Data repository associations are supported only on FSx for Lustre 2.12 and newer file systems, excluding the SCRATCH_1 deployment type; this depends on the referenced AWS::FSx::FileSystem and was not registered.
SecurityGroupIds: a security group must be specified when creating a Multi-AZ FSx for ONTAP file system in a VPC subnet shared with you; subnet ownership is external state, so no rule was registered.

LustreConfiguration AutoImportPolicy, ExportPath, ImportedFileChunkSize, ImportPath and CopyTagsToBackups are not supported for Lustre file systems linked to a data repository association; this depends on AWS::FSx::DataRepositoryAssociation resources and was not registered.
LustreConfiguration.ExportPath must use the same S3 bucket as ImportPath; comparing the bucket part of two strings is not expressible, so it was not registered.

StorageCapacity for FSx for Lustre must be 1200 GiB, 2400 GiB or specific increments (2400, 3600, 6000 or 1800 GiB) depending on DeploymentType, StorageType and PerUnitStorageThroughput; increment rules are not expressible and were not registered.

For FSx for ONTAP, StorageCapacity bounds (1,024-524,288 GiB per HA pair), DiskIopsConfiguration.Iops bounds (StorageCapacity * 3 * HAPairs to 200,000 * HAPairs) and ThroughputCapacity divided by HAPairs depend on OntapConfiguration.HAPairs; only the fixed StorageCapacity bounds 1,024 GiB and 1,048,576 GiB were registered.
SubnetIds count is documented only for Windows deployment types, ONTAP MULTI_AZ_1 and Lustre; the count for ONTAP MULTI_AZ_2, SINGLE_AZ_1, SINGLE_AZ_2 and for OpenZFS deployment types is not stated.
PreferredSubnetId (WindowsConfiguration, OntapConfiguration, OpenZFSConfiguration) must be one of the SubnetIds; membership in another array is not expressible, so it was not registered.

WindowsConfiguration.ThroughputCapacity is described as powers of two between 8 and 2048 MB/s; it was not registered pending confirmation that this list reflects the currently supported FSx for Windows throughput values.

WindowsConfiguration.ActiveDirectoryId is Required: Conditional (only when joining an AWS Managed Microsoft AD) and SelfManagedActiveDirectoryConfiguration.DnsIps is Required: Conditional without an explained condition; which directory settings must be given together is not stated as a property condition.

SelfManagedActiveDirectoryConfiguration.DnsIps: the FileSystem page allows up to three IP addresses, while the StorageVirtualMachine page says FSx for Windows supports up to two; only the limit of three was registered.

STORAGE_CAPACITY_REQUIRED and LUSTRE_PER_UNIT_STORAGE_THROUGHPUT_REQUIRED exempt StorageType INTELLIGENT_TIERING; the exemption is inferred from the 'fully elastic' Intelligent-Tiering description and the Lustre ThroughputCapacity property, not stated explicitly. Confirm it.

WindowsConfiguration.Aliases items must be fully qualified domain names of alphanumerics, underscores and hyphens that do not start or end with a hyphen; a pattern on each string item is not expressible, so it was not registered.

LustreConfiguration.ThroughputCapacity (Intelligent-Tiering) must be 4000 MBps or a multiple of 4000; the multiple-of rule and whether it is required for INTELLIGENT_TIERING file systems were not registered.
WindowsConfiguration.AuditLogConfiguration.AuditLogDestination must be in the same partition, Region and account as the file system; this is external state and was not registered.

The pages do not state that Type must match the configuration given (ONTAP with OntapConfiguration, OPENZFS with OpenZFSConfiguration); the pinned schema oneOf only requires exactly one configuration. Confirm whether a Type/configuration rule should be added.
OntapConfiguration.FileSystemIdentity.Type (UNIX or WINDOWS) is not stated to require the matching UnixUser or WindowsUser; the pinned schema oneOf only requires exactly one of them.

AWS::FSx::Snapshot.rationale: Checked the AWS::FSx::Snapshot resource page, its Tag property page and the pinned schema: the only constraints are required Name/VolumeId and page-listed patterns and lengths, and the tag text only describes key uniqueness and null values, so there is no conditional wording to register.

open_questions: ActiveDirectoryConfiguration.NetBiosName: the page lists a maximum length of 15 characters, which the pinned schema lacks; not registered because page-listed limits are not rules.

SelfManagedActiveDirectoryConfiguration: the pages do not state which of UserName/Password or DomainJoinServiceAccountSecret must be provided, nor whether DomainName and DnsIps are required when joining a directory; FileSystemAdministratorsGroup must already exist in the domain (external state).
The pages do not state that VolumeType must match the configuration given (ONTAP with OntapConfiguration, OPENZFS with OpenZFSConfiguration) or that exactly one configuration is required.
OntapConfiguration.JunctionPath says 'This parameter is required.' but the property is marked Required: No and data-protection (DP) volumes may not be mounted; presence was not registered.

OpenZFSConfiguration.RecordSizeKiB valid values depend on whether the parent file system uses Intelligent-Tiering, and StorageCapacityReservationGiB cannot exceed the parent volume's storage; both depend on other resources and were not registered.
OpenZFSConfiguration.OriginSnapshot.CopyStrategy INCREMENTAL_COPY is only for updating an existing volume; because OriginSnapshot can change on update, it was not registered as a creation rule.

SnaplockConfiguration.RetentionPeriod.DefaultRetention must be between MinimumRetention and MaximumRetention, and an audit log volume (AuditLogVolume true) needs a minimum retention of six months; comparisons across time units are not expressible and were not registered.
OntapConfiguration.AggregateConfiguration.Aggregates must name aggregates that exist and have volume capacity (external state); FlexVol volumes have a single aggregate entry.
OntapConfiguration.SizeInMegabytes is superseded by SizeInBytes ('Use SizeInBytes instead'); no exclusivity is stated, so no rule was registered.

Schema.Attributes must contain the minimum required fields for the chosen Domain and DatasetType, in the order of the training data; the required fields come from the external Forecast dataset domain tables.
EncryptionConfig.RoleArn must be a role in the same AWS account (passing a role across accounts is not allowed); this depends on the deployment account.
Amazon Forecast is no longer available to new customers; whether the target account can create datasets depends on account eligibility.
Domain must match the Domain of every dataset listed in DatasetArns; this needs the values of the AWS::Forecast::Dataset resources.
The pinned schema says tag values cannot be prefixed with aws:, while the Tag page says values can have this prefix; no tag value rule was registered because the sources conflict.
Amazon Forecast is no longer available to new customers; whether the target account can create dataset groups depends on account eligibility.

OperatingSystem: the page says a valid operating system must be specified and there is no default, while the pinned schema description says WINDOWS_2012 is used when it is not specified; because the sources conflict, no rule requiring OperatingSystem was registered.
StorageLocation: the S3 bucket must be owned by the account and be in the same Region as the build, and the role must allow Amazon GameLift to read it (external state).

InstanceConnectionPortRange: the port range must not overlap the reserved range 4092-4191; this needs an either/or comparison (ToPort < 4092 or FromPort > 4191) that a single declarative assertion cannot express, so no rule was registered.

InstanceInboundPermissions FromPort/ToPort: only ports 22 and 1026-60000 are valid for Linux builds and 1026-60000 for Windows builds; the operating system comes from the container group definition (another resource).
Locations: the list must also include the fleet's home Region (the Region where the stack is deployed), which is not a resource property.

GameServerContainerGroupDefinitionName / PerInstanceContainerGroupDefinitionName: the schema says a GAME_SERVER container group must be specified and a PER_INSTANCE group is optional; whether the fleet can be created without a game server definition, and the ContainerGroupType of the referenced definitions, depend on other resources.

LogConfiguration: LogGroupArn and S3BucketName are described as used when LogDestination is CLOUDWATCH or S3, but the page does not say they are required or rejected otherwise; an S3 bucket must be in the fleet's home Region (external state).

Locations LocationCapacity MinSize: the property page says MinSize is ignored with ZeroCapacityStrategy SCALE_TO_AND_FROM_ZERO while the schema says it must not be specified; the rule follows the schema wording (ERROR).
TotalVcpuLimit: when individual containers have vCPU limits, the total must be equal to or greater than the sum of the container limits; a sum across array items cannot be expressed declaratively.
PortConfiguration ContainerPortRanges: ranges with the same protocol must not overlap; overlap between array items cannot be expressed declaratively.

SupportContainerDefinitions Essential: the schema says exactly one essential container must be specified in a container group, while the game server container is automatically essential; how this applies to GAME_SERVER groups is not stated, so no rule was registered.
ContainerDependency Condition: with COMPLETE or SUCCESS the dependency container can't be an essential container; this cross-item check is not registered.

ContainerName: names must be unique within the whole container group definition; the registered rule only checks the support containers against each other, not against GameServerContainerDefinition ContainerName.
GameServerContainerDefinition: the page does not state whether it is required when ContainerGroupType is GAME_SERVER.

BuildId / ScriptId (Required: Conditional): BuildId is required for custom game builds and ScriptId identifies a Realtime script, but the page does not state whether exactly one of them must be given (or how this applies to ANYWHERE fleets); the build must be READY and the script uploaded (external state).

RuntimeConfiguration: the page states it is required unless ServerLaunchPath and ServerLaunchParameters are used, without mentioning ComputeType; the registered rule applies it only to EC2 fleets (the default ComputeType). Confirm the requirement for ANYWHERE fleets.

RuntimeConfiguration ServerProcesses: an instance is limited to 50 concurrent processes (the schema says the configuration must specify fewer than this limit); the sum of ConcurrentExecutions across items cannot be expressed declaratively.

InstanceRoleARN / InstanceRoleCredentialsProvider: described as used with fleets where ComputeType is EC2, and InstanceRoleCredentialsProvider refers to the role in InstanceRoleArn and needs server SDK 5.x; whether they are rejected for ANYWHERE fleets or without InstanceRoleARN is not stated.
AnywhereConfiguration: described as settable with ComputeType ANYWHERE; whether it is rejected for EC2 fleets is not stated.
EC2InboundPermissions FromPort/ToPort: only ports 22 and 1026-60000 are valid for Linux builds and 1026-60000 for Windows builds; the operating system comes from the build (another resource).
Locations: the home location (the Region where the stack is deployed) must be included when this parameter is used; the deployment Region is not a resource property.

PeerVpcId must be in the same Region as the fleet, CertificateConfiguration GENERATED fails in Regions without ACM, and PlayerGatewayMode needs a server SDK 5.x build (external state / other resources).

Locations LocationCapacity MinSize: the property page says MinSize is ignored with ZeroCapacityStrategy SCALE_TO_AND_FROM_ZERO while the schema says it must not be specified; the rule follows the schema wording (ERROR).
LaunchTemplate: if the launch template specifies network interfaces, AssociatePublicIpAddress must be set to true in the template; this is a property of another resource (the EC2 launch template).

PriorityConfiguration LocationOrder: described as the order used when PriorityOrder includes LOCATION; the page does not say whether LocationOrder is required with LOCATION or rejected/ignored without it.

AWS::GameLift::Location.rationale: Checked the resource page and its 4 schema descriptions. The only constraints (LocationName must start with custom- and its length) are already enforced by the schema pattern and length limits, and no conditional wording applies.

open_questions: RuleSetName: a matchmaking configuration can only use rule sets defined in the same Region (another resource / external state).
AcceptanceTimeoutSeconds: described as the wait time if acceptance is required; the page does not say whether it is required when AcceptanceRequired is true or ignored when it is false.
RuleSetBody: must be a JSON-formatted rule set without comments; JSON syntax and rule-set content cannot be validated by the declarative operators.
Rule sets must be defined in the same Region as the matchmaking configurations that use them (another resource).
NodeJsVersion: the page lists the valid values as 10.x | 24.x while the pinned schema only has a pattern; this is a runtime version list that changes over time, so no rule was registered.
StorageLocation: the S3 bucket must be in the same Region where the script is created (external state).

RuntimeEnvironment: the page lists the supported Type/Version combinations (UBUNTU 22_04_LTS, WINDOWS 2022, PROTON 20260204/20250516/20241007/20230704), but the pinned schema has no enum and the list is a version table that changes over time, so no rule was registered.
ApplicationSourceUri: the Amazon S3 bucket must be in the same AWS Region as the application and must contain all files needed to run the content (external state).

ExecutablePath: for Linux applications the file must be a valid Linux binary or a script with a shebang line, and it must be contained within the application's root folder; this depends on the uploaded content, not on property values.

LocationConfigurations: one of the locations must be the primary location, i.e. the AWS Region where the stack is deployed; the deployment Region is not a resource property, so no rule was registered.

LocationConfigurations: when a location is configured for the first time a numeric value must be given for at least one of 'the two capacity types', but the page does not name which two of AlwaysOnCapacity, TargetIdleCapacity, MaximumCapacity and OnDemandCapacity are meant.

LocationConfigurations capacities: values must be whole-number multiples of the tenancy of the stream group's StreamClass; tenancy is only given in the StreamClass description table (not in the schema), so no rule was registered.
StreamClass: the page lists the available stream classes but the pinned schema has no enum; availability varies by location.

VpcTransitConfiguration: Ipv4CidrBlocks must be subsets of the VPC's CIDR blocks and must not overlap the service VPC CIDR block, and the VPC must be in the same AWS account as the stream group (another resource / external state).

IpAddresses: the addresses must come from the account's own BYOIP address pool and only one address from each BYOIP range can be used per accelerator; this depends on provisioned BYOIP ranges (external state) and was not registered as a rule.

FlowLogsS3Bucket: the bucket must exist and have a bucket policy that grants Global Accelerator permission to write to it; this depends on another resource and was not registered as a rule (the FlowLogsEnabled/FlowLogsS3Bucket/FlowLogsS3Prefix co-requirement is already enforced by the pinned schema dependencies).
Principals: the page says a principal can be an AWS account number or the ARN of an accelerator, but gives no exact format; no pattern rule was registered.

Resources Cidr: the CIDR range must be provisioned and advertised through the Global Accelerator BYOIP process (external state), and Resources EndpointId must be the ARN of a resource type that Global Accelerator supports as an endpoint; neither was registered as a rule.

EndpointConfigurations EndpointId: for cross-account endpoints it must be the ARN of the resource, and AttachmentArn is not required for resources in the same account as the endpoint group; whether an endpoint is cross-account depends on resource ownership (external state), so no rule was registered.
EndpointConfigurations EndpointId: the endpoint resource must be valid and active when it is added (external state).

HealthCheckPath: the page says the path is used if the health check protocol is HTTP/S; it does not say whether specifying it with HealthCheckProtocol TCP is rejected or ignored, so no rule was registered.

AWS::GlobalAccelerator::Listener.rationale: Checked the resource page, the PortRange property page and the 6 schema descriptions. The only conditional wording (ClientAffinity) describes routing behaviour and the NONE default, and its allowed values and the Protocol values are already enforced by schema enums; port bounds are enforced by schema minimum/maximum.

open_questions: Name 'Cannot be the same as the account ID'; the account ID is deployment context rather than a property value, so no rule was registered.
CatalogProperties.DataLakeAccessProperties.CatalogType: 'The currently supported type is aws:redshift', but the pinned schema has no enum; whether other values are rejected needs confirmation.

XMLClassifier, CsvClassifier, GrokClassifier and JsonClassifier are marked Required: Conditional without an explained condition; the pinned schema anyOf already requires at least one, but the pages do not say whether more than one may be specified.
CsvClassifier.QuoteSymbol 'must be different from the column delimiter' (CsvClassifier.Delimiter); the compare operator is numeric only, so this string inequality was not registered.

The ConnectionType text lists required 'ConnectionParameters' keys; the rules map them to ConnectionInput.ConnectionProperties (the CloudFormation map of connection parameter keys). Confirm this mapping.

JDBC, MONGODB and JDBC-type MARKETPLACE connections list 'Required: All of (USERNAME, PASSWORD) or SECRET_ID'; not registered because credentials may also be supplied through ConnectionInput.AuthenticationConfiguration (SecretArn or BasicAuthenticationCredentials) and the page does not say how the two interact.
ConnectionType allowed values include SFTP while the text says 'SFTP is not supported'; whether SFTP is rejected needs confirmation.

OAuth2ClientApplication.UserManagedClientApplicationClientId applies 'if the ClientAppType is USER_MANAGED', but no ClientAppType property exists in the schema; OAuth2Properties.AuthorizationCodeProperties is described as required for the AUTHORIZATION_CODE grant type without saying it is mandatory when OAuth2GrantType is AUTHORIZATION_CODE.
AuthenticationConfiguration.BasicAuthenticationCredentials is 'for supplying basic auth credentials when not providing a SecretArn value'; whether specifying both is rejected is not stated.
CatalogId 'Currently, this should be the AWS account ID'; the account ID is deployment context.
LakeFormationConfiguration.AccountId is 'Required for cross account crawls'; whether a crawl is cross-account depends on the target data's account (external state).
Name 'must be unique per AWS account'; uniqueness depends on existing custom entity types (external state).

AWS::Glue::DataCatalogEncryptionSettings.rationale: Checked the resource page and the DataCatalogEncryptionSettings, EncryptionAtRest and ConnectionPasswordEncryption property pages plus schema descriptions; the conditional wording only describes encryption behaviour and the KMS permissions needed by callers of CreateConnection, and no property combination is stated as required or exclusive.

AWS::Glue::DataQualityRuleset.rationale: Checked the resource page, the DataQualityTargetTable property page and 9 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the ClientToken idempotency recommendation and descriptive uniqueness of names, with no stated property condition.

open_questions: DataLakePrincipal.DataLakePrincipalIdentifier is marked Required: Conditional without an explained condition.
Arguments: the page lists the valid argument keys (--enable-glue-datacatalog, GLUE_PYTHON_VERSION with 3 or 2); no operator checks map keys, so this was not registered.

AWS::Glue::IdentityCenterConfiguration.rationale: Checked the resource page (4 property sections) and 5 schema descriptions; no conditional wording or cross-property condition is stated, and the InstanceArn format is already enforced by the schema pattern.

open_questions: IntegrationConfig.RefreshInterval: 'Time increment can be set from 15 minutes to 8640 minutes (six days)', but the property is a string and the value format (plain minutes or a unit suffix) is not stated, so no range rule was registered.

The page says source and target properties are set by two separate calls (the AWS Glue connection ARN with SourceProcessingProperties, the AWS Glue database ARN with TargetProcessingProperties); whether one resource may set both, and whether the ResourceArn kind must match the properties used, is not stated as a rule.
MaxCapacity for an Apache Spark ETL job (Command.Name glueetl) 'cannot have a fractional DPU allocation'; no operator checks that a number is an integer, so only the 2 to 100 range was registered.
Command.PythonVersion: the text says 'Allowed values are 3 or 3.9. Version 2 is deprecated.' while the listed pattern still accepts 2; whether 2 is rejected needs confirmation.
Command.ScriptLocation is described as '(required)' but marked Required: No; whether every job type needs it (for example Ray jobs) needs confirmation.
AllocatedCapacity 'is no longer supported. Use MaxCapacity instead.'; whether specifying it is rejected or ignored is not stated.
ExecutionProperty.MaxConcurrentRuns: the maximum value is controlled by a service limit (account quota).

WorkerType: the text says it 'Accepts a value of Standard, G.1X, or G.2X' while the page's allowed values also list G.025X, G.4X, G.8X and Z.2X; the accepted set needs confirmation, so no value rule was registered.

MaxCapacity: the page says 'You can allocate from 2 to 100 DPUs' and also 'MaxCapacity and NumberOfWorkers must both be at least 1'; only the consistent bounds (at least 1, at most 100) were registered and the lower bound of 2 needs confirmation.
Name: 'Names are required to be unique'; uniqueness depends on existing transforms (external state).
StorageDescriptor.NumberOfBuckets 'must' be specified 'if the partition contains any dimension columns'; which columns are dimension columns is not identifiable from the property values.
PartitionInput.Values must be ordered like the partition keys of the table's Amazon S3 prefix; this depends on the table definition (another resource).
Name 'may only contain letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, dollar sign, or hash mark'; only the no-whitespace part was registered because the letter set (ASCII or Unicode) is not defined.
DataFormat: the page says 'Currently only AVRO is supported' while the pinned schema enum and allowed values include JSON and PROTOBUF; not registered.
Name 'may only contain letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, dollar sign, or hash mark'; only the no-whitespace part was registered because the letter set (ASCII or Unicode) is not defined.

AWS::Glue::SchemaVersionMetadata.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 property sections) and 3 schema descriptions; no conditional wording or cross-property condition is stated, and required properties and lengths are enforced by the schema.

AWS::Glue::SecurityConfiguration.rationale: Checked the resource page, the EncryptionConfiguration, S3Encryption, CloudWatchEncryption and JobBookmarksEncryption property pages and 6 schema descriptions; no conditional wording is stated (the pages do not say a KMS key is required for a given encryption mode).

open_questions: GlueVersion 'must be greater than 2.0'; whether 2.0 itself is accepted is unclear, so no comparison rule was registered.

WorkerType: the text accepts G.1X, G.2X, G.4X or G.8X for Spark sessions and Z.2X for Ray sessions, while the pinned schema enum also allows Standard and G.025X; Command.Name is described as 'glueetl' or 'gluestreaming' only, so how a Ray session is identified is not stated. No rule was registered.
TableInput.PartitionKeys must at least be an empty list when the table is used by Amazon Athena; whether a table is used by Athena is not a property value.

LogType is only mandatory when ResourceArn could match more than one log type, and valid values depend on the source service; this cannot be decided from this resource's values.
Only one integration is allowed per account, and DashboardViewerPrincipals must also be granted the CloudWatchOpenSearchDashboardAccess IAM policy; both depend on state outside this resource.
ApplyOnTransformedLogs is valid only for log groups that have an active log transformer; this depends on an AWS::Logs::Transformer or account-level transformer policy, not on this resource's values.

AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page and 2 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is JSON escaping guidance for PolicyDocument and the quota of 10 resource policies per account and Region, which is account state rather than a property condition.

open_questions: Most property descriptions are 'Property description not available' (QueryLanguage, ExecutionRoleArn, LogGroupIdentifiers, ScheduleStartTime, ScheduleEndTime, StartTimeOffset); allowed QueryLanguage values and any relation between ScheduleStartTime and ScheduleEndTime could not be reviewed.

AWS::Logs::StorageTierPolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page and 3 schema descriptions; 'Only INTELLIGENT_TIERING is accepted for creation' is already enforced by the StorageTier enum, which contains only INTELLIGENT_TIERING.

open_questions: ApplyOnTransformedLogs is valid only for log groups that have an active log transformer; this depends on another resource.

RoleArn is not needed for a logical cross-account destination; whether it is required for Kinesis Data Streams or Firehose destinations is not stated, and the destination kind is only implied by DestinationArn.
Transformers can be created only for log groups in the Standard log class; this depends on the log group named by LogGroupIdentifier.

A transformer must contain at least one parse-type processor (ParseJSON page); the pages do not list which processors count as parse-type (for example Csv, Grok, ParseKeyValue, ParseToOCSF), so no rule is registered.
Template Reference page was unavailable on 2026-09-29; review is based on pinned schema descriptions only

AWS::M2::Application.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Definition property page and 1 schema description; the inline-JSON or S3 location choice for Definition is already enforced by the schema oneOf, and the need for an existing runtime environment is a deployment prerequisite, not a property condition.

AWS::M2::Deployment.rationale: Checked the resource page and 5 schema descriptions; the text only describes identifiers and the service availability notice, and the required fields, patterns and ApplicationVersion minimum are enforced by the schema.

open_questions: PreferredMaintenanceWindow must also be less than 24 hours long; the duration between the two day/time parts cannot be checked with the available operators.

AWS::MSK::BatchScramSecret.rationale: Checked the resource page (no pinned schema descriptions); it only identifies the cluster ARN and the list of Secrets Manager secret ARNs, with no conditional wording.

open_questions: The Channel page gives no property descriptions ('Property description not available') and the schema only describes AppendOnly; whether exactly one of IcebergDestinationConfiguration and S3DestinationConfiguration is required is undocumented and not registered.

BrokerNodeGroupInfo ClientSubnets: exactly two subnets are required in US West (N. California), the subnets must be in distinct Availability Zones, and they can't occupy the Availability Zone use1-az3; these depend on the Region and subnet placement and only the two-to-three count is registered.
BrokerNodeGroupInfo InstanceType: kafka.t3.small can't be selected when the metadata mode is KRaft; the metadata mode is not a property of this resource, so no rule is registered.
Policy: the maximum size of the resource-based policy document is 20 KB; document size cannot be checked with the rule operators.
KafkaVersionsList: to update it successfully, Name must be updated in the same operation; this update-time restriction is not registered.
ConsumerGroupOffsetSyncMode ENHANCED requires a corresponding replicator that replicates data from the target cluster to the source cluster; this depends on another AWS::MSK::Replicator.

SaslOAuthBearer TokenEndpointTlsCertificateArn is required only if the identity provider uses a private CA, and the ClientCredentials secret must contain client_id and client_secret; both depend on external state.

AWS::MSK::ServerlessCluster.rationale: Checked the resource page, the ClientAuthentication/Sasl pages and 1 pinned schema description; the Sasl text about inCluster, clientBroker and unauthenticated refers to settings that do not exist on this type (only Sasl Iam is defined), so there is no single-resource condition to register.

AWS::MSK::Topic.rationale: Checked the resource page and 6 pinned schema descriptions; they only describe the cluster ARN, topic name, partition count, replication factor and Base64 configs, with minimums already enforced by the schema.

AWS::MSK::VpcConnection.rationale: Checked the resource page and 3 pinned schema descriptions; Authentication values and the subnet, security group and VPC ID patterns are already enforced by the schema, and no conditional wording is present.

open_questions: Schedulers: the page states 'v2 - For environments larger than mw1.micro, accepts values from 2 to 5' and 'v1 - Accepts 1'; how these Airflow-version ranges apply to Airflow 3.x versions is not stated, so no rule is registered.
MaxWebservers, MinWebservers and Schedulers: the valid range for mw1.micro environments is not stated (only its default of 1).

EnvironmentClass: the page lists valid values (mw1.micro, mw1.small, mw1.medium, mw1.large, mw1.1large, mw1.2large) that the pinned schema does not enforce; confirm before relying on the class-dependent web server rules.

NetworkConfiguration.SubnetIds must be private subnets in two different Availability Zones, and the security groups must be in the same VPC as the subnets; this depends on the referenced subnet and security group resources.
Page text states length limits that the pinned schema lacks: Name 1-128 characters, Description 1-512 characters, Criteria.Regex 1-512 characters.
Allow lists cannot be created in the Asia Pacific (Osaka) Region (regional availability).
An AWS::Macie::Session must exist for the account before this resource is created (use DependsOn); this depends on another resource.

Page text states limits that the pinned schema lacks: Name 1-128 characters, Description 1-512, Regex 1-512, Keywords 1-50 items of 3-90 characters, IgnoreWords 1-10 items of 4-90 characters, MaximumMatchDistance 1-300.
An AWS::Macie::Session must exist for the account before this resource is created (use DependsOn); this depends on another resource.
Page text states length limits that the pinned schema lacks: Name 3-64 characters, Description 1-512 characters.
An AWS::Macie::Session must exist for the account before this resource is created (use DependsOn); this depends on another resource.

AWS::Macie::Session.rationale: Checked the resource page and 5 schema descriptions; Status and FindingPublishingFrequency values are enforced by enums, and 'only one session per account in each Region' is account state, not a property condition.

open_questions: The Member page does not state when NetworkConfiguration (create a new network) versus NetworkId and InvitationId (join an existing network) must be specified, or whether they are mutually exclusive; confirm against the CreateMember/CreateNetwork API before registering a rule.

The property pages list constraints that the pinned schema lacks (NetworkConfiguration Framework HYPERLEDGER_FABRIC | ETHEREUM, NetworkFabricConfiguration Edition STARTER | STANDARD, MemberConfiguration Name and NetworkConfiguration Name patterns, AdminUsername pattern, ThresholdPercentage 0-100, ProposalDurationInHours 1-168); they are only 'Allowed values'/range lines and are not registered as rules.

MemberId applies only to Hyperledger Fabric; whether the node's network is Hyperledger Fabric or Ethereum depends on the network identified by NetworkId (external state; for example n-ethereum-mainnet is an Ethereum public network), so 'MemberId only for Fabric networks' is not registered as a rule.
NodeConfiguration InstanceType and AvailabilityZone must be valid for the network's framework and Region; the allowed instance types are not listed on the page and depend on external state.

The page says that for each bridge you specify the type of bridge, but it does not state that exactly one of IngressGatewayBridge or EgressGatewayBridge is required; confirm before registering an exactly-one rule.

Each Sources item may contain FlowSource or NetworkSource; the pages do not state that exactly one is required, nor that ingress bridges must use network sources and egress bridges flow sources; confirm.
SourceFailoverConfig SourcePriority PrimarySource names 'the source you choose as the primary source'; the pages do not state that it must match a Sources item name.
Name must be unique among outputs in the bridge; this depends on the other outputs of the bridge identified by BridgeArn (cross-resource), so it is not registered.
Name must be unique among sources in the bridge; this depends on the other sources of the bridge identified by BridgeArn (cross-resource), so it is not registered.
FlowSource and NetworkSource are both optional; the pages do not state that exactly one must be specified; confirm before registering an exactly-one rule.

The pages do not state which Source settings are required together or mutually exclusive (EntitlementArn for entitled content, GatewayBridgeSource for a bridge source, or Protocol with ingest settings for a standard source); confirm before registering a source-kind rule.

A flow with a VPC source must first be created with a temporary standard source and then updated to use the VPC interface; whether Source.VpcInterfaceName may be set at creation is a deployment-sequence question and is not registered.
VpcInterfaces SubnetId must be in the Availability Zone of the flow; this depends on the subnet (external state).

The VpcInterface note states a maximum of three VPC interfaces per flow (in the context of NDI outputs) while AWS::MediaConnect::FlowVpcInterface says up to two; confirm the limit before registering a VpcInterfaces size rule.
The schema says to set FlowSize to LARGE to enable NDI sources or outputs; confirm whether LARGE (or LARGE_4X) is mandatory when Source.Protocol is ndi-speed-hq.
SourceIngestPort (read-only) says the port must be 2088 for Zixi sources; the Source IngestPort section does not repeat this, so no rule is registered for Source.IngestPort.

Source.Decryption SPEKE parameters (DeviceId, Region, ResourceId, Url, ConstantInitializationVector) are deprecated in the pinned schema although the page says they are required for SPEKE; confirm whether SPEKE decryption is still supported.

NdiConfig is also required when the flow has an NDI output, SourceFailoverConfig State limits the flow to one or two sources, and SourcePriority PrimarySource names a source; outputs and additional sources are separate AWS::MediaConnect::FlowOutput/FlowSource resources, so these checks are cross-resource.

Encryption.Algorithm is required by the pinned schema, but the page says it must be left blank for SPEKE encryption, and the SPEKE parameters are deprecated in the schema; confirm whether KeyType speke is still usable for entitlements.
Name must be unique within the flow and each flow can have up to 50 entitlements; both depend on the other entitlements of the flow identified by FlowArn (cross-resource).
Subscribers must be AWS account IDs; the pinned schema has no pattern and the rule engine cannot match every array item against a pattern, so the account ID format is not registered.
The Encryption section says the allowable encryption type is static-key, but the Encryption KeyType page and the pinned schema also allow srt-password; confirm before restricting KeyType.
Name must be unique within the flow and each flow can have up to 50 outputs; both depend on the other outputs of the flow identified by FlowArn (cross-resource).

EncodingParameters apply only to outputs on flows that have a CDI source, EncodingName must match the media stream type defined on the flow, and an ndi-speed-hq output requires the flow's NdiConfig with NdiState ENABLED; these depend on the AWS::MediaConnect::Flow resource (cross-resource).

The intro lists the supported protocols as RIST, RTP, RTP-FEC, SRT-listener, SRT-caller, Zixi pull and Zixi push, which omits ndi-speed-hq allowed by the Protocol enum; only the explicit CDI/ST 2110 JPEG XS exclusion is registered.

Adding a source requires Failover to be enabled on the flow, the same protocol as the existing source, and FailoverMode FAILOVER for SRT caller/listener; these depend on the AWS::MediaConnect::Flow identified by FlowArn (cross-resource).

The Decryption section says the allowable encryption type is static-key, while KeyType allows speke and srt-password and the SPEKE parameters (and EntitlementArn) are deprecated in the pinned schema; confirm before restricting KeyType.
The pages do not state which source settings are required together or mutually exclusive (EntitlementArn, GatewayBridgeSource, or Protocol with ingest settings); confirm.
Name must be unique within the flow, including VPC interfaces nested in AWS::MediaConnect::Flow (cross-resource).
SubnetId: the subnets used across all VPC interfaces on the flow must be in the same Availability Zone as the flow (external and cross-resource).
A flow can have up to two VPC interfaces according to this page (three according to the Flow VpcInterface note); the count depends on other resources and the limit is inconsistent.
VPC interfaces for NDI outputs must be defined inside AWS::MediaConnect::Flow, not with this resource; whether the flow uses NDI outputs is cross-resource.
AvailabilityZone must be a valid Availability Zone for RegionName (or the current Region); this depends on external state.
Standard.Protocol is optional and the pages do not state that it must agree with the protocol key used in Standard.ProtocolConfiguration; confirm.

AWS::MediaConnect::RouterNetworkInterfac.rationale: Checked the resource page, 4 property pages (RouterNetworkInterfaceConfiguration, PublicRouterNetworkInterfaceConfiguration, PublicRouterNetworkInterfaceRule, VpcRouterNetworkInterfaceConfiguration) and 16 pinned schema descriptions. The Public/Vpc choice is enforced by the schema oneOf, the AllowRules and SecurityGroupIds sizes by minItems/maxItems, and the only other conditional wording is the RegionName default.

open_questions: AvailabilityZone must be a valid Availability Zone for RegionName (or the current Region); this depends on external state.
Standard.Protocol is optional and the pages do not state that it must agree with the protocol key used in Standard.ProtocolConfiguration; confirm.

HopDestinations Queue 'cannot be the original queue to which the job is submitted'; the submission queue is the template Queue unless a job overrides it, and the rule engine cannot compare two strings for inequality, so check manually that no HopDestinations Queue equals Queue.
SettingsJson must conform to AWS Elemental MediaConvert job validation (the CreateJobTemplate Settings model); the pinned schema types it as a plain object, so its content is not checked by any rule.
AccelerationSettings Mode has no allowed values on the page or in the pinned schema; confirm the valid values (for example DISABLED, ENABLED, PREFERRED) against the MediaConvert API.
SettingsJson must conform to AWS Elemental MediaConvert job validation (the CreatePreset Settings model); the pinned schema types it as a plain object, so its content is not checked by any rule.

ConcurrentJobs is constrained by the service quotas 'Maximum concurrent jobs, per on-demand queue' and 'Maximum concurrent jobs, per account' (account state, external); confirm the value against the account quotas.
Vpc.SubnetIds: for a STANDARD channel the subnets must be mapped to two unique Availability Zones; checking this needs the subnets' Availability Zones (external).

VideoDescription Width/Height and VideoPositionRectangle X/Y/Width/Height must be even numbers, and Border must be an even integer 0-100 with Width and Height each greater than twice Border; parity and this arithmetic cannot be expressed with the available operators.
H265Settings.TreeblockSize must be 32x32 for tiled encoding, but the page does not give the enumeration literal (the MediaLive API value is presumably TREE_SIZE_32X32); confirm before registering.

H265Settings GopBReference DISABLED, SubgopLength FIXED and GopNumBFrames 2 are also required when the resolution is greater than 1080p; the resolution may come from the source when VideoDescription Width/Height are blank, so only the tiled case is registered.
H264Settings.EntropyEncoding CABAC 'must be in Main or High profile': confirm which Profile values (HIGH_10BIT, HIGH_422, HIGH_422_10BIT, MAIN) count as Main or High before registering.

H264Settings.QualityLevel must be ENHANCED_QUALITY and H265Settings.RateControlMode MULTIPLEX is required only when the channel is delivered to a MediaLive multiplex; confirm whether Destinations[].MultiplexSettings is a sufficient single-resource indicator.

M2tsSettings.SegmentationTime 'is required unless markers is set to None_' (UDP, SRT, MediaConnect Router and Archive containers): confirm that 'markers' means SegmentationMarkers and that the literal is NONE before registering.
HlsGroupSettings.TsFileMode SINGLEFILE 'Applies only if the Mode field is VOD': confirm whether SINGLEFILE with Mode LIVE is rejected or ignored.

Numeric ranges stated only in descriptions (FecOutputSettings ColumnDepth 4-20 and RowLength 1-20, M2ts PatInterval/PmtInterval 0 or 10-1000, M2ts/M3u8 PID fields 32-8182 in decimal or hex lists, AncillarySourceSettings SourceAncillaryChannelNumber 1-4, CaptionLanguageMapping CaptionChannel maximum 4) are not in the pinned schema; decide whether to register them.
CaptionRectangle: LeftOffset + Width and TopOffset + Height must each add up to 100 or less; sums are not supported by the operators.
Caption selector names must be unique across all input attachments of the channel; the registered rule only checks duplicates within one attachment.

H264Settings/H265Settings.Bitrate must be unique (rounded down to a multiple of 1000) across the outputs of a Microsoft Smooth output group, and MediaPackageV2DestinationSettings HlsAutoSelect/HlsDefault (at most one YES, not all NO) and OutputUsage (all or none of the video outputs in a group) are group-wide constraints that need cross-referencing outputs and video descriptions.
MediaPackageOutputDestinationSettings.ChannelId and MultiplexProgramChannelDestinationSettings.MultiplexId must be in the same Region as the channel (external).

Output settings reference descriptions and destinations by name (VideoDescriptionName, AudioDescriptionNames, CaptionDescriptionNames, Destination.DestinationRefId, CaptionSelectorName, MediaConnectRouterOutputSettings Destination must reference an OutputDestination with MediaConnectRouterSettings); cross-reference integrity is not registered.

AWS::MediaLive::ChannelPlacementGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page and the Tags property page plus the pinned schema descriptions; they only describe values (cluster ID, node list, tags) and read-only attributes, with no conditional requirement.

open_questions: MetricName 'Must be compatible with targetResourceType'; the page gives no mapping of metric names to TargetResourceType values.

Name must be unique among AWS::MediaLive::CloudWatchAlarmTemplate resources in the same Region ("Names must be unique within the scope of a resource type in a specific region"); this depends on other resources and cannot be checked from one resource.

Name must be unique among AWS::MediaLive::CloudWatchAlarmTemplateGroup resources in the same Region ("Names must be unique within the scope of a resource type in a specific region"); this depends on other resources and cannot be checked from one resource.

Name must be unique among AWS::MediaLive::EventBridgeRuleTemplate resources in the same Region ("Names must be unique within the scope of a resource type in a specific region"); this depends on other resources and cannot be checked from one resource.

Name must be unique among AWS::MediaLive::EventBridgeRuleTemplateGroup resources in the same Region ("Names must be unique within the scope of a resource type in a specific region"); this depends on other resources and cannot be checked from one resource.

Destinations and InputSecurityGroups apply only to push inputs, Sources only to pull inputs, MediaConnectFlows only to MediaConnect inputs, InputDevices only to Elemental Link inputs, Vpc only to Amazon VPC push inputs, and RoleArn only to MediaConnect or VPC inputs; the page does not list which Type values belong to each category (the pinned schema has no Type enumeration).
RouterSettings applies only to Type MEDIACONNECT_ROUTER; confirm whether RouterSettings with another Type is rejected before registering.

InputDestinationRequest.NetworkRoutes is required when the push input has an input location of ON-PREM; the page writes the InputNetworkLocation value as ON-PREM / On-Prem, so the literal to compare is unconfirmed.
Vpc.SubnetIds must be associated with two unique Availability Zones (external subnet data).
SrtListenerSettings.MinimumLatency has 'Range 120-15000' in the description but no minimum/maximum in the pinned schema; decide whether to register it.

RouterSettings.Destinations should have one destination for a single-pipeline input and two for a standard input; the input class is not a property of AWS::MediaLive::Input, so only the 1-2 range is registered.

AWS::MediaLive::InputSecurityGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page and the InputWhitelistRuleCidr property page; the descriptions only state that WhitelistRules entries are IPv4 CIDR ranges, with no conditional or cross-property requirement.

AWS::MediaLive::Multiplex.rationale: Checked the resource page and 4 property pages (MultiplexSettings, MultiplexOutputDestination, MultiplexMediaConnectOutputDestinationSettings, Tags); required fields and numeric ranges are already enforced by the pinned schema and no conditional requirement is stated.

open_questions: MultiplexProgramSettings.ProgramNumber must be unique ('Unique program number'), presumably among the programs of the same multiplex; this needs other AWS::MediaLive::Multiplexprogram resources.

AWS::MediaLive::Network.rationale: Checked the resource page and 3 property pages (IpPool, Route, Tags) plus schema descriptions; they only describe CIDR, gateway and name values, and IpPools/Name requirements are already in the pinned schema.

AWS::MediaLive::SdiSource.rationale: Checked the resource page and the Tags property page; Mode and Type allowed values are already enforced by pinned-schema enums and no conditional requirement is stated.

open_questions: Name must be unique among AWS::MediaLive::SignalMap resources in the same Region ("Names must be unique within the scope of a resource type in a specific region"); this depends on other resources and cannot be checked from one resource.
DiscoveryEntryPointArn must be a top-level supported AWS resource ARN; the page does not list the supported resource types.

AWS::MediaPackage::Asset.rationale: Checked the resource page and 12 pinned schema descriptions; the text only describes identifiers, the S3 source and egress endpoints, and states no property condition beyond the schema's required fields.

AWS::MediaPackage::Channel.rationale: Checked the resource page, the LogConfiguration page and 15 pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording describes the default access-log group names, and LogGroupName is already enforced by the schema pattern.

open_questions: EncryptionContractConfiguration: the page says it can be used for DASH endpoints that use SPEKE Version 2.0; whether it is also accepted under HlsPackage, MssPackage and CmafPackage encryption (the pinned schema marks the HLS and MSS presets deprecated) is not stated as a rule, so no restriction by package type is registered.

DashPackage UtcTimingUri: the page describes it as the value used 'when utcTiming is set to HTTP-ISO or HTTP-HEAD' (the schema adds HTTP-XSDATE); whether UtcTimingUri is required for those UtcTiming values, or ignored otherwise, is not stated.

SpekeKeyProvider: CertificateArn must be a certificate imported to AWS Certificate Manager and the DRM key provider must support content key encryption; RoleArn must trust MediaPackage. These depend on external state and are not checked.

EncryptionContractConfiguration: the page says it can be used for DASH endpoints that use SPEKE Version 2.0; whether it is also accepted under HlsPackage, MssPackage and CmafPackage encryption (the pinned schema marks the HLS and MSS presets deprecated) is not stated as a rule, so no restriction by package type is registered.

AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Authorization and LogConfiguration pages and 9 pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording describes the default egress log group name, and LogGroupName is already enforced by the schema pattern.

open_questions: MultiviewConfiguration AvailableSources: each source channel must be in the same channel group as the multiview channel and must have InputType CMAF; this depends on other Channel resources and is not registered.

InputSwitchConfiguration PreferredInput is described 'For CMAF inputs'; whether it is rejected for HLS or MULTIVIEW channels is not stated explicitly, so only MQCSInputSwitching is restricted to CMAF.

AWS::MediaPackageV2::ChannelGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag page and 5 pinned schema descriptions; they only describe the name, description, egress domain and timestamps, and the name pattern and lengths are already enforced by the schema.

AWS::MediaPackageV2::ChannelPolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page (no pinned schema descriptions); it only names the channel group, channel and policy document, whose patterns and required status are already enforced by the schema.

open_questions: HlsManifests and LowLatencyHlsManifests: 'You can't use the same manifest name if you use HLS manifest and low-latency HLS manifest'; uniqueness of ManifestName across the two arrays cannot be expressed as a rule.

StartTag TimeOffset: a positive value must be less than the manifest duration minus three times the segment target duration, and a negative value's absolute value must be between three segment durations and the manifest duration; this arithmetic across fields is not registered.

DashManifests BaseUrls DvbPriority and DvbWeight are 'For use with DVB-DASH profiles only'; the dependency of these nested BaseUrls items on the parent manifest's Profiles is not expressible and is not registered.
DASH FixedAvailabilityStartTime must be at least 14 days before the current time; this depends on the deployment date and is not checked.
Segment OutputTimestampMode is only configurable on channels with OutputLockingMode NON_EPOCH_LOCKED; this depends on the Channel resource and is not registered.

SpekeKeyProvider Url: the API Gateway proxy must reside in the same AWS Region as MediaPackage; Segment SegmentDurationSeconds should equal or be a multiple of the input segment duration. Both depend on external state.

AWS::MediaPackageV2::OriginEndpointPolic.rationale: Checked the resource page, the CdnAuthConfiguration page and 3 pinned schema descriptions; they only identify the endpoint, policy and CDN authorization secrets and role, with lengths and required fields already enforced by the schema.

open_questions: CorsPolicy: AllowedOrigins strings may include only one wildcard character (*) and AllowedHeaders 'can contain only one wildcard character'; per-string wildcard counts inside CORS rule arrays cannot be expressed with the rule operators and are not registered.
FillerSlate VodSourceName: the VOD source must already exist in a source location before it can be used for slate; this depends on other resources and is not checked.
HlsPlaylistSettings AdMarkupType: SCTE35_ENHANCED is described as 'for VOD content only'; whether a channel serves VOD content cannot be decided from its own properties, so no rule is registered.

AWS::MediaTailor::ChannelPolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page and 1 pinned schema description; they only name the channel and the IAM policy document, both already required by the schema, with no conditional wording.

open_questions: Only ConcurrentExecutorConfiguration is documented as required for its FunctionType; whether HttpRequestConfiguration, AwsServiceRequestConfiguration, CustomOutputConfiguration, SequentialExecutorConfiguration and VastRequestConfiguration are required for, or limited to, their FunctionType is not stated.

FunctionList: each child function's resolved namespace (Alias, or FunctionId when Alias is omitted) must be unique across the list; this fallback cannot be expressed with the unique operator and is not registered.
ConcurrentExecutorConfiguration FunctionList: child functions cannot themselves be executors; this depends on other AWS::MediaTailor::Function resources.

HttpRequestConfiguration Output keys must start with session., temp., avail., scte., or be a valid adsRequest directive, and VastRequestConfiguration Headers beginning with X-Amz- or method override headers are not allowed; map keys cannot be checked with the rule operators.
AwsServiceRequestConfiguration TargetService lists 'Valid value: elemental-inference'; this service list may grow and is not registered as an allowed-values rule.
HttpPackageConfigurations SourceGroup 'has to match one of the Channel::Outputs::SourceGroup'; this depends on AWS::MediaTailor::Channel resources and is not registered.
SlateAdUrl: the slate is required for VPAID; whether VPAID ads are used depends on the ad decision server responses, so no rule is registered.
TranscodeProfileName should be used only if custom transcode profiles were set up with AWS Support; this is external state.
LogConfiguration EnabledLoggingStrategies VENDED_LOGS requires a delivery destination configured in Amazon CloudWatch; this is external state.

AccessConfiguration AccessType S3_SIGV4: the source location base URL must follow the S3 virtual hosted-style request URL format and MediaTailor needs IAM access to the bucket; the URL format is not registered as a pattern and the IAM requirements are external.
AccessConfiguration: whether SecretsManagerAccessTokenConfiguration is required when AccessType is SECRETS_MANAGER_ACCESS_TOKEN is not stated.
HttpPackageConfigurations SourceGroup 'has to match one of the Channel::Outputs::SourceGroup'; this depends on AWS::MediaTailor::Channel resources and is not registered.

AWS::MemoryDB::ACL.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag page and 8 pinned schema descriptions; the only restriction found (tag keys cannot be prefixed with aws:) is already enforced by the schema pattern, and the rest describes names and status.

open_questions: SnapshotArns: the Amazon S3 object name in each ARN cannot contain any commas; a per-string check inside the array cannot be expressed with the rule operators and is not registered.

AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: the schema description says it cannot be modified after the cluster is created, but the pinned schema does not list it as create-only; this update-time restriction is not registered.

AWS::MemoryDB::MultiRegionCluster.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag page and 16 pinned schema descriptions; TLSEnabled's no-modify statement is already covered by create-only, the name-suffix uniqueness is an account-level identifier note, and UpdateStrategy values are enforced by the schema enum.

open_questions: Parameters: the schema description says 'You must supply at least one parameter name and value', worded for the parameter update; whether an empty Parameters map is rejected at creation is not stated and the size of a map cannot be checked with the rule operators.

AWS::MemoryDB::Snapshot.rationale: Checked the resource page, the ClusterConfiguration and Tag pages and 25 pinned schema descriptions; the r6gd data-tiering wording applies to the read-only DataTiering attribute and the rest describes identifiers and snapshot status.

AWS::MemoryDB::SubnetGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag page and 9 pinned schema descriptions; the subnet-group name uniqueness is an account-level identifier note and SupportedNetworkTypes is read-only, so no property condition is stated.

open_questions: AuthenticationMode: the page says 'All newly-created users require a password' while Type allows password or iam; whether Passwords is required when Type is password, or must be omitted when Type is iam, is not stated.

DBInstanceParameterGroupName is only valid for major engine version upgrade requests (an update-time condition), and the parameter group must be in the same family as the target engine version (depends on another resource).

ServerlessScalingConfiguration MinCapacity and MaxCapacity accept only half-step increments (for example 8, 8.5, 9); this is not expressible with the declarative operators. The page lists Minimum 2 for MaxCapacity while the schema description states 2.5 (registered).
SnapshotIdentifier must match an existing snapshot, and after a restore the same SnapshotIdentifier must be specified for future updates (external state and update-time condition).

RestoreToTime, RestoreType, SourceDBClusterIdentifier and UseLatestRestorableTime share a generic description; the conditions between them for point-in-time restores (for example RestoreToTime versus UseLatestRestorableTime) are not stated.
GlobalClusterIdentifier: Neptune global databases are supported only in select Regions (regional availability).
NetworkType (IPV4 | DUAL) is determined by the DB subnet group given in DBSubnetGroupName (depends on another resource).

Family must be neptune1 for engine versions prior to 1.2.0.0 or neptune1.2 for 1.2.0.0 and higher; the engine version is set on the DBCluster (another resource) and later families may exist, so no value rule is registered.
Parameters: the schema description says a maximum of 20 parameters can be modified in a single request; confirm whether this limits the Parameters object at creation.

DBSnapshotIdentifier: the schema description says this parameter is not supported (AWS::Neptune::DBInstance does not support restoring from snapshots) while the page intro describes adding it to restore; confirm whether it must be left unspecified.
AllowMajorVersionUpgrade must be true when an EngineVersion of a different major version is specified; this is an update-time condition and the engine version is set on the DBCluster.
DBSubnetGroupName: when updated, the new subnet group must be in a new VPC (update-time condition).
