AuthenticationConfig.AuthenticationMetadata is described as 'the specific configuration for the chosen authentication type', but the page does not state the mapping from AuthenticationType (BASIC, API_KEY, OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS, NONE, IAM, OAUTH2_AUTHORIZATION_CODE) to the metadata member, so no consistency rule is registered.
Which AuthenticationType values each connector Type supports is not documented on the page; this depends on the service, not on the resource values.

AWS::QuickSight::Agent.rationale: Checked the resource page, 5 property pages and 41 schema descriptions; the only choice (CustomPromptInput ExistingPrompt or NewPrompt) is already enforced by the schema oneOf, and the remaining wording describes limits, read-only status values or behaviour.

open_questions: The page says either a SourceEntity or a Definition must be provided, but does not say whether both may be given together; only the at-least-one rule is registered.

About 45 further union-type structures inside Definition (for example AggregationFunction, the field wells of each visual type, NumericFormatConfiguration, VisualCustomActionOperation, TooltipItem, AxisDisplayRange, DataLabelType) state that only one of their attributes can be defined; they occur at many nested paths and are not registered as individual rules.

VisualId and SheetTextBoxId must be unique within the context of the dashboard, template, or analysis across all sheets and visual types; uniqueness across the different visual union members is not registered.

AxisLabelOptions says the field that the label is targeted to (ApplyTo) must be specified, but ApplyTo is optional in the pinned schema and AxisLabelOptions occurs at many nested paths; not registered.

Cross-structure conditions are not registered: DefaultFilterControlConfiguration applies only to filters scoped to multiple sheets, ExplicitHierarchy fields can't be duplicated to other visuals, DecalSettings.DecalStyleType applies only to line series and ElementValue only to field level settings, and CalculatedMeasureField is only used in pivot tables.
SourceEntity.SourceTemplate.Arn, dataset ARNs and ThemeArn must refer to existing, accessible QuickSight assets (external state).

ApplicableTo.Type has no type or allowed values in the page or the pinned schema (only GROUP is mentioned), and the item values of Actions and AssetTypes are undocumented; valid values cannot be checked.
ApprovalGroups has an account-level upper bound enforced by the service (configurable approver-group limit); this is external state.

AWS::QuickSight::CustomPermissions.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Capabilities and Tag property pages and 3 schema descriptions; every capability only accepts DENY, which the schema enum already enforces, and no conditional wording between properties was found.

AWS::QuickSight::DLPSetting.rationale: Checked the resource page, 6 property pages and 3 schema descriptions; the pages carry no property descriptions and the only provider choice (ProviderConfig MicrosoftPurview) is already enforced by the schema oneOf and enums, so no condition was found.

open_questions: The Dashboard page does not state whether SourceEntity or Definition must be provided: SourceEntity says a dashboard can only be created from a template, while the pinned schema also accepts Definition; no presence rule is registered.

About 45 further union-type structures inside Definition (for example AggregationFunction, the field wells of each visual type, NumericFormatConfiguration, VisualCustomActionOperation, TooltipItem, AxisDisplayRange, DataLabelType) state that only one of their attributes can be defined; they occur at many nested paths and are not registered as individual rules.

VisualId and SheetTextBoxId must be unique within the context of the dashboard, template, or analysis across all sheets and visual types; uniqueness across the different visual union members is not registered.

AxisLabelOptions says the field that the label is targeted to (ApplyTo) must be specified, but ApplyTo is optional in the pinned schema and AxisLabelOptions occurs at many nested paths; not registered.

Cross-structure conditions are not registered: DefaultFilterControlConfiguration applies only to filters scoped to multiple sheets, ExplicitHierarchy fields can't be duplicated to other visuals, DecalSettings.DecalStyleType applies only to line series and ElementValue only to field level settings, and CalculatedMeasureField is only used in pivot tables.
ThemeArn must exist in the same AWS account where the dashboard is created, and the source template and dataset ARNs must exist (external state).

PhysicalTableMap entries (PhysicalTable), LogicalTableMap entries (Source as LogicalTableSource and each DataTransforms TransformOperation) and TagColumnOperation ColumnTag items are variant structures where only one attribute can be non-null; they sit under map-valued properties that a rule scope cannot address, so no rule was registered.
FieldFolders: a column can only be in one folder; this spans entries of the FieldFolders map and was not registered.

InputColumn and CastColumnTypeOperation SubType are only available for decimal columns of a SPICE dataset, and S3Source InputColumns support only STRING types for files that aren't JSON; these sit inside PhysicalTableMap/LogicalTableMap map entries and depend on the upload file format, so they were not registered.

RowLevelPermissionDataSet: DENY_ACCESS is not supported for new RLS datasets, and FormatVersion VERSION_1 requires UserName and GroupName while VERSION_2 requires UserARN and GroupARN and says 'Namespace must not exist'; these describe the permissions dataset referenced by Arn (another resource), and it is unclear whether 'Namespace' means the RowLevelPermissionDataSet.Namespace property or a column, so no rule was registered.

RowLevelPermissionTagConfiguration.TagRuleConfigurations: 'At least one rule in this structure must have all tag values assigned to it to apply RLS' is ambiguous (tag values are assigned at runtime) and was not registered.

AthenaParameters.ConsumerAccountRoleArn says 'Provide this along with RoleArn to enable role-chaining'; it is unclear whether RoleArn is required whenever ConsumerAccountRoleArn is set, so no rule was registered.

IdentityCenterConfiguration (AthenaParameters, RedshiftParameters) can only be specified if the Quick Sight account is configured with IAM Identity Center; this is an account setting (external state).

RedshiftIAMParameters: the RoleArn must grant redshift:CreateClusterUser (when AutoCreateDatabaseUser is used) and redshift:JoinGroup (when DatabaseGroups is used), and its trust policy must allow Quick Sight; these are IAM policy contents (external state).
The page does not state which DataSourceParameters member each Type value requires (for example ATHENA with AthenaParameters), so Type/parameter consistency is not checked.

AWS::QuickSight::Flow.rationale: Checked the resource page, 2 property pages (Permission, StepAliasMapping) and the pinned schema (no descriptions); most properties have no description and FlowDefinition is an internal format, so no conditional wording was found.

AWS::QuickSight::Folder.rationale: Checked the resource page, 2 property pages (ResourcePermission, Tag) and 9 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording (omit Permissions to specify none) describes a default, and FolderType/SharingModel values are already enforced by schema enums.

open_questions: KbTemplateConfiguration.Template: the template structure (type value) depends on the connector type of the data source referenced by DataSourceArn, which is another resource's value.

Web Crawler (WEBCRAWLERV3) requires authType with valid values NO_AUTH, BASIC_AUTH, FORM, SAML, but the text ('Requires connectionConfiguration with seedUrls or siteMapUrls (mutually exclusive) and authType') does not make clear whether authType belongs in connectionConfiguration or at the template root, so no authType rule was registered for Web Crawler.
Page-listed formats inside Template (tenantId in UUID format, bucketName and bucketOwnerAccountId patterns, deletionProtectionThreshold 1 to 100) were not registered as rules.

For S3V2, document-level ACL enforcement needs both accessControlConfiguration.crawlAcl true in the Template and AccessControlConfiguration.IsACLEnabled true; enabling only one 'does not produce a fully ACL-enforced knowledge base' (behaviour, not a validation error); decide whether a WARNING rule is wanted.

AWS::QuickSight::LimitsProfile.rationale: Checked the resource page, the ProfileLimitValue property page and the pinned schema (no descriptions); no conditional wording was found and Unit values are already enforced by the schema enum.

open_questions: DataSourceType: the page says 'Valid values are SNOWFLAKE' while the pinned schema enum lists 38 data source types; confirm whether only SNOWFLAKE is accepted before registering a rule.

RefreshOnDay.DayOfWeek and ScheduleFrequency.RefreshOnDay are described as required for 'weekly and monthly' intervals, while DayOfMonth is the documented monthly field; whether DayOfWeek is also required for MONTHLY is unclear, so only the WEEKLY DayOfWeek and MONTHLY DayOfMonth rules were registered.
Interval MINUTE15, MINUTE30 and HOURLY can only be used for one schedule per dataset; this spans other AWS::QuickSight::RefreshSchedule resources for the same DataSetId.
TimeZone must match an ID from java.util.time.getAvailableIDs() (external catalog); not checked.

AWS::QuickSight::Space.rationale: Checked the resource page, 3 property pages (ResourcePermission, SpaceResource, Tag) and 20 schema descriptions; none states a condition between properties and SpaceResource.ResourceType is already enforced by the schema enum.

open_questions: The page says either a SourceEntity or a Definition must be provided, but does not say whether both may be given together; only the at-least-one rule is registered.

About 45 further union-type structures inside Definition (for example AggregationFunction, the field wells of each visual type, NumericFormatConfiguration, VisualCustomActionOperation, TooltipItem, AxisDisplayRange, DataLabelType) state that only one of their attributes can be defined; they occur at many nested paths and are not registered as individual rules.

VisualId and SheetTextBoxId must be unique within the context of the dashboard, template, or analysis across all sheets and visual types; uniqueness across the different visual union members is not registered.
SheetDefinition says 'Every analysis and dashboard must contain at least one sheet'; the sentence does not name templates, so no Definition.Sheets presence rule was registered for templates.

Cross-structure conditions are not registered: DefaultFilterControlConfiguration applies only to filters scoped to multiple sheets, ExplicitHierarchy fields can't be duplicated to other visuals, DecalSettings.DecalStyleType applies only to line series and ElementValue only to field level settings, and CalculatedMeasureField is only used in pivot tables.
SourceEntity SourceTemplate/SourceAnalysis ARNs and DataSetReferences must refer to existing, accessible QuickSight assets whose dataset schemas match the placeholders (external state).
BaseThemeId must identify an existing theme that the custom theme inherits from (ultimately one of the Quick Sight starting themes listed by ListThemes); this is external state and was not checked.

AWS::QuickSight::TopicV2.rationale: Checked the resource page, 6 property pages and 5 schema descriptions; most properties have no description and none states a condition between properties (DataSetRelation only describes a relation between two datasets).

AWS::QuickSight::VPCConnection.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag and NetworkInterface property pages and 13 schema descriptions; the only wording found describes ID uniqueness, and subnet/security group counts and ID patterns are already enforced by the schema.

open_questions: PolicyTemplate: the Action list must contain only actions supported by the specified ResourceType; checking this needs the IAM service authorization reference and cannot be decided from the design values alone.
ResourceType: valid values are those returned by the ListResourceTypes operation (external catalog, not enumerated in the pinned schema).
Name must be unique within the AWS Region among customer managed permissions; this depends on existing account state.

PermissionArns: only one permission can be associated with each resource type included in the resource share; deciding this needs the resource type of each permission ARN (permission metadata), which is not available from the design values.

SourceCustomDbEngineVersionIdentifier: the page says you can't specify a different JSON manifest when this property is specified; it does not say whether Manifest must be omitted or may repeat the source CEV's manifest, so no rule was registered. The sentence 'You can specify a different AMI by using either Source or UseAwsProvidedLatestImage' is likewise not precise enough for a rule.

KMSKeyId: a symmetric encryption KMS key is required for RDS Custom but optional for Amazon RDS; the page does not map this to Engine values (for example custom-oracle-ee / custom-oracle-ee-cdb versus sqlserver-*), so confirm which engines require KMSKeyId.

Engine: the description lists valid values (custom-oracle-ee, custom-oracle-ee-cdb, sqlserver-dev-ee, sqlserver-ee, sqlserver-se) that the pinned schema does not enforce; the list may be incomplete (for example RDS Custom for SQL Server engines), so confirm before registering a value rule.

EngineVersion: the description gives a malformed pattern (^[a-z0-9_.-]{1,60$}) that the pinned schema does not enforce, and says the Engine and EngineVersion combination is unique per customer per Region (external state); confirm the intended character set before registering a pattern rule.
ImageId, DatabaseInstallationFilesS3BucketName/Prefix and SourceCustomDbEngineVersionIdentifier must refer to an existing AMI, S3 location or CEV (external state).

Cluster-type applicability labels are not registered as rules: 'Valid for: Aurora DB clusters only' (AvailabilityZones, BacktrackWindow for Aurora MySQL only, DBInstanceParameterGroupName, Domain, DomainIAMRoleName, EnableGlobalWriteForwarding, EnableHttpEndpoint, EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication, EnableLocalWriteForwarding, EngineMode, GlobalClusterIdentifier, NetworkType, ReplicationSourceIdentifier, SourceRegion) and 'Multi-AZ DB clusters only' (AllocatedStorage, DBClusterInstanceClass, Iops, PubliclyAccessible) do not say whether the property is rejected or ignored for the other cluster type; confirm before flagging them by Engine.

The Multi-AZ requirement rules infer the cluster type from Engine (mysql or postgres = Multi-AZ DB cluster) and exclude restores; the page does not state whether DBClusterInstanceClass, AllocatedStorage, StorageType and Iops are also required when a Multi-AZ DB cluster is restored from SnapshotIdentifier or a source cluster.
Iops must be a multiple between .5 and 50 of the storage amount (AllocatedStorage); the ratio check is not expressible with the declarative operators.

MasterUsername and MasterUserPassword are 'Required: Conditional', but the page states only when they must not be specified, not when they are required (for example a new cluster without a snapshot or source, or with ManageMasterUserPassword); confirm.

MasterUsername and MasterUserPassword must not be specified with GlobalClusterIdentifier according to the page; this was not registered because a cluster can also be added as the first (primary) member of an empty AWS::RDS::GlobalCluster, and the page does not say whether the prohibition applies then.

EngineVersion: the page says not to use this property when the DB cluster is a member of a global database cluster (set it on AWS::RDS::GlobalCluster instead); membership of a primary cluster is defined on the other resource, so no rule was registered for GlobalClusterIdentifier with EngineVersion.
EnableGlobalWriteForwarding can be set only on members of an Aurora global database; membership may be defined on AWS::RDS::GlobalCluster (another resource).

RestoreToTime must be specified if UseLatestRestorableTime isn't provided and must be before the latest restorable time; the page does not state that this applies only to point-in-time restores, and the restorable time is external state.
StorageEncrypted must not be specified when SnapshotIdentifier refers to an encrypted snapshot (depends on the snapshot, external state).

PreferredBackupWindow must be at least 30 minutes and must not conflict with PreferredMaintenanceWindow; PreferredMaintenanceWindow must be at least 30 minutes; window arithmetic is not expressible with the declarative operators.

ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration: MaxCapacity 'largest value that you can use is 128' may be outdated for newer Aurora versions, MinCapacity may be 0 only for versions supporting auto-pause (otherwise 0.5), and ACU values must be half-step increments; these depend on the engine version or are not expressible, so they were not registered.
ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration must be set before adding a DB instance with the db.serverless instance class (depends on AWS::RDS::DBInstance).

DBInstanceParameterGroupName is valid only with AllowMajorVersionUpgrade for a major version upgrade (update-time; AllowMajorVersionUpgrade is not a property of this schema), and the parameter group must be in the same family as the cluster (depends on another resource).

EnableCloudwatchLogsExports: the page lists valid log types per engine (Aurora MySQL audit, error, general, slowquery; Aurora PostgreSQL postgresql) but none for Multi-AZ mysql/postgres, and the lists may be incomplete; no items_in rule was registered.
NetworkType (IPV4 | DUAL) is determined by the DB subnet group (another resource); the value list is not in the pinned schema.

External state: SnapshotIdentifier and SourceDBClusterIdentifier must match existing snapshots/clusters; PubliclyAccessible true fails if the DB subnet group's VPC has no internet gateway; EngineLifecycleSupport open-source-rds-extended-support-disabled fails if the major version is past its end of standard support; KmsKeyId for a cross-Region read replica must be valid in the destination Region.
DBClusterParameterGroupName must not match the name of an existing DB cluster parameter group (external state).

Family must be a DB cluster parameter group family returned by describe-db-engine-versions for aurora-mysql, aurora-postgresql, mysql or postgres, and the group can be applied only to DB clusters whose engine and version match the family (external list and another resource).
KMS and storage encryption for ordinary creation is implemented; restore, replica, cluster, and further RDS conditions need review.

Parameters: the page says 'You must specify at least one parameter name and value', but Parameters is optional (Required: No) and the wording comes from the parameter-update API; confirm whether an empty Parameters object is rejected at creation (object entry counts are not expressible with the operators).

Family must be a parameter group family that describe-db-engine-versions returns for the engine (external engine-version data), and the group can be applied only to DB instances whose engine and engine version are compatible with the family (depends on another resource).

VpcSecurityGroupIds: if you plan to update the resource, don't specify VPC security groups in a shared VPC; whether the subnets belong to a shared VPC is external state and the restriction concerns updates, so it is not registered.
DBProxyName must be unique for all proxies owned by the account in the Region (external state).
RDS Proxy has DB engine version and AWS Region limitations (see Limitations for RDS Proxy); these depend on the target database and Region and are not checked.
DBProxyEndpointName must be unique for all DB proxy endpoints owned by the account in the Region (external state).
DBSecurityGroupIngress items: the pages do not say whether CIDRIP and the EC2 security group fields may be combined in one ingress item, or whether each item must specify one of them.

EC2-Classic was retired on August 15, 2022; the pages do not say whether a DB security group without EC2VpcId (a non-VPC DB security group) can still be created, so the non-VPC ingress rules may never apply.

EC2SecurityGroupId must be provided for VPC DB security groups; otherwise EC2SecurityGroupOwnerId and either EC2SecurityGroupName or EC2SecurityGroupId must be provided. Whether the group named in DBSecurityGroupName is a VPC DB security group depends on another resource (AWS::RDS::DBSecurityGroup EC2VpcId), so no rule is registered.
The page describes two forms of authorization (EC2 or VPC security groups, or CIDRIP IP ranges) but does not say whether exactly one of CIDRIP and the EC2 security group fields must be specified.

Aurora Limitless Database must be enabled to create a DB shard group, and the resource is valid for Aurora DB clusters only; both depend on the DB cluster named in DBClusterIdentifier (another resource).

SourceIds must identify sources of the given SourceType (a DBInstanceIdentifier for db-instance, a DBClusterIdentifier for db-cluster, a DBProxyName for db-proxy, and so on); this depends on the referenced resources.

SourceIds items must begin with a letter, contain only ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, and must not end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens; the pinned schema has no item pattern and per-item string checks are not expressible with the declarative operators.
SnsTopicArn: RDS doesn't support FIFO topics; whether the topic is FIFO depends on the referenced AWS::SNS::Topic.

SourceType: the description lists valid values (db-instance | db-cluster | db-parameter-group | db-security-group | db-snapshot | db-cluster-snapshot | db-proxy | zero-etl | custom-engine-version | blue-green-deployment) but the pinned schema has no enum; confirm whether to enforce the list, which has grown over time.
EventCategories must be categories that exist for the chosen SourceType (service event category list, external).
GlobalClusterIdentifier is 'Required: Conditional' but the page does not state the condition.
Engine: the page lists valid values aurora-mysql | aurora-postgresql while the pinned schema enum also allows aurora; confirm whether aurora is still accepted.

EngineLifecycleSupport: the page lists valid values open-source-rds-extended-support | open-source-rds-extended-support-disabled but the pinned schema has no enum; with open-source-rds-extended-support-disabled, creation fails if the DB major version is past its end of standard support date (engine-version data, external).
OptionConfigurations is 'Required: Conditional' but the page does not state the condition.

EngineName: the description lists valid values (mariadb, mysql, oracle-ee, oracle-ee-cdb, oracle-se2, oracle-se2-cdb, postgres, sqlserver-ee, sqlserver-se, sqlserver-ex, sqlserver-web) but the pinned schema has no enum; confirm whether to enforce the list.
The Template Reference page gives 'Property description not available.' for the properties of this type; conditions for GatewayId, LinkAttributes, LinkLogSettings could not be reviewed from AWS text.

The Template Reference page gives 'Property description not available.' for the properties of this type; conditions for GatewayId, LinkAttributes, LinkLogSettings and PublicEndpoint could not be reviewed from AWS text.
SubnetIds: an account service quota limits the number of Availability Zones the subnets can span (one by default); this is external account state and was not registered.
The page does not state whether AcmCertificateArn or TrustStoreConfiguration is required when Protocol is HTTPS; confirm before registering a rule.

The page states that Domain or DomainList is required without mentioning Platform; confirm whether this requirement (registered as DOMAIN_OR_DOMAIN_LIST) also applies to app monitors with Platform Android or iOS.

AppMonitorConfiguration: when Amazon Cognito is used for authorization, the structure must include the Cognito identity pool ID (IdentityPoolId); whether Cognito authorization is intended cannot be decided from the property values.

MetricDestinations: the page says DestinationArn and IamRoleArn are required when Destination is Evidently, while the pinned schema says Evidently has been discontinued and requests with Evidently are rejected; only a WARNING against Evidently was registered.

MetricDefinitions: UnitLabel and DimensionKeys are only for the CloudWatch destination (DimensionKeys is ignored for Evidently); the per-definition check depends on the parent MetricDestination's Destination and cannot be expressed with the current operators.

MetricDefinitions: Namespace must not be specified for an extended metric, and EventPattern is required for an extended metric; whether a definition is an extended or a custom metric is not decidable from the property values alone.
MetricDefinitions: all dimensions listed in DimensionKeys must also be included in EventPattern (a JSON string); this needs parsing of EventPattern and is not registered.
ResourcePolicy.PolicyDocument can be up to 4 KB in size; the byte-size limit is not in the pinned schema and is not registered.

The LockState attribute is documented as '[Region-level retention rules only]'; confirm whether LockConfiguration must be omitted when ResourceTags is specified (tag-level retention rule), since the LockConfiguration property page does not state this explicitly.

ResourceTags: the same tag key and value pair can be added to a maximum of five retention rules; this limit spans other AWS::Rbin::Rule resources and the existing account state and cannot be checked from one resource.

MasterUserPassword: the page says Amazon Redshift uses MasterUserPassword when ManageMasterPassword is false or not set, but does not state that MasterUserPassword is required in that case (it is not needed when restoring from SnapshotIdentifier); confirm whether a password must be given for a new cluster without ManageMasterPassword.
MasterUsername and DBName cannot be words reserved by the service; the reserved-word list is external to the page.

DBName 'Must contain 1 to 64 alphanumeric characters. Must contain only lowercase letters.'; the registered rule checks only length and lowercase, because the exact allowed character set (digits, underscore) is ambiguous.
Port valid ranges depend on NodeType (RG/RA3: 5431-5455 or 8191-8215; dc2: 1150-65535); these page-listed ranges are not in the pinned schema and are not registered.

ClusterParameterGroupName constraints (1 to 255 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, first character a letter) conflict with default parameter group names such as default.redshift-2.0; not registered, confirm.

EnhancedVpcRouting requires the cluster to be in a VPC, and ElasticIp requires EC2-VPC with an Internet gateway; the intro says a cluster subnet group name must be provided to create a cluster in a VPC. Whether this means ClusterSubnetGroupName must be specified is not stated explicitly (Internet gateway state is external).

OwnerAccount is required when restoring a snapshot you do not own, and SnapshotClusterIdentifier is required when the caller's IAM policy restricts the snapshot resource; both depend on external state.

AvailabilityZone must be in the same Region as the endpoint, and LoggingProperties.BucketName must be an existing bucket in the same Region with read bucket and put object permissions (external state).
ClusterVersion: the page says only version 1.0 is currently available; not registered because it is a current service limitation absent from the pinned schema.
PreferredMaintenanceWindow must be at least a 30-minute window; window arithmetic is not expressible with the operators.

Parameters: the page says a maximum of 20 parameters can be modified in a single request; the pinned schema has no maxItems and it is unclear whether CloudFormation splits larger lists, so it is not registered.
Parameters: for wlm_json_configuration all name-value pairs must be supplied inside the JSON value; the JSON content is not checked.

AWS::Redshift::ClusterSecurityGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag property page and the pinned schema (no schema descriptions); the only conditional text is the intro note that cluster security groups control access to non-VPC clusters, which describes behaviour rather than a property condition.

open_questions: The Amazon EC2 security group and the Amazon Redshift cluster must be in the same AWS Region, and the security group must be associated with a cluster; both depend on other resources.
The page says up to 20 ingress rules can be added to a cluster security group; this is a per-group quota across resources.
SubnetIds must be subnets in an existing VPC (external state); the page limit of 20 subnets per request is already the schema maxItems.

AWS::Redshift::EndpointAccess.rationale: Checked the resource page, 3 property-type pages and 22 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the lowercase/hyphen description of ClusterIdentifier copied from the cluster (it identifies an existing cluster), and name formats are already enforced by schema patterns.

AWS::Redshift::EndpointAuthorization.rationale: Checked the resource page and 12 schema descriptions; the conditional wording (Account is the grantor when Grantee is true, Force deletes endpoints on revoke) describes read-only attributes and delete behaviour, and identifier formats are already enforced by schema patterns.

open_questions: SourceIds: all of the objects must be of the same type as SourceType; this depends on the referenced resources.
Schedule invocations must be separated by at least one hour; cron arithmetic is not expressible with the operators.
IamRole must have permission to run the target operation and must trust scheduler.redshift.amazonaws.com; this depends on the role resource.
ScheduledActionName must be unique within an account (external state).
NamespaceName cannot be a reserved word; the reserved-word list is external to the page.

AdminUsername and DbName: the schema descriptions say only alphanumeric characters and underscores are allowed and the name should start with a letter, but the pinned schema pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z_0-9+.@-]* also accepts + . @ and -; the conflicting character set is not registered.
IamRoles: the schema description mentions a default limit of 10 roles per request (a service quota), which is not registered.

AWS::RedshiftServerless::Snapshot.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Snapshot and Tag property pages and 6 schema descriptions; no conditional wording applies to settable properties, and name formats and lengths are already enforced by schema patterns.

open_questions: ConfigParameters: individual query monitoring metrics (such as max_scan_row_count, max_query_execution_time) and wlm_json_configuration cannot both be used; the operators cannot test one array item against the keys of other items, so it is not registered.

SnapshotOwnerAccount is required when restoring from a snapshot shared by another account (external state) and is used in combination with SnapshotName; confirm whether SnapshotOwnerAccount without SnapshotName should be rejected.
PricePerformanceTarget.Level: the page lists valid values 1, 25, 50, 75 and 100, while the pinned schema only enforces 1 to 100.

AWS::RefactorSpaces::Application.rationale: Checked the resource page, the ApiGatewayProxyInput and Tag property pages and 4 schema descriptions; the conditional wording (VPC-to-VPC connectivity for NetworkFabricType NONE environments, PRIVATE endpoint access) describes networking behaviour of other resources, and names, identifiers and tag keys are already enforced by schema patterns and enums.

AWS::RefactorSpaces::Environment.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 4 schema descriptions; the conditional wording about NetworkFabricType (TRANSIT_GATEWAY provisions a transit gateway, NONE requires your own routing) describes behaviour, and name, description and tag-key formats are already enforced by schema patterns and enums.

open_questions: If an application has no routes, the first route must be created with RouteType DEFAULT, and no route can be active unless the default route is active; both depend on other Route resources of the application.

DefaultRoute is described as the configuration for the DEFAULT route type and UriPathRoute for the URI_PATH route type; the page does not state whether the matching object is required or the other one forbidden for each RouteType (for example whether UriPathRoute.SourcePath is required for URI_PATH).

Route creation fails if the target service's Lambda function is in a Failed state or does not exist, or if a NONE network fabric environment lacks connectivity to the application proxy VPC (external state).
EndpointType (LAMBDA | URL) presumably selects LambdaEndpoint or UrlEndpoint, but the page does not state the correspondence explicitly; only the either-or of the two endpoint objects is registered.

UrlEndpoint.HealthUrl must be a public endpoint when Url is public, and a private endpoint with the same host as Url when Url is private inside a VPC; whether a URL is public or private depends on DNS resolution (external state).
UrlEndpoint.Url must be resolvable over the public internet when the host is a domain name, and for https the top-level domain must be in the IANA root zone database (external state).

KmsKeyId is described as an optional parameter for connected home stream processors, and BoundingBoxRegionsOfInterest and PolygonRegionsOfInterest as part of the connected home feature; the page does not state that they are rejected for face search stream processors, so no rule is registered.
Name must be within the constraints described in the Name section of the StreamProcessor API reference, which is not on this page (the pinned schema pattern is unanchored).

RoleArn must grant Rekognition read access to the Kinesis video stream and write access to the S3 bucket and SNS topic (connected home) or Kinesis data stream (face search); this depends on the role resource.
DataSharingPreference is ignored when the account has opted out at the account level (external state).

ResourceMappings: LogicalStackName, ResourceName, TerraformSourceName and EksSourceName are described as the name the resource is mapped to 'when the mappingType is' CfnStack, Resource, Terraform or EKS respectively; the page does not say whether the matching field is required or the others forbidden for each MappingType.

PermissionModel.InvokerRoleName: the page says it currently accepts only [A-Za-z0-9_+=,.@-] characters but also that a role path must be included (which contains /); the character set is ambiguous and is not registered. Whether InvokerRoleName is required when PermissionModel.Type is RoleBased is not stated.
PermissionModel.CrossAccountRoleArns are required only when resources are in other accounts with a different role name, and those roles must trust the invoker role (external state).

AppTemplateBody is a JSON string whose content has its own constraints (for example only one of logicalStackName, resourceGroupName, terraformSourceName or eksSourceName per excluded logical resource, one failover region in additionalInfo); the JSON content is not checked.

AWS::ResilienceHub::ResiliencyPolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page, the PolicyMap and FailurePolicy property pages and 8 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the note that RTO/RPO values of zero lead to a Policy breached assessment result (behaviour), and the required failure policies, tier and data location values are already enforced by the schema.

open_questions: SharingEnabled is only applicable if the policy owner is a management account or delegated admin (account state, external).

AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections) and 3 schema descriptions; they only describe the policy document and target queues, with no condition beyond the schema's required properties.

AWS::SSMContacts::ContactChannel.rationale: Checked the resource page (6 property sections) and 6 schema descriptions; DeferActivation only describes activation behaviour, the intro note is a recommendation, and the joint requirement of ContactId, ChannelName, ChannelType and ChannelAddress plus the ChannelType values are already enforced by the pinned schema.

open_questions: ContactIds: only contacts of type PERSONAL are supported (ESCALATION and ONCALL_SCHEDULE are not); this depends on the referenced AWS::SSMContacts::Contact resources' Type values and cannot be decided from the rotation alone.

TimeZoneId: time zone designators that don't support Daylight Savings Time rules (such as PST) are not supported; the page gives no complete list of unsupported designators, so the value is not checked by a rule.

ConnectionRecordingPreferences.KMSKeyArn: the KMS key must exist in the same AWS Region as the node the RDP connection is started to; this depends on external state (key region vs. target node region) and cannot be decided from this resource's property values.

AWS::SSMIncidents::ReplicationSet.rationale: Checked the resource page and 3 property pages (RegionConfiguration, ReplicationRegion, Tag) plus 10 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is DeletionProtected, which describes deletion behaviour, and the Regions count, tag key pattern and lengths are already enforced by the pinned schema.

open_questions: Actions[].SsmAutomation.DynamicParameters: the INCIDENT_RECORD_ARN value can only be assigned to runbook parameters of type String and INVOLVED_RESOURCES only to parameters of type StringList; the parameter types are defined in the external Automation document, so this cannot be checked from the response plan alone.

ConfigurationDefinitions[].LocalDeploymentAdministrationRoleArn / LocalDeploymentExecutionRoleName: for types other than AWSQuickSetupType-PatchPolicy they are required for 'any type of deployment for a single account' but may be omitted for organizational deployments; how a single-account vs. organizational deployment is expressed in Parameters differs per configuration type and is not defined on the page, so this is not registered as a rule.

ConfigurationDefinitions[].Parameters: the Template Reference Parameters section in the material only lists parameters for AWSQuickSetupType-CFGRecording; required/conditional parameters of other configuration types (e.g. PatchPolicy, SSMHostMgmt) were not available and need review.

AWS::SSMQuickSetup::LifecycleAutomation.rationale: Checked the resource page (4 property sections and the AssociationId attribute) and 4 schema descriptions; the wording only describes what the properties are used for (association naming, parameter map shape), and the required properties, patterns and lengths are already enforced by the pinned schema.

open_questions: ApplicationProviderArn: the resource only creates OAuth 2.0 customer managed applications and does not support SAML 2.0 customer managed applications or AWS managed applications; whether a given application provider is supported depends on the external provider and cannot be decided from property values.

AWS::SSO::ApplicationAssignment.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 property sections) and 3 schema descriptions; they only describe the application ARN and principal, and the required properties, PrincipalType values and patterns are already enforced by the pinned schema.

AWS::SSO::Assignment.rationale: Checked the resource page (6 property sections) and 6 schema descriptions; the only restrictive wording (TargetType is only an AWS account) is already enforced by the AWS_ACCOUNT enum, and the other properties are covered by required, pattern and enum constraints in the pinned schema.

open_questions: Only one IAM Identity Center instance can be created per account across all AWS Regions, and creation is rejected in the organization management account or when an instance already exists in the account; this depends on account state and cannot be checked from property values.

AWS::SSO::InstanceAccessControlAttribute.rationale: Checked the resource page and 2 property pages (AccessControlAttribute, AccessControlAttributeValue) plus 2 schema descriptions; the deprecated InstanceAccessControlAttributeConfiguration property is only a recommendation to use AccessControlAttributes, and the Source maximum, key pattern and lengths are already enforced by the pinned schema.

open_questions: CustomerManagedPolicyReferences / PermissionsBoundary.CustomerManagedPolicyReference: an IAM policy matching the name and path must exist in each AWS account where the permission set is deployed; this depends on external account state.

AIWorkloadConfigs.WorkloadSpec.Inline: the service validates the YAML or JSON document and it must declare a benchmark object whose type member matches ^(aiperf)$; the requirement is on the content of an embedded document and cannot be checked with the declarative operators.
AWS::SageMaker::AIWorkloadConfig.rationale: The AIDatasetConfig union has a single required member (InputDataConfig) and the lowercase name restriction is enforced by the schema pattern; only the embedded benchmark document requirement remains open.

AWS::SageMaker::Action.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag property page and 20 pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the account-level uniqueness of ActionName and tag-key uniqueness, so no property condition is stated.

AWS::SageMaker::AppImageConfig.rationale: Checked the resource page, 5 property pages and 25 schema descriptions; the 'FileSystemConfig object is not supported' statements for JupyterLab and Code Editor configs are already enforced because the pinned schema has no such property there, and the rest covers defaults and name uniqueness.

AWS::SageMaker::Artifact.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag property page and 19 pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the account-level uniqueness of ArtifactName and tag-key uniqueness, so no property condition is stated.

open_questions: ClusterRole: the page says the role 'is only required when autoscaling is enabled and when HyperPod is performing autoscaling operations'; confirm whether ClusterRole is required whenever AutoScaling.Mode is Enable (not registered).

NodeProvisioningMode: the page says Continuous 'is only supported for EKS orchestrated clusters', but the pinned schema accepts a Slurm orchestrator and says the Slurm AccountingDatabase is supported only with Continuous provisioning; the EKS-only restriction was not registered because the sources conflict.
Orchestrator: the page says 'eks' is currently the only available option, while the pinned schema accepts Eks or Slurm; not registered.

ScheduledUpdateConfig.DeploymentConfig.RollingUpdatePolicy.MaximumBatchSize must be between 5% and 50% of 'the variant's total instance count' (endpoint wording); how this maps to a HyperPod instance group and to the CapacitySizeConfig type is unclear, so it was not registered.

InstanceGroups[].LifeCycleConfig: SourceS3Uri together with OnCreate or OnInitComplete selects Customer Managed or Extended mode; whether SourceS3Uri is required when OnCreate or OnInitComplete is given is only implied, so it was not registered.

AWS::SageMaker::ClusterSchedulerConfig.rationale: Checked the resource page, 3 property pages and 16 schema descriptions; the conditional wording describes FairShare, IdleResourceSharing and priority-class queuing behaviour, and their values are enforced by schema enums.

open_questions: GitConfig.SecretArn: the Secrets Manager secret must have the AWSCURRENT staging label and contain a username/password JSON object; this depends on the secret itself (external state) and was not registered.

AWS::SageMaker::Context.rationale: Checked the resource page and 14 pinned schema descriptions; the only conditional wording is the account-level uniqueness of ContextName, and the inline tag schema carries no aws: restriction.

open_questions: DataQualityAppSpecification.RecordPreprocessorSourceUri and PostAnalyticsProcessorSourceUri are 'Applicable only for the built-in (first party) containers'; whether ImageUri is a built-in container cannot be decided from the property values.
DataQualityJobInput: the page says 'Currently endpoints are supported for input', while the pinned schema also accepts BatchTransformInput; not registered.

DefaultUserSettings.SecurityGroups: the UserSettings page says SecurityGroups is 'Required when the CreateDomain.AppNetworkAccessType parameter is set to VpcOnly, unless specified as part of the DefaultUserSettings for the domain' (written for user profiles); confirm whether a VpcOnly domain must set DefaultUserSettings.SecurityGroups, and whether VpcId and SubnetIds must be set for VpcOnly.

SecurityGroups: SageMaker adds an NFS security group, so 'the number of security groups that you can specify is one less than the maximum number shown' (maximum listed as 32 | 5); the effective limit is unclear and was not registered.
DomainSettings.IpAddressType: 'When you specify dualstack, the subnet must support IPv6 CIDR blocks'; this depends on the referenced AWS::EC2::Subnet resources.
AppNetworkAccessType VpcOnly: internet access needs a NAT gateway or interface endpoints, and NFS over TCP port 2049 must be allowed in security groups; these depend on other resources.
DefaultUserSettings.SharingSettings: S3OutputPath and S3KmsKeyId apply 'When NotebookOutputOption is Allowed'; confirm whether S3OutputPath is required when NotebookOutputOption is Allowed.

ResourceSpec.TrainingPlanArn 'is supported for JupyterLab and CodeEditor app types'; confirm whether it must be absent from the JupyterServer, KernelGateway and RStudio DefaultResourceSpec settings (not registered).

DefaultEbsStorageSettings 'Must be provided if storage type is Amazon EBS and must not be provided if storage type is not Amazon EBS'; the schema has no storage-type property, so this was not registered.

RetainAllVariantProperties and ExcludeRetainedVariantProperties are for updates only ('Use this property only when updating endpoint resources, not when creating new endpoint resources'); a design value cannot tell creation from update, so the creation-time prohibition was not registered.

DeploymentConfig: 'Only one update policy should be used in the deployment configuration' (BlueGreenUpdatePolicy or RollingUpdatePolicy) is worded as a recommendation; confirm whether specifying both is rejected.

RollingUpdatePolicy.MaximumBatchSize (5% to 50%), TrafficRoutingConfig.CanarySize (at most 50%) and LinearStepSize (10-50%) are relative to the variant's total instance count, which is defined in the referenced AWS::SageMaker::EndpointConfig.
KmsKeyId: 'You can't request a KmsKeyId when using an instance type with local storage'; deciding this needs the instance-store table for each ProductionVariants InstanceType.

ExplainerConfig.ClarifyExplainerConfig.InferenceConfig.FeatureTypes: 'If provided, FeatureTypes must have at least one text string'; the declarative assertions cannot test that an array contains a value, so it was not registered.
ServerlessConfig.ProvisionedConcurrency 'Should be less than or equal to MaxConcurrency' is worded as should; confirm whether a larger value is rejected.

ClarifyInferenceConfig.ContentTemplate is 'Required only when the model container input is in JSON Lines format' and ClarifyShapConfig.TextConfig is required for NLP explainability only; both depend on the model container, not on property values.
KMS key policies must grant the IAM role permission to use KmsKeyId, DataCaptureConfig.KmsKeyId and CoreDumpConfig.KmsKeyId; this is external state.

AWS::SageMaker::Experiment.rationale: Checked the resource page and 9 pinned schema descriptions; the wording covers DisplayName falling back to ExperimentName and account-level name uniqueness only, and the inline tag schema carries no aws: restriction.

AWS::SageMaker::ExperimentTrialComponent.rationale: Checked the resource page and the pinned schema (which has no property descriptions); no conditional wording beyond the required TrialComponentName was found.

open_questions: OfflineStoreConfig.S3StorageConfig.KmsKeyId and OnlineStoreConfig.SecurityConfig.KmsKeyId require the role or caller to hold specific kms: permissions; this is external state.
ThroughputConfig: a feature group can be switched to on-demand only once in a 24 hour period; this is an update-time restriction and was not registered.

AWS::SageMaker::Hub.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag property page and 11 pinned schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the required HubName and HubDescription was found.

AWS::SageMaker::HumanTaskUi.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag property page and 9 pinned schema descriptions; the only matches for condition words are timestamp descriptions and tag-key uniqueness, so no property condition is stated.

AWS::SageMaker::ImageVersion.rationale: Checked the resource page and 15 pinned schema descriptions; the DependsOn note describes ordering between resources and version numbering, not a condition on this resource's property values.

open_questions: DeploymentConfig.RollingUpdatePolicy.MaximumBatchSize 'must be between 5% to 50% of the copy count of the inference component'; checking it needs arithmetic on RuntimeConfig.CopyCount and the capacity-size type, which the declarative operators cannot express.

Container.ArtifactUrl 'must point to a single gzip compressed tar archive (.tar.gz suffix)'; the object content is external and it is unconfirmed whether the suffix rule also applies to adapter artifacts, so it was not registered.
Specification.BaseInferenceComponentName must name an existing inference component that hosts the foundation model; this is external state.
Container.Environment supports up to 16 entries; the declarative operators cannot count map entries.
Schedule: 'The maximum duration that you can set for an inference experiment is 30 days'; the declarative operators cannot compute the difference between Schedule.StartTime and Schedule.EndTime.

AWS::SageMaker::MlflowApp.rationale: Checked the resource page, its Tag property page and 12 pinned schema descriptions; no conditional wording beyond the required Name, ArtifactStoreUri and RoleArn was found.

open_questions: Containers[].ContainerHostname: if any container of an inference pipeline specifies ContainerHostname, every container must specify it; this all-or-none condition across array items cannot be expressed with the declarative operators.

ModelDataUrl 'must point to a single gzip compressed tar archive (.tar.gz suffix)' and is required for SageMaker built-in algorithms; multi-model containers use an S3 prefix and whether Image is a built-in algorithm cannot be decided from property values, so neither was registered.
Model artifacts in Amazon S3 and the inference image in Amazon ECR must be in the same Region as the model; this depends on external resources.
ModelDataSource.S3DataSource.ModelAccessConfig.AcceptEula must be true to accept the EULA 'that this model requires'; whether a model requires a EULA is external.
ModelDataSource cannot currently be used with batch transform, serverless endpoints or AWS Marketplace; these depend on how other resources use the model.
Content.ModelPackageDetails.SourceAlgorithms[].AlgorithmName must be an algorithm resource in the account or a subscribed AWS Marketplace algorithm; this is external state.

SourceAlgorithms[].ModelDataUrl 'must point to a single gzip compressed tar archive (.tar.gz suffix)' in a bucket in the same Region as the algorithm; the model card only records this metadata, so it was not registered as a rule.

ValidationSpecification TransformInput DataSource S3DataSource S3DataType: AugmentedManifestFile can only be used when the channel input mode is Pipe, but TransformInput has no input mode property; the condition cannot be evaluated from the resource and was not registered.
TransformResources VolumeKmsKeyId cannot be requested for instance types with local storage; this needs instance-type metadata (external) and was not registered.
ModelDataUrl, S3DataSource S3Uri and SourceAlgorithm ModelDataUrl: the S3 buckets must be in the same Region as the model package, algorithm or job; this is external state and was not registered.

Container and TransformJobDefinition Environment: at most 16 entries are supported in the map; counting map entries is not expressible with the declarative operators and the pinned schema has no maxProperties.
AdditionalInferenceSpecificationsToAdd: the total number of additional inference specifications (existing plus added) cannot exceed 15; this is an update-time condition and was not registered.
ModelAccessConfig AcceptEula must be true to accept the EULA that the model requires; whether a model requires a EULA is external, so no rule was registered.
SourceAlgorithm AlgorithmName must be an algorithm resource in the account or a subscribed AWS Marketplace algorithm; this is external state and was not registered.
S3ModelDataSource CompressionType: the page describes Gzip only together with S3Object and does not state whether Gzip with S3Prefix is invalid, so no rule was registered.

ModelQualityJobInput: the page says 'Currently endpoints are supported', but the schema also offers BatchTransformInput and neither is required; whether exactly one of EndpointInput and BatchTransformInput must be given is not stated, so no rule was registered.

ModelQualityAppSpecification RecordPreprocessorSourceUri and PostAnalyticsProcessorSourceUri are applicable only to built-in (first party) containers; whether ImageUri is a built-in container is external, so no rule was registered.

ScheduleConfig DataAnalysisStartTime / DataAnalysisEndTime: the end time must not follow the start time by more than 24 hours; comparing ISO 8601 duration offsets is not expressible with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.

MonitoringAppSpecification RecordPreprocessorSourceUri and PostAnalyticsProcessorSourceUri are applicable only to built-in (first party) containers; whether ImageUri is a built-in container is external, so no rule was registered.

MonitoringScheduleConfig MonitoringJobDefinition / MonitoringJobDefinitionName and MonitoringInput EndpointInput / BatchTransformInput: neither the page nor the schema states that exactly one of each pair must be given, so no exclusivity rule was registered.
SecurityGroupIds must belong to the same VPC as SubnetId; this needs subnet and security group metadata (external) and was not registered.
KmsKeyId: the KMS key must be enabled, and RoleArn must trust sagemaker.amazonaws.com and be passable by the caller; these are external states and were not registered.

OnCreate and OnStart: the page lists Maximum: 1 script per array, but the pinned schema has no maxItems; page-listed limits are not registered as rules, so confirm whether a single hook per array should be enforced.
Name must be unique within the account and Region; uniqueness depends on existing resources (external state) and was not registered.

AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline.rationale: Checked the resource page, 4 property pages and the 10 pinned schema descriptions. The only choice stated (JSON body or S3 location) is already enforced by the PipelineDefinition oneOf, and the remaining conditional wording describes defaults (latest S3 version, skipped ETag validation).

open_questions: ProcessingResources ClusterConfig VolumeKmsKeyId cannot be requested, and VolumeSizeInGB cannot exceed the local storage size, for instance types with local instance storage; this needs instance-type metadata (external) and was not registered.
ProcessingJobName must be unique within the Region and account; uniqueness depends on existing resources (external state) and was not registered.
ExperimentConfig ExperimentName and TrialName must name existing experiments and trials; this is external state and was not registered.

ProcessingOutputConfig: the page says TargetDevice and TargetPlatform are mutually exclusive, but neither property exists in the pinned schema for this type (text appears copied from compilation jobs); no rule was registered.
ServiceCatalogProvisioningDetails PathId is required if the Service Catalog product has more than one path; this depends on the product definition (external) and was not registered.
SpaceSettings CustomFileSystems S3FileSystem is only supported in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio; whether the domain is a Unified Studio domain is external, so no rule was registered.
KernelGatewayAppSettings CustomImages ImageName must be unique to the account; this is external state and was not registered.
ResourceSpec: when both SageMakerImageVersionArn and SageMakerImageArn are passed, SageMakerImageVersionArn takes precedence; this is precedence behaviour and was not registered as a rule.

Parameters: each TrialComponentParameterValue may specify only one of NumberValue and StringValue, but Parameters is a map keyed by parameter name and the declarative scope operator iterates arrays only, so no rule was registered.
TrialComponentName must be unique in the account (case-insensitive); uniqueness depends on existing resources (external state) and was not registered.

SingleSignOnUserIdentifier and SingleSignOnUserValue are required when the Domain's AuthMode is IAM Identity Center (SSO) and cannot be specified otherwise; this depends on the AWS::SageMaker::Domain resource and was not registered.

UserSettings SecurityGroups are required when the domain's AppNetworkAccessType is VpcOnly unless given in the domain's DefaultUserSettings; this depends on the AWS::SageMaker::Domain resource and was not registered.
SharingSettings S3OutputPath and S3KmsKeyId are described as used 'when NotebookOutputOption is Allowed'; the page does not say they are required or forbidden otherwise, so no rule was registered.
CustomImage ImageName must be unique to the account, and SingleSignOnUserValue must match a user in the directory; these are external states and were not registered.
Only one private workforce can be created in each Region; this depends on existing resources (external state) and was not registered.
WorkforceVpcConfig SecurityGroupIds must be for the same VPC as the subnets; this needs subnet and security group metadata (external) and was not registered.

MemberDefinitions CognitoMemberDefinition: the Cognito user pool and app client must be created first and the user pool must be in the same Region; these depend on other resources or external state and were not registered.
At most 25 work teams can be created per account and Region; this is a quota (external) and was not registered.

Target EcsParameters CapacityProviderStrategy: only one capacity provider in a strategy can have Base defined, but Base defaults to 0 and counting array items that set a field is not expressible with the declarative operators, so no rule was registered.

Target Input: the input must be well-formed JSON for templated Lambda, Step Functions and EventBridge targets; the target kind depends on the Target Arn and JSON validity is not expressible, so no rule was registered.
Target SqsParameters: an SQS FIFO target queue must have content-based deduplication enabled; this depends on the AWS::SQS::Queue resource and was not registered.

Target EcsParameters LaunchType: must match a launch type (compatibility) of the target task definition, FARGATE is available only in Regions that support Fargate, and NetworkConfiguration is relevant only for awsvpc task definitions; these depend on the task definition or Region and were not registered.
Target EcsParameters NetworkConfiguration AwsvpcConfiguration Subnets and SecurityGroups must all be in the same VPC; this needs subnet and security group metadata (external) and was not registered.

Target EcsParameters PlacementStrategy Field for the spread strategy: the page lists 'instanceId (or instanceId, ...)' while the schema says 'instanceId (or host, ...)', plus any platform or custom attribute; because of the discrepancy no value rule was registered for spread.

AWS::Scheduler::ScheduleGroup.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and the 8 pinned schema descriptions. The only limits stated are the account quota of 500 schedule groups (external) and name/tag lengths and patterns already enforced by the schema.

open_questions: SecretId: if the secret already has a resource policy attached, it must be removed before this resource attaches a new one; this depends on the existing state of the secret (external) and was not registered.

HostedRotationLambda requires the template to declare Transform: AWS::SecretsManager-2024-09-16, and HostedRotationLambda Runtime must not be set with that transform (only with AWS::SecretsManager-2020-07-23); these are template-level conditions outside the resource properties and were not registered.
Only one rotation schedule can be defined per secret (SecretId); this spans several resources and was not registered.

RotationRules ScheduleExpression and Duration: rotation can be at most every four hours and the rotation window must not extend into the next UTC day or the next rotation window; checking this needs cron/rate expression evaluation and was not registered.

HostedRotationLambda MasterSecretArn / SuperuserSecretArn: the superuser secret must already exist and its ARN must be included as a key in the JSON of the rotating secret; this depends on other resources and secret values and was not registered.

ExternalSecretRotationMetadata and ExternalSecretRotationRoleArn have no description on the Template Reference page; the schema only says they are used to rotate a managed external secret, so when they are required or allowed (for example together with AWS::SecretsManager::Secret Type) is not stated.

KmsKeyId: if the secret is in a different AWS account from the calling credentials, aws/secretsmanager cannot be used and a customer managed key is required; this depends on account context (external) and was not registered.

Tags: the page states at most 50 tags per secret, key length 127 and value length 255 characters, while the Tag property page lists maximum 128 and 256 and the pinned schema has no limits; the limits were not registered because the sources disagree and the declarative operators cannot count array items.

Name: the page says not to end the secret name with a hyphen followed by six characters because it risks confusion when searching by partial ARN; this is guidance about ARN lookup, not a validity condition, and was not registered.
ReplicaRegions Region must be a valid Region and Type must be the exact partner string of a managed external secret partner; both need external lists and were not registered.
A single secret can have only one target attached (SecretId is unique for each target attachment definition); this spans several resources and was not registered.
TargetId must be the ID of a database or cluster of the kind named by TargetType; the target resource type depends on TargetType, so no reference entry or rule was registered.

AWS::SecurityAgent::AgentSpace.rationale: Checked the resource page, 15 property pages (AWSResources, CodeReviewSettings, IntegratedResource, ProviderResource, VpcConfig, Tag and the repository, capability and Confluence document pages) and 58 schema descriptions. The conditional wording only describes the default AWS managed KMS key and read-only Confluence titles, and the one-resource/one-capability choice of ProviderResource is already enforced by the schema oneOf.

AWS::SecurityAgent::Application.rationale: Checked the resource page, the IdCConfiguration and Tag property pages and 5 schema descriptions; the text only lists accepted KMS key identifier forms and describes read-only IAM Identity Center outputs, so no single-resource condition is stated.

AWS::SecurityAgent::Artifact.rationale: Checked the resource page and 7 schema descriptions; the properties are only described (ArtifactType values are enforced by the schema enum) and no conditional requirement is stated.

open_questions: Assets.Actors[].Authentication.Value is a secret ARN, Lambda function ARN or IAM role ARN 'depending on the provider type', but the page does not state the exact mapping per ProviderType (nor what AWS_INTERNAL expects), so no per-type format rule was registered.

AWS::SecurityAgent::SecurityRequirementP.rationale: Checked the resource page, the SecurityRequirement and Tag property pages and 15 schema descriptions; the conditional wording only gives the Status default (ENABLED) and that KmsKeyId can be set only at creation, which are default and update behaviour rather than requirements.

AWS::SecurityAgent::TargetDomain.rationale: Checked the resource page, 4 property pages (DnsVerification, HttpVerification, VerificationDetails, Tag) and 20 schema descriptions; VerificationMethod and DnsRecordType values are enforced by schema enums and the verification details are read-only outputs.

open_questions: Tags values cannot be prefixed with aws: (pinned schema tag value description); Tags is a key/value map and the rule operators cannot check every map value, so no WARNING rule was registered.

Criteria StringFilter/MapFilter entries: the Comparison descriptions say you can't have both a CONTAINS and a NOT_CONTAINS filter, or an EQUALS and a NOT_EQUALS/PREFIX_NOT_EQUALS filter, on the same field, and that CONTAINS (NOT_CONTAINS) filters can only be used with other CONTAINS (NOT_CONTAINS) filters; this applies to each of the many filter-field arrays and was not registered as per-field rules.
Tags values cannot be prefixed with aws: (pinned schema tag value description); Tags is a key/value map and the rule operators cannot check every map value, so no WARNING rule was registered.

Criteria.OcsfFindingCriteria.CompositeFilters: the StringFilter/MapFilter Comparison descriptions forbid combining CONTAINS with NOT_CONTAINS, or EQUALS with NOT_EQUALS/PREFIX_NOT_EQUALS, on the same field; entries for the same FieldName are spread across array items and this cross-item check was not registered.

Actions[].Type FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE / EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION presumably needs FindingFieldsUpdate / ExternalIntegrationConfiguration respectively, but the pages do not state this requirement, so no rule was registered.
Tags values cannot be prefixed with aws: (pinned schema tag value description); Tags is a key/value map and the rule operators cannot check every map value, so no WARNING rule was registered.

SecurityControlCustomParameters[].Parameters: when ValueType is CUSTOM the Value field can't be empty, and when ValueType is DEFAULT a provided Value is ignored; Parameters is a map keyed by parameter name and the rule operators cannot iterate map entries, so these were not registered.
Only the Security Hub CSPM delegated administrator can create this resource in the home Region; this depends on account and organization state.
Tags values cannot be prefixed with aws: (pinned schema tag value description); Tags is a key/value map and the rule operators cannot check every map value, so no WARNING rule was registered.

Provider.Azure.ScopeConfiguration.ScopeValues is 'the list of scope values, such as subscription IDs, when the scope type is subscription'; the page does not say whether ScopeValues is required for SUBSCRIPTION or must be omitted for TENANT, so no rule was registered.

Provider.Azure.ScopeConfiguration.ScopeValues is 'the list of scope values, such as subscription IDs, when the scope type is subscription'; the page does not say whether ScopeValues is required for SUBSCRIPTION or must be omitted for TENANT, so no rule was registered.
Tags values cannot be prefixed with aws: (pinned schema tag value description); Tags is a key/value map and the rule operators cannot check every map value, so no WARNING rule was registered.

The Security Hub CSPM integration with AWS Organizations must be enabled first and only the organization management account can designate the delegated administrator; these depend on organization state, not on AdminAccountId.

Regions is interpreted according to RegionLinkingMode (excluded Regions for ALL_REGIONS_EXCEPT_SPECIFIED, included Regions for SPECIFIED_REGIONS), but the page does not state that Regions is required for those modes or forbidden for ALL_REGIONS, so no rule was registered.
The resource must be created in the Region to be designated as the aggregation Region; this depends on the deployment Region, not on property values.
Tags values cannot be prefixed with aws: (pinned schema tag value description); Tags is a key/value map and the rule operators cannot check every map value, so no WARNING rule was registered.
An AWS::SecurityHub::Hub resource must exist for the account before other Security Hub CSPM resources are created (DependsOn); this is a cross-resource ordering requirement.

NetworkScanning is available in the AWS commercial partition only and specifying it in another partition fails; it also requires Security Hub V2 to be enabled in the same account and Region. Both depend on the deployment partition/account state.

Filters StringFilter/MapFilter entries: you can't provide both an EQUALS filter and a NOT_EQUALS or PREFIX_NOT_EQUALS filter on the same field; this applies to each of the 104 filter-field arrays and was not registered as per-field rules.
Filters.VulnerabilitiesExploitAvailable and VulnerabilitiesFixAvailable can be used only if Security Hub CSPM and Amazon Inspector are used; this depends on account state.

AWS::SecurityHub::PolicyAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page and 8 schema descriptions; ConfigurationPolicyId (UUID or SELF_MANAGED_SECURITY_HUB) and TargetType are already enforced by the schema pattern and enum, and the remaining wording describes read-only association status.

AWS::SecurityHub::ProductSubscription.rationale: Checked the resource page and 2 schema descriptions; ProductArn is constrained by the schema pattern and the text only describes that changing the subscription requires a new resource.

open_questions: Parameters: when ValueType is CUSTOM the Value field can't be empty, and when ValueType is DEFAULT a provided Value is ignored; Parameters is a map keyed by parameter name and the rule operators cannot iterate map entries, so these were not registered. SecurityControlId/SecurityControlArn presence is already enforced by the schema anyOf.
SourceName and SourceVersion 'must be a Regionally unique value'; uniqueness depends on the other log sources already added in the Region, not on this resource's values.
Multiple AwsLogSource resources must be created sequentially with DependsOn; this is a cross-resource ordering requirement.

If one template creates data lakes in several Regions and more than one of them includes an AwsLogSource resource, the data lakes must be deployed sequentially; this is a cross-resource deployment requirement.
Sources[].AwsLogSource and Sources[].CustomLogSource SourceName/SourceVersion 'must be a Regionally unique value' (schema descriptions); this depends on sources registered in the Region.
A subscriber can be created only for accounts already enabled in Amazon Security Lake; this depends on account state.
Only one subscriber notification can be created per subscriber; this depends on other SubscriberNotification resources with the same SubscriberArn.

AWS::ServiceCatalog::AcceptedPortfolioSh.rationale: Checked the resource page and 2 schema descriptions; the text only describes the language code and portfolio identifier, with no conditional requirement.

open_questions: SourceConnection.Type: 'The only supported SourceConnection type is Codestar.' The pinned schema has no enum and the exact value spelling (for example CODESTAR) is not given, so no value rule was registered.

ProvisioningPreferences: the pages say you must specify either StackSetFailureToleranceCount or StackSetFailureTolerancePercentage (and either StackSetMaxConcurrencyCount or StackSetMaxConcurrencyPercentage), but also give a default of 0 and apply the preferences only to CFN_STACKSET products (a property of the product, not of this resource); only the 'not both' parts were registered.
StackSetMaxConcurrencyCount is at most one more than StackSetFailureToleranceCount; the rule operators cannot compare against a value plus one, so this was not registered.
